In either mode, only the secure password hash is stored. An invalid or mismatched manual password is rejected without creating the account. The system creates an Active account with the selected non-Admin role and no room assignment. In GENERATE mode, passwordChangeRequired \= Yes. In MANUAL mode, passwordChangeRequired \= No. The system records the account creation in the audit log without recording the plaintext password or its hash. The system returns the new account ID and the generated or manually supplied initial password once. In GENERATE mode, the password is returned as a temporary password and passwordChangeRequired \= Yes. In MANUAL mode, the password is returned as the official initial password and passwordChangeRequired \= No. The web client retrieves the created account detail. The system displays “Đã tạo tài khoản” and the “Sao chép” button. In GENERATE mode, the password label is “Mật khẩu tạm thời” and the system states that the staff member must change it at first sign-in. In MANUAL mode, the password label is “Mật khẩu chính thức” and the system states that the staff member is not required to change it at first sign-in. The Admin selects “Xem chi tiết”, “Tạo tài khoản khác” or “Về danh sách”. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 14): Create another account 1.1. The Admin clicks “Tạo tài khoản khác”. 1.2. The system clears the result and opens a new empty creation form. AF-02 (at step 14): View the created account 1\. The Admin clicks “Xem chi tiết”. 2\. The system opens UC-06 for the created account. AF-03 (at step 14): Return to the account list 3.1. The Admin clicks “Về danh sách”. 3.2. The system returns to UC-05. AF-04 (at step 4): Cancel account creation 4.1. The Admin clicks “Hủy” or the back button. 4.2. The system immediately returns to the previous screen. 4.3. No account is created. 4.4. The current implementation does not show an unsaved-data confirmation. AF-05 (after step 9): Doctor or Technician account 5.1. The account is created without a room assignment. 5.2. The success result displays:    “Tài khoản chưa được phân công phòng. Phân công phòng làm việc ở chức năng Khoa / Phòng.” 5.3. Room assignment is completed separately. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 5): Required field empty, invalid format or value too long 1.1. The web client displays the corresponding Vietnamese validation message under each invalid field. 1.2. It also displays “Vui lòng sửa các ô được đánh dấu.” 1.3. The request is not sent until client-side errors are corrected. 1.4. In MANUAL mode, an invalid password displays MSG41, and a mismatched confirmation displays MSG42 in the form's common error area.  1.5. No account is created. EF-02 (at step 7): Username, phone number, non-empty email or non-empty practice-license number already exists 2.1. The system rejects the request with Conflict. 2.2. The web client displays the corresponding duplicate-field error. 2.3. No account is created. EF-03 (at step 9): Concurrent uniqueness conflict 3.1. A database uniqueness constraint detects a conflict during account creation. 3.2. The transaction is rolled back. 3.3. The web client displays the corresponding duplicate-data error. 3.4. No account is created. EF-04 (at steps 6–9): Unauthorized requester, expired session or system error 4.1. The system rejects a non-Admin requester or an expired session. 4.2. For a network or system error, the web client displays the corresponding Vietnamese error. 4.3. No account is created. EF-05 (at step 5): The practice-license number is missing5.1. The selected role is Doctor or Technician.5.2. “Số giấy phép hành nghề” is empty.5.3. The system shows MSG02 under “Số giấy phép hành nghề”.5.4. No account is created.5.5. The use case returns to the account-creation form. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: a new Active account exists with exactly one non-Admin role. Doctor/Technician accounts may be unassigned to a room and cannot perform room-dependent work until assigned (UC-15). In GENERATE mode, the user can sign in with the temporary password and must change it before continuing. In MANUAL mode, the user can sign in with the Admin-entered password and is not required to change it.. The creation is audited without recording the password. Failure / Cancelled: no account is created. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-01, BR-02, BR-05, BR-42, BR-49, BR-57, BR-58, BR-59, BR-60, BR-61, BR-62, BR-63, BR-64, BR-138. |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG02, MSG05, MSG07, MSG08, MSG12, MSG13, MSG41, MSG42, MSG80 |  |  |

### **2.4 UC-08: Update Account Information** {#2.4-uc-08:-update-account-information}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to update the personal and contact information of another non-Admin staff account so that the account displays the latest staff information. The seeded Admin account and the requester’s own account cannot be updated through UC-08. Locked non-Admin accounts may be updated without being unlocked. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | 1\. The Admin is signed in and viewing another staff account in UC-06. The target must not be the Admin's own account; Locked staff accounts may be updated without being unlocked. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin clicks “Chỉnh sửa tài khoản” on another non-Admin staff account. The system opens “Cập nhật thông tin tài khoản”. The screen displays the account’s current information.                   The editable fields are: “Họ và tên”; “Học hàm / học vị”; “Số giấy phép hành nghề”; “Mã liên thông bác sĩ” (displayed and editable only for Doctor accounts; optional).  “Ngày sinh”; “Giới tính”; “Số điện thoại”; “Email”; “Địa chỉ”. “Tên đăng nhập” and “Trạng thái” are displayed as disabled fields.The current role is displayed but cannot be changed on this screen. The Admin changes one or more editable values. The “Lưu thay đổi” button becomes enabled only after an editable value differs from the originally loaded value. The Admin clicks “Lưu thay đổi”. The web client validates the form. The system verifies Admin authorization, rejects the seeded Admin account and self-administration, and checks the submitted account version. The system validates all editable fields, including “Số giấy phép hành nghề” and “Mã liên thông bác sĩ”.  The system checks the uniqueness of the phone number, any non-empty email and any non-empty practice-license number and any non-empty Mã liên thông bác sĩ  across all accounts, including Locked accounts. The system atomically saves all changed editable fields while preserving the username, role and account status. For every stored field whose value actually changes, the system records a separate account change-history entry containing the field, old value, new value, Admin and change time. The system returns the updated account detail. The web client updates its cached account detail, refreshes the account list and returns to the previous screen. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at steps 6–8): Restore the form 1.1. The Admin clicks “Khôi phục”. 1.2. The system restores all editable fields to the values originally loaded. 1.3. The “Lưu thay đổi” and “Khôi phục” buttons become disabled. AF-02 (at steps 6–8): Cancel editing 2.1. The Admin clicks “Hủy” or the back button. 2.2. The system returns to the previous screen immediately. 2.3. Unsaved changes are discarded without an unsaved-data confirmation. AF-03 (at step 7): No values have changed 3.1. The “Lưu thay đổi” button remains disabled. 3.2. No update request is sent. 3.3. No change-history entry is created.  |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 9): Invalid field value 1.1. The web client displays the Vietnamese validation message under the invalid field. 1.2. It also displays “Vui lòng sửa các ô được đánh dấu.” 1.3. No update request is sent until the client-side errors are corrected. EF-02 (at step 12): A unique account field already exists  2.1. The system detects that the submitted phone number, non-empty email or non-empty practice-license number or non-empty Mã liên thông bác sĩ belongs to another account. 2.2. The system shows MSG07 under each conflicting field. 2.3. No account or change-history data is changed. 2.4. The use case returns to step 6\.  EF-03 (at step 10): Protected account or self-update 3.1. The system rejects updating an account having the ADMIN role. 3.2. The web client displays “Không thể thực hiện thao tác này trên tài khoản Quản trị viên.” 3.3. A direct self-update request is also rejected. 3.4. No account or history change is committed. EF-04 (at step 10): Concurrent modification 4.1. The account version no longer matches the loaded version. 4.2. The system rejects the update with Conflict. 4.3. The web client displays “Tài khoản vừa được thay đổi bởi thao tác khác. Vui lòng tải lại trang rồi thử lại.” 4.4. No account or history change is committed. EF-05 (at steps 10–15): Unauthorized requester, expired session, network failure or system error 5.1. The system rejects an unauthorized requester or expired session. 5.2. The web client displays the corresponding Vietnamese error. 5.3. No account or history change is committed. EF-06 (at step 10): Mã liên thông bác sĩ submitted for a non-Doctor account 6.1. The system rejects the request because only a Doctor account holds a Mã liên thông bác sĩ. 6.2. No account or history change is committed.  |  |  |
|  **Postconditions** | Success: all submitted editable personal and contact fields, including “Số giấy phép hành nghề” and, for a Doctor, “Mã liên thông bác sĩ”, contain their new values. Username, role and account status remain unchanged. A separate account change-history entry exists for each stored field whose value actually changed. Cancelled: no update request is sent and no change-history entry is created. Unchanged: the “Lưu thay đổi” button remains disabled; no update request is sent and no change-history entry is created. Failure: no account or change-history data is partially committed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-02, BR-04, BR-42, BR-49, BR-59, BR-60, BR-61, BR-62, BR-64, BR-65, BR-112, BR-119; Permission Matrix 4.4. |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG02, MSG05, MSG07, MSG08, MSG12, MSG13, MSG45, MSG46, MSG75, MSG80 |  |  |

### **2.5 UC-09: Assign Role** {#2.5-uc-09:-assign-role}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----- | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to change a staff account’s role among Receptionist, Doctor, Technician and Cashier so that it matches the staff member’s work. Each account has exactly one role (BR-02). When the new role is Doctor or Technician, the Admin also enters the academic title and practice-license number in the same step, so that every Doctor or Technician account always has them (I1-D47). The sole Admin account is seeded at system initialization; UC-09 cannot assign the Admin role or change the seeded Admin’s role.  |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in and is viewing the target staff account in UC-06. The target account is a non-Admin staff account other than the Admin’s own account.  |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin clicks “Đổi vai trò” on the account detail (UC-06). The system opens “Phân quyền tài khoản” and shows the account summary, the current role with its permissions, and the selectable roles “Lễ tân”, “Bác sĩ”, “Kỹ thuật viên” and “Thu ngân”. “Quản trị viên” is not selectable. The Admin selects a new role. The system previews the permissions of the selected role. “Áp dụng vai trò” stays disabled until the selected role differs from the current role. If the current role is Bác sĩ or Kỹ thuật viên and the account has a room, the screen warns that the current room assignment will be removed. If the selected role is Bác sĩ or Kỹ thuật viên, the screen shows the section “Thông tin chuyên môn” with the required fields “Học hàm / học vị” (at most 50 characters) and “Số giấy phép hành nghề” (5–50 letters, digits, “/” or “-”, unique). Both are prefilled with the account’s current values. The screen also reminds the Admin to assign a room after the role change. For Bác sĩ or Kỹ thuật viên, the Admin enters or confirms the academic title and practice-license number. The Admin clicks “Áp dụng vai trò”. The web client checks the professional fields and calls the role-change check with newRole, expectedRole and, for Bác sĩ or Kỹ thuật viên, academicTitle and practiceLicenseNo. The system verifies that: the account and the new role are non-Admin; the account is not the Admin’s own; the role has actually changed; the stored role still matches expectedRole; for Bác sĩ or Kỹ thuật viên, both professional fields are present and valid, and no other account uses the practice-license number. The system counts the visits In Examination and the paraclinical order details In Progress assigned to the account and returns the counts. If there is no work in progress, the web client opens “Xác nhận đổi vai trò” (MSG06). It shows the username, old role, new role, the possible room removal and the warning that all active sessions will be signed out. The Admin clicks “Đổi vai trò”. The system repeats the checks of steps 8 and 9\. In one transaction the system: changes the role; for Bác sĩ or Kỹ thuật viên, saves the academic title and practice-license number; removes the active room assignment when the previous role was Bác sĩ or Kỹ thuật viên; keeps the Active/Locked status; revokes all sessions of the account. The system records the change in the account history (the role, plus the academic title and practice-license number when they changed) and records the security audit event. The system returns the updated account detail. The web client displays “Đã đổi vai trò của \[username\] thành \[new role\]” and opens the updated account detail (UC-06). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at steps 3–6): Cancel the role-selection page1.1. The Admin clicks “Hủy”.1.2. The system returns to UC-06.1.3. Nothing is changed. AF-02 (at step 11): Cancel the confirmation2.1. The Admin closes “Xác nhận đổi vai trò”.2.2. The system returns to the role-selection page with the selected role and entered values kept.2.3. Nothing is changed. AF-03 (at step 4): The new role is Lễ tân or Thu ngân3.1. The section “Thông tin chuyên môn” is not shown, and the request carries no professional fields.3.2. The stored academic title and practice-license number are kept unchanged.3.3. The use case continues at step 6\. AF-04 (after step 16): The new role is Bác sĩ or Kỹ thuật viên4.1. The web client reminds the Admin to assign a room through UC-15 from the account detail.4.2. Until an active room is assigned, the staff member’s room-dependent waiting lists and work functions are unavailable (MSG48).4.3. The use case ends. AF-05 (at step 13): The account is Locked5.1. The role change is allowed and the account stays Locked.5.2. It cannot sign in until unlocked through UC-10.5.3. The use case continues at step 14\. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at steps 1 or 8): The Admin targets their own account1.1. “Đổi vai trò” is not shown on the Admin’s own account.1.2. A direct API request is rejected with MSG45.1.3. Nothing is changed.1.4. The use case ends. EF-02 (at steps 1 or 8): The seeded Admin account or the Admin role is targeted2.1. The system rejects the request and shows MSG46.2.2. Nothing is changed.2.3. The use case ends. EF-03 (at steps 7, 8 or 12): Missing or invalid professional information for Bác sĩ or Kỹ thuật viên3.1. If “Học hàm / học vị” or “Số giấy phép hành nghề” is empty, the system shows MSG02 under the field.3.2. If “Học hàm / học vị” is longer than 50 characters, the system shows MSG08 under the field.3.3. If “Số giấy phép hành nghề” does not have 5–50 letters, digits, “/” or “-”, the system shows MSG05 under the field.3.4. If another account already uses the practice-license number, the system shows MSG07 under the field.3.5. Nothing is changed, and the use case returns to step 5\. EF-04 (at step 8): The selected role is the same as the current role4.1. The interface prevents this by keeping “Áp dụng vai trò” disabled.4.2. A direct API request is rejected; nothing is updated or audited.4.3. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-05 (at steps 9 or 12): The staff member has work in progress5.1. At step 9 the web client does not open the confirmation and displays: “Không thể đổi vai trò: còn \[visits\] lượt khám và \[orders\] chỉ định đang xử lý.”5.2. If work started between steps 9 and 12, the system rejects the change and shows MSG47.5.3. Nothing is changed.5.4. The use case ends. EF-06 (at steps 8 or 12): Concurrent change6.1. The stored role no longer matches expectedRole, or another account took the practice-license number between steps 8 and 12\.6.2. The system rejects the request without changing anything and shows MSG75 (or MSG07 for the practice-license number).6.3. The use case ends. EF-07 (at any step): Session expired or system error7.1. The system shows MSG12 or MSG80.7.2. No partial update is committed.7.3. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the account has the selected non-Admin role; a Doctor or Technician account has the academic title and practice-license number entered in this use case; any room assignment of a previous Doctor/Technician role is removed; the account status is preserved; all account sessions are revoked; the change is recorded in the account history and the security audit. Failure or cancellation: role, professional information, room assignment, status and sessions remain unchanged. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-02, BR-04, BR-05, BR-19.  |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG02, MSG05, MSG06, MSG07, MSG08, MSG12, MSG13, MSG45, MSG46, MSG47, MSG48, MSG75, MSG80.  |  |  |

### **2.6 UC-10: Lock/Unlock Account** {#2.6-uc-10:-lock/unlock-account}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to manually Lock or Unlock a non-Admin staff account to control access without deleting its records (BR-01). Manual account status Locked is distinct from the 15-minute temporary password sign-in block in UC-01; UC-10 does not clear that temporary block. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | 1\. The Admin is signed in (UC-01) and viewing a non-Admin staff account in UC-06. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin clicks “Khóa tài khoản” on an Active non-Admin account. Before opening the lock dialog, the web client requests the number of visits In Examination and paraclinical order details In Progress assigned to the target account. The system opens “Khóa tài khoản \[username\]”. The dialog displays:  “Vui lòng cung cấp lý do khóa tài khoản này (tối đa 500 ký tự).” The Admin enters the required “Lý do khóa” (5–500 characters after trimming, BR-97) and clicks “Khóa tài khoản”.  The web client trims the reason and sends at most 500 characters together with expectedStatus and expectedVersion. The system verifies Admin authorization, validates the trimmed reason length (5–500 characters), rejects the seeded Admin account and self-administration (BR-112), checks the expected account version and status (BR-119), and re-checks that the account has no visit In Examination and no paraclinical order detail In Progress (BR-113).  The system changes the account status from ACTIVE to LOCKED and records the reason, lock time and locking Admin. The system revokes all sessions of the target account. The system records the LOCK account change and ACCOUNT\_LOCKED security audit. The system returns the updated account detail. The web client displays “Đã khóa tài khoản \[username\]” and reloads UC-06 with the updated account detail.  |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 1): Unlock a Locked account 1.1. The Admin clicks “Mở khóa tài khoản”. 1.2. The system opens “Mở khóa tài khoản” and displays MSG06: “Bạn có chắc chắn muốn mở khóa tài khoản \[username\] không?”  1.3. The Admin clicks “Mở khóa”. 1.4. The web client sends expectedStatus and expectedVersion. 1.5. The system verifies Admin authorization, protected-account restrictions, version and current LOCKED status. 1.6. The system changes the status to ACTIVE and clears lockReason, lockedAt and lockedByAccountId. 1.7. The system preserves the account’s role, room assignment, must-change-password flag and independent temporary password-login block. 1.8. The system does not create a new login session. 1.9. The system records the UNLOCK account change and ACCOUNT\_UNLOCKED security audit. 1.10. The system returns the updated account detail. 1.11**.** The web client displays “Đã mở khóa tài khoản \[username\]” and reloads UC-06 with the updated account detail.  AF-02 (at steps 3–5 or AF-01 1.2–1.3): The Admin closes the Lock or Unlock dialog.  2.1. The Admin closes the confirmation dialog. 2.2. The account status remains unchanged. 2.3. No account-change or security-audit success entry is created. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 2 or 7): The staff member has work in progress  1.1. The preliminary web-client check (step 2), or the server re-check (step 7), finds one or more visits In Examination or paraclinical order details In Progress assigned to the account. 1.2. The system displays MSG47: “{full\_name} đang có lượt khám hoặc dịch vụ đang thực hiện. Vui lòng hoàn tất các công việc này trước.” 1.3. At step 2, the “Khóa tài khoản” dialog is not opened. At step 7, the lock command is rejected. 1.4–1.6. Same as the original. EF-02 (at step 5 or 7): Invalid lock reason  2.1. The trimmed reason is empty, or shorter than 5 characters. 2.2. The web client displays under “Lý do khóa”: – MSG31 “Vui lòng nhập lý do.” when the reason is empty; – MSG95 “Lý do phải có từ 5 đến 500 ký tự.” when the reason is too short. 2.3. No API request is sent. A direct API request with an invalid reason is rejected at step 7, and the account status and audit data remain unchanged. 2.4. The use case returns to step 5\.  EF-03 (at steps 1 or 7): Protected account or own account 3.1. Lock/Unlock of an account having the ADMIN role is rejected with MSG46: “Không thể thực hiện thao tác này đối với tài khoản Admin.” 3.2. Self-administration is rejected with MSG45: “Bạn không thể khóa tài khoản của chính mình.” (for Unlock, “mở khóa”). 3.3. No account status or audit data is changed. EF-04 (at step 7): Stale version, invalid status or concurrent modification 4.1. The target version or status differs from expectedVersion or expectedStatus, or an optimistic-locking conflict occurs while saving. 4.2. The system rejects the request with Conflict. 4.3. The web client displays MSG75: “Tài khoản vừa được người khác cập nhật. Vui lòng tải lại và thử lại.”  4.4. No account-status or audit change is committed. EF-05 (at steps 7–11): Unauthorized requester, expired session, network failure or system error 5.1. An unauthorized requester is rejected with MSG13 “Bạn không có quyền thực hiện thao tác này.” 5.2. An expired session displays MSG12 “Phiên đăng nhập của bạn đã hết hạn. Vui lòng đăng nhập lại.” and opens the Login screen. 5.3. A network failure displays MSG96 “Không kết nối được máy chủ. Vui lòng kiểm tra mạng và thử lại.” 5.4. A system error displays MSG80 “Đã xảy ra lỗi. Vui lòng thử lại hoặc liên hệ quản trị viên.” 5.5. The account status and audit data remain unchanged. 5.6. The use case ends.  |  |  |
|  **Postconditions** | Lock success: the account is Locked and all its active sessions are revoked. The lock reason, lock time and locking Admin are recorded. Role, room assignment, work data and historical records remain unchanged. Unlock success: the account is Active and its manual lock information is cleared. Unlocking does not create a login session. The independent temporary password-login block, role, room assignment and password-change requirement remain unchanged. Failure or cancellation: account status, sessions and audit data remain unchanged. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-01, BR-02, BR-05, BR-97, BR-112, BR-113, BR-119, BR-127  |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG06, MSG10, MSG12, MSG13, MSG31, MSG45, MSG46, MSG47, MSG75, MSG80, MSG95, MSG96.  |  |  |

### **2.7 UC-11: Reset Password** {#2.7-uc-11:-reset-password}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | The Admin may reset a non-Admin staff member’s forgotten password using one of two methods. “Hệ thống tự sinh” generates a one-time temporary password that the staff member must change after the next successful sign-in. “Admin nhập thủ công” sets a permanent password agreed with the staff member and does not require another password change. Resetting the seeded Admin account through UC-11 is not allowed. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in and is viewing a non-Admin staff account in UC-06. The staff member has asked for a reset (in person or by phone). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin clicks “Đặt lại mật khẩu” on the account detail (UC-06). The system opens “Đặt lại mật khẩu” and the Admin selects “Hệ thống tự sinh” (default) or “Admin nhập thủ công”. For manual mode, the Admin enters “Mật khẩu chính thức” and “Xác nhận mật khẩu”. The Admin clicks “Đặt lại mật khẩu”. For manual mode, the web client checks that the password has 8–64 characters, is at most 72 UTF-8 bytes and matches its confirmation. If the client-side checks pass, the system shows a confirmation (MSG06) with the target’s full name and username. The Admin confirms the reset. The web client sends the selected mode, the manual password (manual mode only) and the account version. The password confirmation is not sent to the backend. The system checks that the target is not the Admin’s own account and is not the seeded Admin account. The system checks that the account version has not changed. For generated mode, the backend generates a 12-character password that meets the same password policy. For manual mode, the backend checks the password policy again. The system replaces the previous password with a protected hash of the new password. For generated mode, the system sets must-change-password to Yes. For manual mode, it sets must-change-password to No. In both modes, the system clears the failed sign-in count and the temporary password-login block. The system revokes all active sessions of the target account. The account’s status, role, room assignment and personal information remain unchanged. The system records the reset in the security audit log. It does not record the plaintext password or its hash. For generated mode, the system displays the generated password exactly once, with “Sao chép”, “In” and “Đóng”, and states that the staff member must change it at the next sign-in. For manual mode, the system displays the manually entered permanent password exactly once, with “Sao chép”, “In” and “Đóng”. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at steps 2–7): The Admin cancels1.1. The Admin clicks “Hủy” or closes the confirmation.1.2. The password is not changed.1.3. The use case ends. AF-02 (at step 14): Password login is temporarily blocked after failed attempts2.1. The system clears the 15-minute temporary password-login block and the failure counter (UC-01) without changing the account status.2.2. The use case continues at step 15\. AF-03 (at step 16): The account is Locked by the Admin3.1. The password is reset, but the account remains Locked.3.2. The user cannot sign in until the Admin unlocks the account through UC-10.3.3. The use case continues at step 17\. AF-04 (at steps 18–19): The Admin closes the result without copying or printing4.1. The displayed password cannot be viewed again.4.2. If the password was not delivered, the Admin must start another password reset.4.3. A new reset replaces the password created by the previous reset.4.4. This alternative flow applies to both generated and manual modes.4.5. The use case ends. |  |  |
|  **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at steps 1 or 9): The target is the Admin’s own account1.1. “Đặt lại mật khẩu” is not shown on the Admin’s own account.1.2. A direct self-reset request is rejected with MSG45.1.3. The Admin changes their own password through UC-03.1.4. No password, session or account data is changed.1.5. The use case ends. EF-02 (at steps 1 or 9): The target is the seeded Admin account2.1. The system rejects the request and shows MSG46.2.2. No password, session or account data is changed.2.3. The use case ends. EF-03 (at step 5 or 11): The manual password violates the password policy3.1. The web client shows MSG41 in the form-level error area.3.2. No password reset is saved.3.3. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-04 (at step 5): The password confirmation does not match4.1. The web client shows MSG42 in the form-level error area.4.2. No password reset is saved.4.3. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-05 (at step 10): The account version is stale5.1. The system detects that the target account has changed since the reset began.5.2. The system rejects the reset and shows MSG75.5.3. No new password is issued and no account data is changed.5.4. The Admin must reload UC-06 before trying again.5.5. The use case ends. EF-06 (at any step): Unauthorized requester, expired session or system error6.1. A non-Admin requester is rejected with MSG13.6.2. An expired session shows MSG12 and opens the “Đăng nhập” screen.6.3. A system error shows MSG80.6.4. No password, session or account data is changed.6.5. The use case ends. |  |  |
|  **Postconditions** | Generated-mode success: the previous password is invalid, all prior sessions are revoked, the generated password is displayed exactly once, and the staff member must change it after the next successful sign-in. Manual-mode success: the previous password is invalid, all prior sessions are revoked, the manually entered password becomes the account’s permanent password and is displayed exactly once, and no further password change is required. In both modes, the failed sign-in count and the temporary password-login block are cleared, and a Locked account remains Locked until it is unlocked through UC-10. Role, room assignment and personal information remain unchanged. Failure or cancellation: the password, the password-change requirement, the sessions and all other account data remain unchanged. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-01, BR-03; Security: Password protection, Account lockout, Audit trail (IV.2.3).  |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG06, MSG12, MSG13, MSG41, MSG42, MSG45, MSG46, MSG75, MSG80.  |  |  |

## **3\. Department Management** {#3.-department-management}

### **3.1 UC-12: View Department List** {#3.1-uc-12:-view-department-list}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to view the list of clinical and paraclinical departments with their number of rooms and status, so that I can find a department to view, update, lock or unlock. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in (UC-01). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin selects “Khoa / Phòng” in the menu. The system opens “Quản lý khoa/phòng” with the statistic cards and two tabs, “Phòng chức năng” (selected by default) and “Chuyên khoa”, each showing its total count. The Admin selects the “Chuyên khoa” tab. The system displays the “Chuyên khoa” table with “Mã khoa”, “Tên chuyên khoa” (the description is shown under the name), “Phân loại” (Lâm sàng / Cận lâm sàng), “Phòng trực thuộc” (“N phòng”, counting active and inactive rooms), “Trạng thái” (Đang hoạt động / Đang khóa) and “Thao tác” (“Xem chi tiết”, “Chỉnh sửa”, “Khóa chuyên khoa” or “Mở khóa chuyên khoa”). The list is sorted by “Mã khoa”, shows 10 rows per page and the footer “Hiển thị a–b trên tổng số N chuyên khoa”. The Admin types a keyword in the search box and/or selects “Loại khoa” (“Tất cả loại khoa”, “Khoa Lâm sàng”, “Khoa Cận lâm sàng”) and “Trạng thái” (“Tất cả trạng thái”, “Đang hoạt động”, “Đang khóa / Tạm ngưng”). The system filters the list at once and returns to page 1\. The keyword is matched against “Mã khoa”, “Tên chuyên khoa” and the description; case and leading or trailing spaces are ignored, Vietnamese accents are not. The keyword and the filters are combined. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 4): Reset the search and filters 1.1. The Admin clicks “Đặt lại”. 1.2. The system clears the keyword and both filters and shows all departments from page 1\. 1.3. The use case returns to step 4\. AF-02 (at step 3 or 5): Change page or page size 2.1. The Admin clicks “Trang trước”, “Trang sau” or a page number, or selects 5, 10, 15 or 20 rows per page. 2.2. The system shows the selected page with the current keyword and filters; a new page size returns to page 1\. 2.3. The use case returns to step 4\. AF-03 (at step 3): Open the rooms of a department 3.1. The Admin clicks “N phòng” of a department. 3.2. The system opens the “Phòng chức năng” tab with the “Khoa” filter set to that department and the other filters reset (UC-16). 3.3. The use case ends. AF-04 (at step 3): Add a department 4.1. The Admin clicks “Thêm chuyên khoa”. 4.2. The system opens the “Thêm mới chuyên khoa” form with “Mã khoa”\* (2–50 characters, capital letters, digits or “-”, unique; typed letters become capitals), “Tên khoa”\*, “Phân loại chuyên khoa”, “Trạng thái” and the description, checked by the same rules as UC-14. 4.3. After “Thêm chuyên khoa”, the system shows the toast “Đã thêm mới chuyên khoa "{name}" thành công\!” and adds the department to the list. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 5): No department matches 1.1. The table shows “Không tìm thấy chuyên khoa nào phù hợp với điều kiện lọc.” and the footer “Hiển thị 0–0 trên tổng số 0 chuyên khoa”. 1.2. The use case returns to step 4\. EF-02 (at step 1): The user is not an Admin 2.1. “Khoa / Phòng” is not in the menu of the user’s role. 2.2. If the user opens the page address directly, the system shows “Không có quyền truy cập”, MSG13 and the “Về trang chủ” button. 2.3. The use case ends. EF-03 (at step 1): The user is not signed in or the session has ended 3.1. The system opens the “Đăng nhập” screen (UC-01); no data is shown. 3.2. The use case ends. EF-04 (at step 2): The list cannot be loaded 4.1. The system shows the toast “Không thể tải danh sách khoa/phòng: …” with the cause (“không kết nối được máy chủ \[Mạng\]” when the server cannot be reached). 4.2. The tables stay empty; no data is changed. 4.3. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | The departments are shown. No data is changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-02; Permission Matrix 4.4. |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG13 |  |  |

### **3.2 UC-13: View Department Detail** {#3.2-uc-13:-view-department-detail}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to view the details of a department and its rooms, so that I can decide whether to update the department or work on its rooms. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in (UC-01). The Admin is on the “Chuyên khoa” tab (UC-12). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin clicks the eye icon (tooltip “Xem chi tiết”) in the “Thao tác” column of a department. The system opens the detail popup with the department name, “Mã đơn vị: {code}”, the label “Khoa chuyên môn”, “Trạng thái” (Đang hoạt động / Đang khóa), “Phân loại” (Lâm sàng / Cận lâm sàng) and “Mô tả nhiệm vụ” (“Chưa có mô tả” when empty). The system displays “Danh sách phòng chức năng trực thuộc” with “N phòng” and, for every room of the department, active or inactive: “Mã phòng”, “Tên phòng”, “Vị trí” and “Trạng thái” (Đang hoạt động / Tạm ngưng). The system displays the “Đóng” and “Chỉnh sửa” buttons. The Admin clicks “Đóng” (or X); the system closes the popup and returns to the department list (UC-12). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 5): Update the department 1.1. The Admin clicks “Chỉnh sửa”. 1.2. The system closes the popup and opens “Chỉnh sửa chuyên khoa” with the current values (UC-14). 1.3. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 3): The department has no room 1.1. The system shows “0 phòng” and “Chuyên khoa này hiện chưa có phòng chức năng nào trực thuộc.” 1.2. The use case continues at step 4\. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | The department details are shown from the data already loaded by UC-12. No data is changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | None |  |  |
| **Messages** | None |  |  |

### **3.3 UC-14: Update Department** {#3.3-uc-14:-update-department}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to update the name, description and status of a department, and lock or unlock it, so that department information stays accurate. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in (UC-01). The Admin is on the department list (UC-12) or viewing the department (UC-13). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin clicks the pencil icon (tooltip “Chỉnh sửa”) in UC-12 or the “Chỉnh sửa” button in UC-13. The system opens “Chỉnh sửa chuyên khoa” (“Cập nhật thông số chi tiết & danh mục dịch vụ cho {name}”) with the current values: “Mã khoa”\* (read-only), “Tên khoa”\*, “Phân loại chuyên khoa” (read-only, “(Cố định)”), “Trạng thái” (“Đang hoạt động” / “Đang khóa”) and “Mô tả chức năng & nhiệm vụ” with the counter “n/500”. The Admin changes “Tên khoa”, “Trạng thái” and/or the description and clicks “Lưu thay đổi”. The system checks the input (BR-68, BR-70): “Tên khoa” is required and has 2–100 characters after leading and trailing spaces are removed, and no other department has the same name, ignoring case; the description has at most 500 characters. The fields do not accept more than 100 and 500 characters. If “Trạng thái” changes from “Đang hoạt động” to “Đang khóa”, the system checks that every active room of the department can be deactivated (UC-19: no doctor or technician on duty today, no shift on a later day, no waiting or in-progress patient today, no unfinished paraclinical service) and that the department does not hold all active examination rooms of the clinic; it then deactivates all active rooms of the department. The system saves the changes, shows the toast “Đã cập nhật chuyên khoa "{name}" thành công\!”, closes the form and updates the row. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 3): The Admin cancels 1.1. The Admin clicks “Hủy” or X. 1.2. The system closes the form without a confirmation; nothing is saved. 1.3. The use case ends. AF-02 (at step 1): Lock a department from the list 2.1. The Admin clicks “Khóa chuyên khoa” on an active department. 2.2. If the department holds all active examination rooms of the clinic, the system shows the toast “Không thể tạm ngưng chuyên khoa "{name}": thao tác này sẽ ngừng hoạt động toàn bộ phòng khám lâm sàng còn lại trong cơ sở.” and the use case ends. 2.3. Otherwise the system shows the dialog “Khóa chuyên khoa”: “Chuyên khoa "{name}" đang có {n} phòng hoạt động… toàn bộ các phòng trực thuộc sẽ tự động tạm ngưng hoạt động” when it has active rooms, or “Bạn có chắc muốn tạm ngưng chuyên khoa "{name}"? Bạn sẽ không thể tạo thêm phòng mới thuộc chuyên khoa này.” when it has none, with “Hủy” and “Khóa chuyên khoa”. 2.4. After “Khóa chuyên khoa”, the system runs the checks of step 5, sets the department to “Đang khóa”, deactivates its active rooms and shows “Đã tạm ngưng chuyên khoa "{name}" và các phòng trực thuộc\!”. 2.5. “Hủy” closes the dialog without any change. The use case ends. AF-03 (at step 1): Unlock a department 3.1. The Admin clicks “Mở khóa chuyên khoa” on a locked department. 3.2. The system shows the dialog “Mở khóa chuyên khoa”: “Kích hoạt lại chuyên khoa "{name}"? Bạn sẽ có thể tạo thêm phòng mới thuộc chuyên khoa này.” 3.3. After “Kích hoạt lại”, the department becomes “Đang hoạt động” and the system shows “Đã kích hoạt lại chuyên khoa "{name}"\!”. Its rooms stay “Tạm ngưng” until each is reactivated (UC-19). 3.4. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 4): The name or the description is not valid 1.1. The system shows under the field “Vui lòng nhập tên chuyên khoa”, “Tên chuyên khoa phải từ 2 đến 100 ký tự” or “Mô tả chuyên khoa tối đa 500 ký tự”. 1.2. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-02 (at step 4): Duplicate name 2.1. The system shows “Tên chuyên khoa đã tồn tại trong hệ thống” under “Tên khoa”. 2.2. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-03 (at step 5 or AF-02): A room cannot be deactivated 3.1. The system shows the toast “Không thể tạm ngưng chuyên khoa: …” with the reason of the first room that cannot be deactivated (doctor or technician on duty today, shifts on later days, waiting or in-progress patients, unfinished paraclinical services). 3.2. The department and all its rooms keep their status; the use case returns to step 3\. EF-04 (at step 6): Another Admin has changed the department 4.1. The system refuses the update (the saved version is newer) and shows the toast “Không thể cập nhật: …”. 4.2. Nothing is saved; the form stays open. EF-05 (at step 6): Server error, network error or session ended 5.1. The system shows the toast “Không thể cập nhật: …” (“không kết nối được máy chủ \[Mạng\]” when the server cannot be reached); the form keeps the entered data. 5.2. When the session has ended, the system opens the “Đăng nhập” screen (UC-01) and nothing is saved. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the department is updated; if it was locked, all its active rooms are “Tạm ngưng”. Failure or cancelled: no change is saved. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-07, BR-68, BR-70. |  |  |
| **Messages** | None |  |  |

## **4\. Room Management** {#4.-room-management}

### **4.1 UC-15: Assign Staff to Room** {#4.1-uc-15:-assign-staff-to-room}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to assign a doctor to a clinical room or a technician to a paraclinical room, so that staff members work in the appropriate room before their shifts are scheduled.  |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in (UC-01). The Admin is on the room list (UC-16). Active Doctor or Technician accounts exist (UC-07). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin clicks “Phân phòng” (person icon) on an active clinical or paraclinical room in the room list. The system shows the dialog “Phân phòng: \<room name\>” with the room code and department, and the list “Bác sĩ”\* (clinical room) or “Kỹ thuật viên”\* (paraclinical room) of all active accounts with that role; each entry shows the full name, the username and the current room, if any. The Admin selects one staff member and clicks “Phân phòng”. The system checks that the room is active and matches the role of the staff member (Doctor – clinical room, Technician – paraclinical room). The system ends the current room assignment of the staff member, if any, and assigns them to the selected room: one room per staff member, and the department becomes the room’s department (BR-05). The system shows “Đã phân \<name\> vào phòng \<room name\>” and reloads the room list, which shows the assigned staff of the room (BR-19). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | 1\. AF-01 (at step 2): No active staff with the matching role 1.1. The system shows “Không có nhân sự đang hoạt động phù hợp với loại phòng này.” under the list. 1.2. The use case ends when the Admin closes the dialog. 2\. AF-02 (at step 3): No staff member is selected 2.1. The system shows “Vui lòng chọn nhân sự cần phân phòng”. 2.2. The use case returns to step 3\. 3\. AF-03 (at step 3): The Admin cancels 3.1. The Admin clicks “Hủy”; the dialog closes and nothing is changed. 3.2. The use case ends. 4\. AF-04 (at step 5): The staff member is already assigned to this room 4.1. The system keeps the current assignment and saves nothing. 4.2. The use case continues at step 6\. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at any step): Session expired or system error 1.1. The system shows MSG12 (session expired) or MSG80 (system error); nothing is changed. 1.2. The use case ends. 2\. EF-02 (at step 4): The room is inactive or does not match the role, or the account is an Admin account or the Admin’s own account 2.1. The system shows an error message; nothing is changed. 2.2. The use case returns to step 2\. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: The staff member is assigned to the room (and leaves their previous room) and belongs to its department. They only see and handle patients and services of their room (BR-19). A clinical room receives patients at reception only when it has a doctor scheduled for that day (BR-96, shifts in UC-86). There is no separate action to remove a staff member from a room: the assignment ends when the staff member is assigned to another room or their role changes (UC-09). Failure or cancelled: No assignment is changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-05, BR-19, BR-96 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG12, MSG80 |  |  |

### **4.2 UC-16: View Room List** {#4.2-uc-16:-view-room-list}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to view the list of rooms with their department, type, location and status, and the details of a room, so that I can manage rooms and staff assignments. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in (UC-01). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin selects “Khoa / Phòng” in the menu; the system opens “Quản lý khoa/phòng” with the “Phòng chức năng” tab selected. The system displays the rooms with “Mã phòng”, “Tên phòng”, “Chuyên khoa”, “Loại phòng” (Khám lâm sàng / Cận lâm sàng), “Vị trí”, “Trạng thái” (Đang hoạt động / Tạm ngưng) and “Thao tác”: “Phân phòng” (UC-15; disabled with the tooltip “Kích hoạt phòng trước khi phân phòng” for an inactive room), “Xem chi tiết”, “Chỉnh sửa” (UC-18) and the status button (UC-18). The list is sorted by “Mã phòng”, shows 10 rows per page and the footer “Hiển thị a–b trên tổng số N phòng chức năng”. The Admin types a keyword and/or selects “Khoa” (“Tất cả các khoa” and every department), “Loại phòng” (“Tất cả loại phòng”, “Phòng khám lâm sàng”, “Phòng cận lâm sàng”) and “Trạng thái” (“Tất cả trạng thái”, “Đang hoạt động”, “Tạm ngưng”). The system filters the list at once and returns to page 1\. The keyword is matched against “Mã phòng”, “Tên phòng”, the department name, “Vị trí” and the staff assigned to the room; case and leading or trailing spaces are ignored, Vietnamese accents are not. The keyword and the filters are combined. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 3): Reset the search and filters 1.1. The Admin clicks “Đặt lại”. 1.2. The system clears the keyword and the three filters and shows all rooms from page 1\. 1.3. The use case returns to step 3\. AF-02 (at step 2 or 4): Change page or page size 2.1. The Admin clicks “Trang trước”, “Trang sau” or a page number, or selects 5, 10, 15 or 20 rows per page. 2.2. The system shows the selected page with the current keyword and filters; a new page size returns to page 1\. 2.3. The use case returns to step 3\. AF-03 (at step 2): View the details of a room 3.1. The Admin clicks the eye icon (tooltip “Xem chi tiết”) of a room. 3.2. The system opens the popup with the room name, “Mã đơn vị: {code}”, the label “Phòng chức năng”, “Trạng thái”, “Phân loại” (Khám lâm sàng / Cận lâm sàng), “Khoa chủ quản”, “Nhóm kỹ thuật” (paraclinical room) and “Vị trí / Tầng”. 3.3. The popup shows “Bác sĩ / Kỹ thuật viên trực phòng (Hôm nay)” with the staff of “Ca Sáng (08:00 \- 11:30)” and “Ca Chiều (13:00 \- 17:30)” (“Chưa phân công trực” when nobody is scheduled), and “Danh mục dịch vụ y tế phục vụ tại phòng (N)”: the active examination services for a clinical room, or the active services of its service group for a paraclinical room, with code, name, clinic price and insurance price. 3.4. The Admin clicks “Đóng” to return to the list, or “Chỉnh sửa” to open UC-18. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 4): No room matches 1.1. The table shows “Không tìm thấy phòng khám nào phù hợp với điều kiện lọc.” and the footer “Hiển thị 0–0 trên tổng số 0 phòng chức năng”. 1.2. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-02 (at step 1): The user is not an Admin 2.1. “Khoa / Phòng” is not in the menu; opening the page address directly shows “Không có quyền truy cập”, MSG13 and “Về trang chủ”. 2.2. The use case ends. EF-03 (at step 1): The user is not signed in or the session has ended 3.1. The system opens the “Đăng nhập” screen (UC-01). 3.2. The use case ends. EF-04 (at step 1 or AF-03): Data cannot be loaded 4.1. If the list cannot be loaded, the system shows the toast “Không thể tải danh sách khoa/phòng: …” (“không kết nối được máy chủ \[Mạng\]” when the server cannot be reached) and the table stays empty. 4.2. If today’s duty schedule of the room cannot be loaded, the popup shows “Lỗi tải: …” in the shift boxes. 4.3. No data is changed; the use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | The rooms are shown. No data is changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-02; Permission Matrix 4.4. |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG13 |  |  |

### **4.3 UC-17: Create Room** {#4.3-uc-17:-create-room}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to create a clinical room or a paraclinical room in an active department, so that patients can be registered to the room or paraclinical services can be routed to it. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in (UC-01). The Admin is on the room list (UC-16). At least one active department exists. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin clicks “Thêm phòng mới”. The system shows “Thêm mới phòng chức năng” (“Khai báo buồng khám chuyên khoa hoặc phòng khám cận lâm sàng”) with “Mã phòng”\*, “Tên phòng”\*, “Chuyên khoa trực thuộc”\* (only active departments, grouped under “Khoa lâm sàng (Khám chữa bệnh)” and “Khoa cận lâm sàng (Kỹ thuật / Xét nghiệm)”), “Loại phòng”\* (“-- Chưa chọn loại phòng \--”, “Phòng khám lâm sàng”, “Phòng khám cận lâm sàng”), “Vị trí / Tầng buồng”\* and “Trạng thái” (default “Đang hoạt động”). The Admin enters “Mã phòng” (typed letters become capitals) and “Tên phòng” and selects the department. The system sets “Loại phòng” to match it: “Phòng khám lâm sàng” for a clinical department, “Phòng khám cận lâm sàng” for a paraclinical department. For a paraclinical room, the system shows “Nhóm dịch vụ kỹ thuật”\*, listing only the service groups of the selected department, and the Admin selects one. The system shows, read-only, the services the room will serve: “Dịch vụ khám bệnh tiếp nhận (N)” (active examination services) for a clinical room, or “Dịch vụ kỹ thuật phòng thực hiện (N)” (active services of the selected group) for a paraclinical room. The Admin enters “Vị trí / Tầng buồng” and clicks “Thêm phòng”. The system validates the input: all starred fields are required; “Mã phòng” has 2–20 capital letters, digits or “-” and is not used by any room, active or inactive (BR-71); “Tên phòng” has 2–100 characters and no other room has the same name, ignoring case (BR-72); “Vị trí” has 2–255 characters (BR-73); the department is active and its type matches the room type; a paraclinical room has a service group of that department and a clinical room has none (BR-74). The system saves the room, shows the toast “Đã thêm mới phòng "{name}" thành công\!”, closes the form, adds the room to the list and increases “Phòng trực thuộc” of the department. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 3): The Admin selects a room type that does not match the department 1.1. The Admin changes “Loại phòng”. 1.2. If the department is of the other type, the system clears “Chuyên khoa trực thuộc” so that a matching department is selected; changing to a clinical room also clears “Nhóm dịch vụ kỹ thuật”. 1.3. The use case returns to step 3\. AF-02 (at any step before step 7): The Admin cancels 2.1. The Admin clicks “Hủy” or X. 2.2. The system closes the form without a confirmation; nothing is saved. 2.3. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 7): A field is empty or not valid 1.1. The system shows under the field: “Vui lòng nhập mã phòng”, “Mã phòng phải từ 2 đến 20 ký tự”, “Mã phòng chỉ bao gồm chữ in hoa, chữ số hoặc gạch ngang (-)”, “Vui lòng nhập tên phòng”, “Tên phòng phải từ 2 đến 100 ký tự”, “Vui lòng chọn chuyên khoa trực thuộc”, “Vui lòng chọn loại phòng”, “Vui lòng chọn nhóm dịch vụ kỹ thuật cho phòng cận lâm sàng”, “Vui lòng nhập vị trí/buồng (ví dụ: Tòa A \- Tầng 1 \- P.102)” or “Vị trí buồng phải từ 2 đến 255 ký tự”. “Mã phòng”, “Tên phòng” and “Vị trí” do not accept more than 20, 100 and 255 characters. 1.2. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-02 (at step 7): The code or the name already exists 2.1. The system shows “Mã phòng khám đã tồn tại trong hệ thống” or “Tên phòng khám đã tồn tại trong hệ thống” under the field. 2.2. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-03 (at step 7): The server refuses the room 3.1. If the department was locked meanwhile, the room type does not match the department, or the service group is not of the department, the system shows the server reason under the field and the toast “Không thể thêm mới: …” (for example “Không thể tạo phòng trong chuyên khoa đang tạm ngưng hoạt động”). 3.2. Nothing is saved; the use case returns to step 3\. EF-04 (at step 8): Network error or session ended 4.1. The system shows the toast “Không thể thêm mới: không kết nối được máy chủ \[Mạng\]” and keeps the form; when the session has ended it opens the “Đăng nhập” screen (UC-01). 4.2. Nothing is saved. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the room is created in the department with the chosen status and, for a paraclinical room, its service group. Failure or cancelled: no room is created. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-71, BR-72, BR-73, BR-74. |  |  |
| **Messages** | None |  |  |

### **4.4 UC-18: Update Room** {#4.4-uc-18:-update-room}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to update the name, location, service group and status of a room, and deactivate or reactivate it, so that registrations, examination tickets and paraclinical order slips use the correct rooms (UC-19 is merged into this use case). |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in (UC-01). The Admin is on the room list (UC-16) or viewing a room. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin clicks the pencil icon (tooltip “Chỉnh sửa”) of a room, or “Chỉnh sửa” in the room details. The system opens “Chỉnh sửa phòng chức năng” with the current values: “Mã phòng”, “Chuyên khoa trực thuộc” and “Loại phòng” are read-only (“(Cố định)”); “Tên phòng”\*, “Vị trí / Tầng buồng”\*, “Trạng thái” and, for a paraclinical room, “Nhóm dịch vụ kỹ thuật”\* (the service groups of the room’s department) can be changed. The services served by the room are listed read-only. If the active room cannot be deactivated now, the “Tạm ngưng” option is disabled with the reason (“(Có BS trực hôm nay)”, “(Đang có bệnh nhân)” or “(Còn ca trực tương lai)”) and a note under “Trạng thái”. The Admin changes one or more fields and clicks “Lưu thay đổi”. The system validates the input: “Tên phòng” has 2–100 characters and no other room has the same name, ignoring case (BR-72); “Vị trí” has 2–255 characters (BR-73); “Mã phòng”, the department and the room type cannot change (BR-71, BR-115); a paraclinical room keeps a service group of its department. If “Trạng thái” changes from “Đang hoạt động” to “Tạm ngưng”, the system checks (BR-07) that no doctor or technician is on duty in the room today, no staff is scheduled in the room on a later day, a clinical room has no waiting or in-progress visit today, a paraclinical room has no service waiting for payment, waiting or in progress, and the room is not the only active examination room. The system saves the room, shows the toast “Đã cập nhật phòng "{name}" thành công\!”, closes the form and updates the row. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 4): The Admin cancels 1.1. The Admin clicks “Hủy” or X. 1.2. The system closes the form without a confirmation; nothing is saved. 1.3. The use case ends. AF-02 (at step 1): Deactivate a room from the list 2.1. The Admin clicks the status button (tooltip “Vô hiệu hóa / Tạm ngưng”) of an active room. 2.2. If a check of step 6 fails, the system shows the toast of EF-03 instead of a dialog and the use case ends. 2.3. Otherwise the system shows the dialog “Tạm ngưng hoạt động phòng”: “Bạn có chắc muốn tạm ngưng "{name}" ({code})?…” with “Hủy” and “Tạm ngưng”. 2.4. After “Tạm ngưng”, the server repeats the checks of step 6, sets the room to “Tạm ngưng” and the system shows “Đã tạm ngưng "{name}" thành công\!”. An inactive room is not offered for registrations (UC-40) or room assignment (UC-15). 2.5. “Hủy” closes the dialog without any change. The use case ends. AF-03 (at step 1): Reactivate a room 3.1. The Admin clicks “Kích hoạt lại” on an inactive room. 3.2. The system shows the dialog “Kích hoạt lại phòng khám”: “Kích hoạt lại "{name}" ({code}) để sẵn sàng phục vụ tiếp nhận bệnh nhân?” 3.3. After “Kích hoạt”, the room becomes “Đang hoạt động” without further checks and the system shows “Đã kích hoạt "{name}" thành công\!”. 3.4. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 5): A field is empty or not valid 1.1. The system shows under the field “Vui lòng nhập tên phòng”, “Tên phòng phải từ 2 đến 100 ký tự”, “Vui lòng nhập vị trí/buồng (ví dụ: Tòa A \- Tầng 1 \- P.102)”, “Vị trí buồng phải từ 2 đến 255 ký tự” or “Vui lòng chọn nhóm dịch vụ kỹ thuật cho phòng cận lâm sàng”. 1.2. The use case returns to step 4\. EF-02 (at step 5): Duplicate room name 2.1. The system shows “Tên phòng khám đã tồn tại trong hệ thống” under “Tên phòng”. 2.2. The use case returns to step 4\. EF-03 (at step 6 or AF-02): The room cannot be deactivated 3.1. The system shows one of: “Không được phép tạm ngừng phòng "{name}" vì phòng đang có bác sĩ trực trong ngày ({names})\!”; “Không thể tạm ngưng phòng "{name}": phòng vẫn còn bệnh nhân đang chờ hoặc đang khám dở trong ngày hôm nay.”; “… phòng vẫn còn dịch vụ cận lâm sàng đang chờ hoặc đang xử lý.”; “… phòng vẫn còn nhân viên được xếp ca trực trong các ngày tới. Vui lòng điều chỉnh lịch trực trước.”; “… đây là phòng khám duy nhất còn hoạt động nên không thể ngừng hoạt động.” 3.2. The room stays “Đang hoạt động”; the use case returns to step 4\. EF-04 (at step 7): Another Admin has changed the room 4.1. The system refuses the update (the saved version is newer) and shows the toast “Không thể cập nhật: …”. 4.2. Nothing is saved; the form stays open. EF-05 (at step 7): Network error or session ended 5.1. The system shows the toast “Không thể cập nhật: không kết nối được máy chủ \[Mạng\]” and keeps the form; when the session has ended it opens the “Đăng nhập” screen (UC-01). 5.2. Nothing is saved. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the room information or status is updated. Failure or cancelled: no change is saved. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-07, BR-71, BR-72, BR-73, BR-115. |  |  |
| **Messages** | None |  |  |

### **4.5 UC-19: Activate/Deactivate Room** {#4.5-uc-19:-activate/deactivate-room}

UC-19: Activate/Deactivate Room – Merged into UC-18 (Update Room), which already covers updating room information, including its status (Active/Inactive).

## **5\. Service & Price Management** {#5.-service-&-price-management}

### **5.1 UC-20: View Service and Price List** {#5.1-uc-20:-view-service-and-price-list}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to view the catalog of examination and paraclinical services, so that I can check and maintain the prices used for billing. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in (UC-01). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin selects “Dịch vụ” in the sidebar. The system displays a table: Mã dịch vụ, Tên dịch vụ, Loại (Khám bệnh, Xét nghiệm, Chẩn đoán hình ảnh, Thăm dò chức năng), Nhóm dịch vụ, Giá viện phí, Giá BHYT, Trạng thái.  “Giá” are shown in VND. If there is no health insurance price, Giá BHYT displays “Không áp dụng”. The list is sorted by “Mã dịch vụ” by default and is paginated.  The Admin searches by “Mã dịch vụ” or “Tên dịch vụ”, or filters by “Loại”, “Nhóm dịch vụ” and “Trạng thái”.  The system updates the list according to the search and filters.  |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 3): Clear the search and filters 1.1.The Admin clicks “Xóa bộ lọc”. 1.2.The system removes all search and filter conditions and shows the full list in the default order. 1.3.The use case returns to step 3\. AF-02 (at step 2 or 4): Change page or page size 2.1.The Admin selects another page, or selects the number of rows per page (10, 20, 50). 2.2.The system shows the selected page and keeps the current search, filters and sort order. 2.3.The use case returns to step 3\. AF-03 (at step 4): No service matches the search and filters 3.1. The system shows MSG01 in the list. 3.2. The use case returns to step 3\.  |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 1): The user is not an Admin 1.1. The system shows MSG13. 1.2. The use case ends. EF-02 (at any step): Session expired or system error 2.1. No data is changed. 2.2. If the session has expired, the system ends the session and shows the Login screen (UC-01). The use case ends. 2.3. If a system error occurs, the system shows MSG80. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | The services are shown. No data is changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-02, BR-08 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG01, MSG13, MSG80 |  |  |

### **5.2 UC-21: View Service Detail** {#5.2-uc-21:-view-service-detail}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to view the full information of a service, so that I can check it before updating its information, price or status. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in (UC-01). The Admin is on the service list (UC-20). |  |  |

For the examination service, the rooms section states that the service is shared by all examination rooms. If the service is a laboratory service (“Xét nghiệm”), the system also shows its indicators with their reference ranges (BR-132). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 2 or 3): A section has no data 1.1. A paraclinical service has no active room in its group, or the laboratory service has no attached indicator. 1.2. The system shows MSG92 in the empty section and shows the other sections normally. 1.3. The use case ends.  |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 1): The user is not an Admin 1.1. The system shows MSG13. 1.2. The use case ends. EF-02 (at step 2): The service does not exist 2.1. The selected service is no longer in the system, for example because it was opened from an old link. 2.2. The system shows MSG39. 2.3. The use case ends. EF-03 (at any step): Session expired or system error 3.1. No data is changed. 3.2. If the session has expired, the system ends the session and shows the Login screen (UC-01). The use case ends. 3.3. If a system error occurs, the system shows MSG80. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | The service details are shown. No data is changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-02, BR-132 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG13, MSG39, MSG80, MSG92 |  |  |

### **5.3 UC-22: Create Service** {#5.3-uc-22:-create-service}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to create a new paraclinical service with its prices and, for a laboratory service, its test indicators, so that doctors can order it right away. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in (UC-01). The Admin is on the service list (UC-20). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin clicks “Thêm dịch vụ”. The system shows the “Thêm dịch vụ” form. The Admin selects the service type: "Xét nghiệm", "Chẩn đoán hình ảnh" or "Thăm dò chức năng" (BR-137). The system shows "Nhóm dịch vụ" with the active groups of that type; for a laboratory service, it also shows "Chỉ số xét nghiệm" (BR-132, BR-135). The Admin selects the service group; the system fills in “Khoa thực hiện” from the group. The Admin enters the service information and prices, checks “Không thuộc BHYT” if the service is not covered by insurance, and selects the indicators and their display order for a laboratory service. The Admin clicks “Lưu”. The system checks the input and that the selected service group has at least one active room (BR-76, BR-77, BR-78, BR-117, BR-132, BR-135). The system creates the service as active and attaches the selected indicators in the set order; these indicators cannot be changed later (BR-132). The system shows MSG04 and opens the list service (UC-20). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 4 or 5): Change the service type  1.1. The Admin selects another type; the system clears the group, department and indicators, and shows or hides “Chỉ số xét nghiệm” by the new type. 1.2. The use case returns to step 4\. AF-02 (at step 5): Change the service group  2.1. The Admin selects another group; the system updates “Khoa thực hiện” from the new group.  2.2. The use case returns to step 5\. AF-03 (at step 5): Remove a selected indicator  3.1. The Admin clicks “Gỡ”; the system removes the indicator and renumbers the display order.  3.2. The use case returns to step 5\. AF-04 (at step 3, 4 or 5): Cancel  4.1. The Admin clicks “Hủy”; if any field has been entered, the system shows MSG38.  4.2. If the Admin selects “Tiếp tục chỉnh sửa”, the use case returns to the step where the Admin was.  4.3. If the Admin confirms, nothing is created, the system returns to the service list and the use case ends. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 1): The user is not an Admin 1.1. The system shows MSG13. 1.2. The use case ends. EF-02 (at step 7): A required field is empty, an input is too long or too short, or a laboratory service has no indicator 2.1. The system shows MSG02 or MSG05, MSG08. 2.2. The use case returns to step 5\. EF-03 (at step 7): The service code or name already exists 3.1. The system shows MSG07. 3.2. The use case returns to step 5\. EF-04 (at step 7): Invalid price 4.1. The system shows MSG32. 4.2. The use case returns to step 5\. EF-05 (at step 7): The service group has no active room 5.1. The system shows MSG73. 5.2. The use case returns to step 4\.  EF-06 (at any step): Session expired or system error 6.1. Nothing is created. 6.2. If the session has expired, the system ends the session and shows the Login screen (UC-01). The use case ends. 6.3. If a system error occurs, the system shows MSG80. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the new paraclinical service exists, is active and appears in the order list (BR-10, BR-117). A laboratory service has its indicators, which cannot be changed. Failure or cancel: no service is created. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-02, BR-08, BR-10, BR-46, BR-76, BR-77, BR-78, BR-132, BR-135, BR-137 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG02, MSG04, MSG05, MSG07, MSG08, MSG13, MSG32, MSG38, MSG73, MSG80 |  |  |

### **5.5 UC-24: Update Price** {#5.5-uc-24:-update-price}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to update the clinic price or the insurance price of a service, so that new orders and receipts use the current prices while existing ones keep the prices at the time they were created (BR-09). |  |  |

The system shows MSG06 with the old and new prices and a note that the new prices apply only to orders and receipts created from now on (BR-09). The Admin confirms. The system saves the prices. The system closes the popup, shows MSG03 and reloads the service detail (UC-21). |  |  |

"Lưu" stays disabled until a price or the "Không thuộc BHYT" checkbox is changed. 2.2. The use case ends. AF-03 (at step 7): The Admin does not confirm 3.1. The prices are not changed. 3.2. The use case returns to step 3\. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 5): A price is empty or invalid 1.1. The system shows MSG02 or MSG32. 1.2. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-02 (at any step): Session expired or system error 2.1. The prices are not changed. 2.2. If the session has expired, the system ends the session and shows the Login screen (UC-01). The use case ends. 2.3. If a system error occurs, the system shows MSG80. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: new orders and receipts use the new prices; existing orders and receipts keep their stored prices (BR-09). A service marked “Không thuộc BHYT” is charged at the clinic price in new receipts (BR-27). Failure / Cancelled: the prices are not changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-08, BR-09, BR-27, BR-78 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG02, MSG03, MSG06, MSG32, MSG38, MSG80 |  |  |

### **5.6 UC-25: Activate/Deactivate Service** {#5.6-uc-25:-activate/deactivate-service}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to deactivate a paraclinical service that the hospital no longer provides, or activate it again, so that it is hidden from or shown again in the order list. Doctors can only order active services (BR-10). |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in (UC-01). The Admin is viewing the service detail (UC-21). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin clicks “Ngừng hoạt động” on an active service. The system checks that the service is not the examination service (BR-116, BR-137). The system checks that the service has no unfinished orders, that is, orders that have no result, are not cancelled and are not abandoned (BR-10). The system shows MSG06. The Admin confirms. The system sets the service to inactive. The system shows MSG03 and reloads the service detail (UC-21). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 1): Activate an inactive service 1.1. The Admin clicks “Kích hoạt”. 1.2. The system checks that the service group has at least one active room (BR-117). 1.3. The system shows MSG06. 1.4. The Admin confirms. 1.5. The system sets the service to active; the service appears in the order list at its current prices. 1.6. The system shows MSG03 and reloads the service detail (UC-21). 1.7. The use case ends. AF-02 (at step 5 or 1.4): The Admin cancels 2.1. The system closes MSG06; the status is not changed. 2.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 2): The service is the examination service 1.1. The system shows MSG52; the service is not deactivated. 1.2. The use case ends. EF-02 (at step 3): The service has unfinished orders 2.1. The system shows MSG55; the service is not deactivated. 2.2. The use case ends. EF-03 (at step 1.2): The service group has no active room 3.1. The system shows MSG73; the service is not activated. 3.2. The use case ends. EF-04 (at any step): Session expired or system error 4.1. The status is not changed. 4.2. If the session has expired, the system ends the session and shows the Login screen (UC-01). The use case ends. 4.3. If a system error occurs, the system shows MSG80. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Deactivate: the service is inactive and hidden from the order list; existing orders, receipts and results that use it are not changed. Activate: the service is active and can be ordered again at its current prices. Failure or cancel: the status is not changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-09, BR-10, BR-116, BR-117, BR-137 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG03, MSG06, MSG52, MSG55, MSG73, MSG80 |  |  |

### **5.6 UC-93: View Laboratory Indicators**

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to view the laboratory indicators with their units and reference ranges, so that I can check the data the system uses to flag abnormal results (BR-133). |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in (UC-01). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin selects "Chỉ số xét nghiệm" in the menu. The system shows "Danh sách chỉ số" with the number of indicators, sorted by "Mã chỉ số". Each row shows Mã chỉ số, Tên chỉ số (marked "Ngừng hoạt động" when the indicator is inactive), Kiểu kết quả, Đơn vị ("—" when empty) and "Chỉ số tham chiếu đang áp dụng": every reference range in force today, one per line, as "Giới tính, tuổi từ–đến: giá trị", or "Chưa cấu hình" when no range is in force (BR-133, BR-136). The Admin enters a code or a name in "Tìm theo mã hoặc tên chỉ số". The system filters the list as the Admin types; "×" clears the search. The Admin clicks a row. The system expands the row and shows a table of the ranges in force today, with Áp dụng cho ("Mọi giới tính, độ tuổi" when there is no condition), Giá trị with the unit, Hiệu lực ("Từ dd/MM/yyyy" or "dd/MM/yyyy – dd/MM/yyyy") and Nguồn. The Admin clicks the row again to collapse it. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 2 or 3): No indicator to show 1.1. If the catalog has no indicator, the system shows MSG92. If no indicator matches the search, the system shows MSG01. 1.2. The use case returns to step 3\. AF-02 (at step 5): The indicator has no range in force 2.1. The system shows "Chỉ số này chưa có khoảng tham chiếu đang áp dụng." in the expanded row. 2.2. The use case continues at step 6\. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 1): The user is not an Admin 1.1. The system shows MSG13 (BR-02). 1.2. The use case ends. EF-02 (at any step): Session expired or system error 2.1. If the session has expired, the system ends the session and shows the Login screen (UC-01). The use case ends. 2.2. If a system error occurs, the system shows MSG80. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Viewing changes no data. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-02, BR-133, BR-136 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG01, MSG13, MSG80, MSG92 |  |  |

## **6\. Statistics & Reporting** {#6.-statistics-&-reporting}

### **6.1 UC-26: View Statistic Report**

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to see an overview dashboard of the clinic’s activity in a selected period, so that I can follow the main figures. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in (UC-01). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin opens “Tổng quan” (home screen after sign-in). The system shows the period filter with the quick choices “Hôm nay”, “7 ngày qua”, “Tháng này” (default) and “Năm nay”, and the fields “Từ ngày” and “Đến ngày”. The system shows the figures of the period: visits (with the number of completed visits), distinct patients, paraclinical services performed and revenue collected (Paid receipts only – BR-37, BR-38). The system shows the charts: visits per day (by the day the visit joined the waiting list), visit outcomes, revenue split into the insurance amount and the patient amount, visits by patient type (insurance / self-paid) and the 5 examination rooms with the most visits; and a table of the 5 most common main diagnoses (ICD-10) by conclusion date. A chart without data shows “Chưa có dữ liệu trong khoảng thời gian này.” The Admin chooses another period or clicks “Làm mới”. The system validates the period (at most 366 days) and recalculates the figures and charts. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | None |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 5): Invalid period 1.1. The system shows MSG50 if “Từ ngày” is later than “Đến ngày”, or MSG51 if the period is longer than 366 days. 1.2. The use case returns to step 5\. EF-02 (at step 1): The user is not an Admin 2.1. The system shows MSG13. 2.2. The use case ends. EF-03 (at any step): Session expired or system error 3.1. The system shows “Phiên đăng nhập đã hết hạn. Vui lòng đăng nhập lại.” (the session has ended), “Không kết nối được máy chủ. Vui lòng kiểm tra mạng và thử lại.” (MSG96) or MSG80; a period refused by the server shows “Khoảng thời gian không hợp lệ. Vui lòng chọn lại.” 3.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | The dashboard is shown. No data is changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-37, BR-38; Permission Matrix 4.4 (Statistics report – View) |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG12, MSG13, MSG50, MSG51, MSG80, MSG96 |  |  |

### **6.2 UC-27: View Patient Visit Statistics** {#6.2-uc-27:-view-patient-visit-statistics}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |

The system recalculates the figures, charts and table. 1.3. The use case returns to step 3\. AF-02 (at step 5): Change page 2.1. The Admin selects another page of the detail table. 2.2. The system shows that page and keeps the period and grouping. 2.3. The use case returns to step 5\. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 2): Invalid period 1.1. The system shows MSG50 if “Từ ngày” is later than “Đến ngày”, or MSG51 if the period is longer than 366 days. 1.2. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-02 (at step 5): No data 2.1. The system shows “Chưa có dữ liệu trong khoảng thời gian này.” 2.2. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-03 (at step 1): The user is not an Admin 3.1. The system shows MSG13. 3.2. The use case ends. EF-04 (at any step): Session expired or system error 4.1. The system shows “Phiên đăng nhập đã hết hạn. Vui lòng đăng nhập lại.” (the session has ended), “Không kết nối được máy chủ. Vui lòng kiểm tra mạng và thử lại.” (MSG96) or MSG80; a period refused by the server shows “Khoảng thời gian không hợp lệ. Vui lòng chọn lại.” 4.2. The use case ends. |  |  |

| **Business Rules** | BR-11, BR-14, BR-22, BR-24, BR-40 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG12, MSG13, MSG50, MSG51, MSG80, MSG96 |  |  |

| **Messages** | MSG12, MSG13, MSG50, MSG51, MSG80, MSG96 |  |  |

### **6.8 UC-33: Export Report** {#6.8-uc-33:-export-report}

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to export statistics reports to an Excel file, or print or save the report I am viewing as PDF, so that I can store it or send it to the clinic management. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is viewing a statistics report screen (UC-27 to UC-32). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin clicks “Xuất Excel” on a report screen. The system shows the dialog “Xuất báo cáo Excel” with the period of the screen (“Từ … đến …, theo bộ lọc của trang”), the reports to include (Lượt khám, Bác sĩ, Khoa / Phòng, Cận lâm sàng, Doanh thu, Bệnh thường gặp), all ticked by default with “Bỏ chọn tất cả” / “Chọn tất cả”, and “Lượt khám và doanh thu” grouped “Theo ngày” or “Theo tháng” (the grouping of the screen). The Admin keeps or changes the reports and the grouping and clicks “Tải Excel”. The system checks the period (at most 366 days, “Từ ngày” not after “Đến ngày”), creates one .xlsx file with one sheet per selected report, downloads it, closes the dialog and records the export in the audit log (format, period and reports). The diagnosis sheet uses the number of diagnoses chosen on its screen. For PDF, the Admin clicks “In / Lưu PDF”; the browser print dialog opens with the report formatted for printing, and the Admin prints it or saves it as PDF. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 3): The Admin cancels 1.1. The Admin clicks “Hủy” or closes the dialog. 1.2. No file is created; the use case ends. AF-02 (at step 3): No report is selected 2.1. The system shows “Chọn ít nhất một báo cáo.” and “Tải Excel” is disabled. 2.2. The use case returns to step 3\. |  |  |
