| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 4): The period or the selection is not valid 1.1. The system shows “Khoảng thời gian hoặc lựa chọn không hợp lệ. Vui lòng kiểm tra lại.” in the dialog. 1.2. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-02 (at step 4): The file cannot be created 2.1. The system shows “Không tạo được tệp. Vui lòng thử lại.”, or “Không kết nối được máy chủ. Vui lòng kiểm tra mạng và thử lại.” when the server cannot be reached; the dialog stays open. 2.2. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-03 (at step 1 or 4): Not an Admin or session expired 3.1. The system shows “Bạn không có quyền xuất báo cáo.” or “Phiên đăng nhập đã hết hạn. Vui lòng đăng nhập lại.” 3.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | The file is downloaded and the export is logged. No data in the system is changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-38; Permission Matrix 4.4 (Statistics report – Export: Admin only) |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG12, MSG13, MSG96 |  |  |

### **6.9 UC-34: View Examined Patient List** {#6.9-uc-34:-view-examined-patient-list}

| Primary Actors | Doctor | Secondary Actors | None |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Doctor, I want to see the list of patients I have examined in a period, so that I can review my work and quickly open a patient's medical record. The list only shows patients examined by me; it does not restrict my access to medical records (BR-39, BR-35). |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Doctor is signed in (UC-01). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Doctor selects “Bệnh nhân đã khám” in the menu. The system shows the period filter (default: this month; quick choices “Hôm nay”, “7 ngày qua”, “Tháng này”, “Năm nay”, or “Từ ngày” and “Đến ngày”) and validates the period (at most 366 days). The system shows the number of visits examined and of distinct patients in the period. The system shows only the visits examined by this Doctor (the Doctor comes from the signed-in account – BR-39): visit date, patient name and code, gender and age, patient type, diagnosis and status, newest first, with paging. The Doctor clicks a row; the system opens the examination screen of that visit. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 2): Change the period 1.1. The Doctor selects another period. 1.2. The system reloads the figures and the list. 1.3. The use case returns to step 3\. AF-02 (at step 4): Search a patient 2.1. The Doctor types a full name or patient code. 2.2. The system shows the matching visits. 2.3. The use case returns to step 4\. AF-03 (at step 4): Change page 3.1. The Doctor selects another page. 3.2. The system shows that page and keeps the period and the keyword. 3.3. The use case returns to step 4\. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 2): Invalid period 1.1. The system shows MSG50 if “Từ ngày” is later than “Đến ngày”, or MSG51 if the period is longer than 366 days. 1.2. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-02 (at step 4): No examination in the period 2.1. The system shows “Bạn chưa khám bệnh nhân nào trong khoảng thời gian này.”, or “Không tìm thấy bệnh nhân phù hợp.” when a keyword is entered. 2.2. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-03 (at step 1): The user is not a Doctor 3.1. The system shows MSG13 (the page is for Doctors only; the server answers “Chỉ bác sĩ mới xem được danh sách bệnh nhân đã khám.”). 3.2. The use case ends. EF-04 (at any step): Session expired or system error 4.1. The system shows “Phiên đăng nhập đã hết hạn. Vui lòng đăng nhập lại.”, “Không kết nối được máy chủ. Vui lòng kiểm tra mạng và thử lại.” (MSG96) or “Đã xảy ra lỗi. Vui lòng thử lại.”; a period refused by the server shows “Khoảng thời gian không hợp lệ. Vui lòng chọn lại.” 4.2. The use case ends |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | The Doctor's examined patients are shown. No data is changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-35, BR-39; Permission Matrix 4.4 (Statistics report – View, Restricted ⁵) |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG12, MSG13, MSG50, MSG51, MSG80, MSG96 |  |  |

## **7\. Patient Profile Management** {#7.-patient-profile-management}

### **7.1 UC-35: Search Patient** {#7.1-uc-35:-search-patient}

| Primary Actors | Receptionist | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Receptionist, I want to search for a patient by citizen ID (first), passport, patient code, phone, name or health insurance card number, so that a returning patient is reused instead of getting a duplicate profile. First-time and returning patients follow the same process; the only difference is whether a new profile is created (BR-12). |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | 1\. 	The Receptionist is signed in (UC-01). 2\. 	The patient (or guardian) is at the reception counter, or is a priority patient brought directly to the Receptionist (BR-14). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | 1\. 	The Receptionist opens "Quản lý & Tiếp đón bệnh nhân". 2\. 	The system shows the search form: "Tìm theo" (CCCD selected by default; Hộ chiếu, Mã bệnh nhân, Số điện thoại, Họ tên, Số thẻ BHYT) and "Từ khóa". Below the form the system shows "Danh sách bệnh nhân" with up to 50 patient profiles (no search applied), and the buttons "Làm mới" and "Tạo hồ sơ bệnh nhân mới". 3\. 	The Receptionist selects the search type, enters the keyword and clicks "Tìm kiếm". 4\. 	The system removes leading and trailing spaces and validates the keyword by type: CCCD exactly 12 digits; Hộ chiếu 1 to 15 letters or digits; Số điện thoại exactly 10 digits; Họ tên 2 to 100 characters; Số thẻ BHYT exactly 15 letters or digits; Mã bệnh nhân not empty. The server repeats the check. 5\. 	The system searches the patient profiles. CCCD, passport, patient code, phone and insurance card number must match exactly (passport, patient code and card number ignore case); the insurance card number is searched among the cards used in the patient's previous visits. Name search matches part of the name and ignores case and Vietnamese accents. 6\. 	The system shows "Kết quả tìm kiếm" with at most 50 results: Mã BN, Họ và tên, Ngày sinh, Giới tính, CCCD / Hộ chiếu, Số điện thoại, Lần khám gần nhất, Lượt khám đang mở (status, registration code, room) and Thao tác ("Đăng ký khám", "Xem hồ sơ", "Chỉnh sửa hồ sơ"). The button "Xóa tìm kiếm" appears next to "Tìm kiếm". 7\. 	The Receptionist clicks "Xem hồ sơ" on a patient. 8\. 	The system opens View Patient Information (UC-36). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | 1\.      AF-01 (at step 3): The patient has no citizen ID (e.g. a child or a foreigner) or does not bring it 1.1. The Receptionist selects another search type (Hộ chiếu, Số điện thoại, Họ tên, Mã bệnh nhân or Số thẻ BHYT) and enters the keyword. 1.2. Continue at step 4 of the Normal Flow.   2\.      AF-02 (at step 6): Several patients match (e.g. same name or same phone) 2.1. The system lists all of them; the Receptionist confirms with the date of birth, phone or identification number shown in the list. 2.2. Continue at step 7 of the Normal Flow.   3\.      AF-03 (at step 6): Exactly one patient matches a search by CCCD, Hộ chiếu or Mã bệnh nhân 3.1. The system shows only that patient in "Kết quả tìm kiếm" ("Có 1 bệnh nhân"); the profile is not opened automatically. 3.2. Continue at step 7 of the Normal Flow.    4\.      AF-04 (at step 6): More than 50 patients match 4.1. The system shows the first 50 patients and MSG100 ("Có hơn 50 bệnh nhân phù hợp, hệ thống chỉ hiển thị 50 kết quả đầu. Vui lòng nhập từ khóa cụ thể hơn.").  4.2. Return to step 3 of the Normal Flow. 5\.      AF-05 (at step 6): The Receptionist clears the search 5.1. The Receptionist clicks "Xóa tìm kiếm". 5.2. The system clears the keyword and shows "Danh sách bệnh nhân" again (up to 50 profiles). 5.3. Return to step 3 of the Normal Flow.   6\.      AF-06 (at step 6): The Receptionist uses another action of the result row 6.1. "Đăng ký khám" opens Register Examination (UC-40) for that patient. 6.2. "Chỉnh sửa hồ sơ" opens Update Patient Information (UC-38) for that patient. 6.3. The use case ends.   7\.      AF-07 (at step 2 or 6): The Receptionist clicks "Làm mới" 7.1. The system repeats the last search (or reloads the unfiltered list). 7.2. Continue at step 6 of the Normal Flow. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | 1\.      EF-01 (at step 4): Empty keyword or wrong format 1.1. The system shows MSG02 ("Từ khóa là bắt buộc.") or MSG05 ("Từ khóa không đúng định dạng.") under "Từ khóa" and does not search.  1.2. Return to step 3 of the Normal Flow.   2\.      EF-02 (at step 6): No patient matches 2.1. The system shows MSG01 ("Không tìm thấy kết quả.") and the button "Tạo hồ sơ bệnh nhân mới", which opens UC-37. The keyword is pre-filled in the form when the search type was CCCD, Hộ chiếu, Số điện thoại or Họ tên; nothing is pre-filled for Mã bệnh nhân and Số thẻ BHYT. 2.2. The use case ends.   3\.      EF-03 (at step 1): The user is not allowed to search patients 3.1. The system shows MSG13. 3.2. The use case ends.   4\.      EF-04 (at step 5): Session expired or system error 4.1. The system shows MSG12 or MSG80 above the list; the list is not changed. 4.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | The patient is identified, or the Receptionist continues with UC-37. No data is changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-12, BR-14, BR-17, BR-83, BR-91, BR-110; Permission Matrix 4.4 (Patient profile – Search) |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG01, MSG02, MSG05, MSG12, MSG13, MSG80, MSG100 |  |  |

### **7.2 UC-36: View Patient Information** {#7.2-uc-36:-view-patient-information}

| Primary Actors | Receptionist | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Receptionist, I want to view a patient's administrative information and visit history, so that I can confirm the patient's identity, update the profile and register a new visit. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Receptionist is signed in and has found the patient (UC-35) or has just created the profile (UC-37). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | 1\.      The Receptionist clicks "Xem hồ sơ" in the search results (UC-35), or the system opens the profile directly ( UC-37 step 9, UC-38 step 8). 2\.      The system shows "Thông tin hành chính": Mã bệnh nhân, Họ và tên, Ngày sinh (age), Giới tính, CCCD / Hộ chiếu (the citizen ID, or the passport when there is no citizen ID), Số điện thoại, Địa chỉ (address, ward, province), Nghề nghiệp, Dân tộc, Quốc tịch ("Việt Nam" when no foreign nationality is recorded), Thẻ BHYT gần nhất (card of the latest visit that used one), Người giám hộ (name, relationship, phone). Empty values are shown as "—". When the patient has drug allergies, they are shown read-only in a red label "Dị ứng thuốc: …" (they are recorded by the Doctor – BR-23). 3\.      The system shows "Lịch sử khám", newest first: Mã lượt khám, Thời gian, Phòng, Bác sĩ, Đối tượng, Trạng thái. Clinical details (findings, results, diagnosis, prescription) are not shown (BR-120). 4\.      The system records the view in the audit log (BR-42). 5\.      The system shows the actions "Cập nhật thông tin" (UC-38) and "Đăng ký khám" (UC-40), and "Tải lại" on the visit history. 6\.      The Receptionist selects an action. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | 1\.      AF-01 (at step 3): No previous visit 1.1. The system shows "Chưa có lịch sử khám." 1.2. Continue at step 4 of the Normal Flow.   2\.      AF-02 (at step 3): The patient has an active visit (not Completed, Cancelled or Abandoned) 2.1. The system shows the box "Lượt khám đang mở" with the registration code, status, room and examination fee status ("Chờ thanh toán", "Đã thanh toán", "Miễn phí", "Đã hủy", or "Chưa có phiếu thu"), disables "Đăng ký khám" (BR-17, tooltip "Bệnh nhân đang có lượt khám chưa kết thúc") and shows the action "In lại phiếu khám". 2.2. If the Receptionist clicks "In lại phiếu khám", the system shows the ticket on the same screen (UC-41 AF-02) and returns to the patient information when the Receptionist finishes. 2.3. Continue at step 4 of the Normal Flow.   3\.      AF-03 (at step 3): The patient has a follow-up appointment today 3.1. The system shows "Có lịch tái khám hôm nay" with the date, the doctor and the suggested room (when recorded), so that the Receptionist registers the follow-up visit. A failure to load the appointment does not block the screen. 3.2. Continue at step 4 of the Normal Flow.   4\.      AF-04 (at step 5): The Receptionist clicks "Tải lại" 4.1. The system loads the patient information and visit history again (the view is recorded again). 4.2. Continue at step 2 of the Normal Flow. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | 1\.      EF-01 (at step 2): The patient does not exist 1.1. The system shows MSG39 ("Không tìm thấy hồ sơ bệnh nhân.") and the button "Về danh sách bệnh nhân".  1.2. The use case ends.   2\.      EF-02 (at step 1): The user is not allowed to view patient profiles 2.1. The system shows MSG13 and the button "Về danh sách bệnh nhân". 2.2. The use case ends.   3\.      EF-03 (at step 2): Session expired or system error 3.1. The system shows MSG12 or MSG80 and the button "Về danh sách bệnh nhân". 3.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | The patient information is shown. No patient data is changed; the view is recorded in the audit log (BR-42). Clinical details are only shown to the Doctor (UC-52). |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-12, BR-17, BR-23, BR-42, BR-120; Permission Matrix 4.4 (Patient profile – View administrative information) |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG12, MSG13, MSG39, MSG80 |  |  |

 

### **7.3 UC-37: Create New Patient Profile**

| Primary Actors | Receptionist | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Receptionist, I want to create a profile for a first-time patient, so that all their visits are linked to one record. A citizen ID is required from 14 years old; a foreigner without a citizen ID uses a passport instead. A patient under 14 years old may have neither. Each number maps to exactly one profile, so the system blocks duplicates by these numbers (BR-12). A profile of a patient under 14 years old can be created without an identification number and completed later (UC-38). The Receptionist only enters administrative information; medical history and allergies are recorded by the Doctor (BR-23).  |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | 1\.      The Receptionist is signed in. 2\.      The Receptionist is on "Quản lý & Tiếp đón bệnh nhân" (UC-35). Normally Search Patient found no profile for the patient; the system does not enforce this. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Receptionist clicks "Tạo hồ sơ bệnh nhân mới" (in the page header, or under MSG01 after an unsuccessful search). The system shows the form "Tạo hồ sơ bệnh nhân mới" in three groups. When it was opened from an unsuccessful search, the keyword is pre-filled (CCCD, Số hộ chiếu, Số điện thoại or Họ và tên). Codes (Mã dân tộc, Mã nghề nghiệp, Mã ngoại kiều, Mã xã/phường, Mã tỉnh/thành) are filled automatically from the selected values and are not typed by the Receptionist.a. Thông tin cá nhân: Họ và tên\*, Ngày sinh\*, Giới tính\* (Nam – default, Nữ, Chưa xác định), CCCD (required from 14 years old unless Số hộ chiếu is entered), Số hộ chiếu, Số điện thoại (required from 18 years old), Email (optional; used for follow-up reminders, UC-75), Dân tộc\* (default Kinh, code 01), Nhóm máu, Yếu tố Rh.b. Thông tin hành chính: Nghề nghiệp\*, Nơi làm việc, Ngoại kiều (required when Nghề nghiệp is "Ngoại kiều"; empty means Vietnamese), Tỉnh/thành phố and Xã/phường (both required unless Nghề nghiệp is "Ngoại kiều"; the wards are those of the selected province), Địa chỉ\* (for a foreigner: the place of stay in Viet Nam or the address abroad).c. Thông tin người thân: Họ tên người thân, Quan hệ and Số điện thoại người thân (all three required under 18 years old; Quan hệ is selected from a list), Địa chỉ người thân. The Receptionist enters the data from the patient's documents and clicks "Lưu hồ sơ". The system checks the required fields, which depend on the age calculated from the date of birth and on the occupation. The required marks of CCCD, Số điện thoại, Họ tên người thân, Quan hệ and Số điện thoại người thân change as soon as the date of birth is entered; the marks of Tỉnh/thành phố and Xã/phường are removed when Nghề nghiệp is "Ngoại kiều". The system checks the formats and lengths (BR-82 to BR-92): CCCD exactly 12 digits; passport 1 to 15 letters or digits; phone and relative's phone exactly 10 digits; email a valid email address of at most 100 characters; date of birth not in the future and not more than 120 years ago; full name at most 100 characters; address, workplace and relative's address at most 1,024 characters each; relative's name at most 255; relationship at most 50\. Dân tộc, Nghề nghiệp, Ngoại kiều, Tỉnh/thành phố and Xã/phường are selected from their catalogues (BR-46). Leading and trailing spaces are removed. The server repeats steps 4 and 5\. The system checks for possible duplicates: profiles with the same full name (ignoring case) and date of birth. The system checks that no profile has the same citizen ID or passport (BR-12; the passport ignores case). The system creates the profile with a unique patient code (BR-53) and records the creation in the audit log (BR-42). The system shows MSG04 ("Tạo thành công hồ sơ bệnh nhân.") and opens View Patient Information (UC-36), from which the Receptionist continues with Register Examination (UC-40). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 6): Possible duplicate found1.1. The system shows the dialog "Có thể trùng hồ sơ" with MSG101 ("Đã có N hồ sơ trùng họ tên và ngày sinh. Vui lòng kiểm tra trước khi tạo hồ sơ mới.") and up to 10 matching profiles (patient code, full name, phone).1.2. If the Receptionist clicks "Chọn hồ sơ này" on one of them, no profile is created, and UC-36 opens for that patient.1.3. If the Receptionist clicks "Vẫn tạo hồ sơ mới", the flow continues at step 7 of the Normal Flow.1.4. If the Receptionist clicks "Quay lại chỉnh sửa", the dialog closes and the form keeps the entered data. The flow returns to step 3 of the Normal Flow. AF-02 (at step 3): The Receptionist clicks "Hủy" or "Quay lại"2.1. If any field was changed (pre-filled values do not count), the system shows the dialog "Hủy tạo hồ sơ" with MSG38; "Loại bỏ" discards the data and returns to the patient list, "Tiếp tục chỉnh sửa" returns to the form. If nothing was changed, the system returns to the patient list without asking.2.2. No profile is created.2.3. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at steps 4–5): Required field empty, wrong format or too long1.1. The system shows MSG02 ("{field\_name} là bắt buộc."), MSG05 ("{field\_name} không đúng định dạng.") or MSG08 ("Vượt quá độ dài tối đa {max\_length} ký tự.") under each wrong field, and "Vui lòng kiểm tra lại các trường được đánh dấu." above the buttons.1.2. Return to step 3 of the Normal Flow. EF-02 (at step 7): The citizen ID or passport already exists2.1. The system shows MSG19 ("Đã có bệnh nhân với số định danh này ({patient\_code} – {full\_name}).") under the field and above the buttons, with the button "Mở hồ sơ", which opens UC-36 of that patient. No profile is created. The message disappears when the Receptionist changes the CCCD or passport.2.2. Return to step 3 of the Normal Flow. If the Receptionist opens the existing profile, the use case ends. EF-03 (at step 8): Session expired or system error3.1. The system shows MSG12 or MSG80; no profile is created and the form keeps the entered data.3.2. The use case ends. EF-04 (at step 2): The administrative unit catalogue cannot be loaded4.1. The system shows "Không tải được danh mục đơn vị hành chính. Vẫn có thể nhập tay tỉnh/thành phố và xã/phường." The Receptionist types the names; their codes stay empty.4.2. Continue at step 3 of the Normal Flow. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: a new profile exists with a unique patient code and a unique citizen ID or passport (optional only under 14 years old); its creation is in the audit log. A profile without an identification number (patient under 14 years old) can be completed later in UC-38. Failure / Cancelled: no profile is created.  |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-12, BR-23, BR-42, BR-46, BR-53, BR-82, BR-83, BR-84, BR-85, BR-86, BR-87, BR-88, BR-89, BR-90, BR-91, BR-92 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG01, MSG02, MSG04, MSG05, MSG08, MSG12, MSG19, MSG38, MSG80, MSG101 |  |  |

 

### **7.4 UC-38: Update Patient Information**

| Primary Actors | Receptionist | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Receptionist, I want to update a patient's administrative information when it changes (phone, address, relative, …), so that the profile stays correct for later visits. The Receptionist cannot change medical history or allergies (BR-23). The Receptionist can also add a missing citizen ID or passport (BR-12). |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Receptionist is signed in and is viewing the patient in UC-36, or sees the patient in the list of UC-35. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | 1\.      The Receptionist clicks "Cập nhật thông tin" in UC-36, or "Chỉnh sửa hồ sơ" on a row of UC-35. 2\.      The system shows "Cập nhật thông tin bệnh nhân": the form of UC-37 with the current data and the note "Chỉ cập nhật thông tin hành chính. Tiền sử và dị ứng do bác sĩ cập nhật khi khám."; Mã bệnh nhân is read-only and medical history and allergies are not in the form (BR-23). 3\.      The Receptionist changes the data and clicks "Lưu thay đổi". 4\.      The system checks the required fields, formats and lengths (as in UC-37, steps 4–5). 5\.      The system checks that the profile was not changed by another user since it was opened (BR-119). 6\.      If a citizen ID or passport is entered, the system checks that it is not used by another patient (BR-12). 7\.      The system saves the changes and records them in the audit log (patient code and each changed field with its old and new value, Receptionist, time – BR-42). 8\.      The system shows MSG03 (“Hồ sơ bệnh nhân cập nhật thành công." ) and opens UC-36 with the new data. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | 1\.      AF-01 (at step 3): The Receptionist clicks "Hủy" or "Quay lại" 1.1. If something was changed, the system shows the dialog "Hủy cập nhật hồ sơ" with MSG38; "Loại bỏ" returns to UC-36 and nothing is saved, "Tiếp tục chỉnh sửa" returns to the form. If nothing was changed, the system returns to UC-36 without asking. 1.2. The use case ends.   2\.      AF-02 (at step 3): The Receptionist clicks "Lưu thay đổi" without changing any value 2.1. The system returns to UC-36 without saving and without an audit entry. 2.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | 1\.      EF-01 (at step 4): Required field empty, wrong format or too long 1.1. The system shows MSG02, MSG05 or MSG08 under each wrong field, and "Vui lòng kiểm tra lại các trường được đánh dấu." above the buttons. 1.2. Return to step 3 of the Normal Flow.   2\.      EF-02 (at step 6): The citizen ID or passport belongs to another patient 2.1.The system shows MSG19 ("Đã có bệnh nhân với số định danh này ({patient\_code} – {full\_name}).") and the button "Mở hồ sơ"; nothing is saved.  2.2. Return to step 3 of the Normal Flow.   3\.      EF-03 (at step 5): The profile was changed by another user after it was opened 3.1. The system shows MSG75 ("Hồ sơ bệnh nhân vừa được cập nhật. Vui lòng tải lại và thử lại."); nothing is saved.  3.2. The use case ends.   4\.      EF-04 (at step 2): The patient does not exist 4.1. The system shows MSG39 instead of the form. 4.2. The use case ends.   5\.      EF-05 (at step 2 or 7): Session expired or system error 5.1. The system shows MSG12 or MSG80; nothing is saved. 5.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the profile holds the new administrative data; each changed field is in the audit log with its old and new value. Visits already created keep the insurance data recorded at registration. Failure / Cancelled: nothing is changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-12, BR-23, BR-42, BR-46, BR-82 to BR-92, BR-119 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG02, MSG03, MSG05, MSG08, MSG12, MSG19, MSG38, MSG39, MSG75, MSG80 |  |  |

 

### **7.5 UC-39: Update Medical History and Allergies**

| Primary Actors | Doctor | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Doctor, I want to update the patient's medical history (own history and family history) during the examination, so that it is kept in the patient profile and seen in later visits (BR-23). Drug allergies are not edited on this screen; the stored allergies are kept and shown on the prescription panel (UC-59). |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Doctor is signed in and is examining the patient: the visit is In Examination or Waiting for Conclusion, in the room the Doctor is assigned to, and its medical record is not closed (UC-47). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | 1\.      On the clinical examination screen, the system shows the panel "2. Tiền sử bệnh". 2\.      The system shows the stored history, read-only: "+ Bản thân" and "+ Gia đình", each as its entries separated by ";" ("Chưa ghi nhận" when empty), and "Cập nhật lần cuối" (time, Doctor) when data exists. 3\.      The Doctor clicks "Cập nhật". 4\.      The system shows two text areas, "+ Bản thân" and "+ Gia đình", filled with the current entries, one entry per line. 5\.      The Doctor adds, changes or removes lines and clicks "Lưu". 6\.      The system checks the data: empty lines are ignored; each line has at most 255 characters and all lines together at most 2,000 characters. The server repeats the check. 7\.      The system checks that the history was not changed by another Doctor since it was loaded (BR-119). 8\.      The system replaces the patient's medical history with the new entries (a kept line keeps its group, a new own-history line goes to the group "Khác", family lines go to "Tiền sử gia đình"), keeps the stored drug allergies unchanged, links the change to the medical record of the current visit and records it in the audit log (old and new values, visit, Doctor, time). 9\.      The system shows MSG03 ("Tiền sử bệnh cập nhật thành công.") and the read-only view with the new data. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | 1\.      AF-01 (at step 5): The Doctor clicks "Hủy" 1.1. If something was changed, the system shows MSG38; "Loại bỏ" discards the changes, "Tiếp tục chỉnh sửa" returns to the text areas. If nothing was changed, the panel returns to the read-only view without asking. 1.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | 1\.      EF-01 (at step 6): A line or the whole history is too long 1.1. The system shows MSG08 ("Mỗi dòng không vượt quá 255 ký tự." under the area, or "Vượt quá độ dài tối đa 2000 ký tự.") and does not save. 1.2. Return to step 5 of the Normal Flow.   2\.      EF-02 (at step 2): The visit is not being examined in the Doctor's room 2.1. The panel is read-only (no "Cập nhật") and the system shows MSG13. 2.2. The use case ends.   3\.      EF-03 (at step 2 or 8): The medical record of the visit is closed 3.1. The panel is read-only and the system shows MSG68 ("Hồ sơ bệnh án đã đóng và không thể chỉnh sửa."). 3.2. The use case ends.   4\.      EF-04 (at step 7): The data was changed by another Doctor 4.1. The system shows MSG75 ("Tiền sử bệnh vừa được cập nhật. Vui lòng tải lại và thử lại.") with "Tải lại"; nothing is saved. "Tải lại" loads the new data and drops the unsaved changes. 4.2. Return to step 2 of the Normal Flow.   5\.      EF-05 (at step 2): The data cannot be loaded 5.1. The system shows "Không thể tải tiền sử bệnh. Vui lòng thử lại." with "Thử lại". 5.2. Return to step 2 of the Normal Flow.   6\.      EF-06 (at step 8): Session expired or system error 6.1. The system shows MSG12 or MSG80 ("Không thể lưu tiền sử bệnh do lỗi hệ thống. Vui lòng thử lại sau."); nothing is saved and the entered data stays in the panel. 6.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the patient's medical history is updated and shown in later visits; the stored drug allergies are not changed. Failure / Cancelled: nothing is changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-19, BR-23, BR-32; Security: Audit trail (IV.2.3) |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG03, MSG08, MSG12, MSG13, MSG38, MSG68, MSG75, MSG80 |  |  |

## **8\. Patient Reception** {#8.-patient-reception}

### **8.1 UC-40: Register Examination** {#8.1-uc-40:-register-examination}

| Primary Actors | Receptionist | Secondary Actors | Simulated health insurance portal (through UC-74) |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Receptionist, I want to register a new visit for a patient, so that the patient is routed to the right examination room and gets a queue number. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Receptionist is signed in (UC-01). The Receptionist is viewing the patient list or the patient profile (UC-36). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Receptionist clicks “Đăng ký khám”. The system checks that the patient has no active visit (BR-17). The system opens the “Đăng ký khám” screen with the patient code, full name, date of birth, gender and identification number; “Loại tiếp nhận” is “Khám bệnh” (BR-94). If the patient belongs to a priority group, the Receptionist ticks “Ưu tiên” and selects “Lý do ưu tiên” (BR-14, BR-94). The Receptionist selects the visit type “BHYT” or “Dịch vụ” (self-paid) (BR-11). For “BHYT”, the Receptionist enters “Số thẻ BHYT/ Số thẻ BHXH” and clicks “Xác minh”. The system verifies the card (UC-74) and shows MSG16 with the card validity and coverage rate (BR-13, BR-50). The Receptionist enters the reason for visit (BR-95) and selects the referral source (BR-129). The system shows the active examination rooms that have a doctor on duty in the current shift, with department, location, doctor on duty and the number of patients the doctor still has to examine (today’s visits of the room that have a queue number and have not ended) (UC-42). The Receptionist selects the “Phòng khám”. The Receptionist clicks “Tiếp tục”. The system shows the confirmation screen: patient, priority, visit type (card number and coverage rate for BHYT), reception type, examination room, doctor, reason for visit, and the examination fee (BR-27). For a BHYT visit, the card must have been verified at step 6\. The Receptionist checks the summary with the patient and clicks “Xác nhận đăng ký”. The system creates the visit with a unique registration code (BR-53), the room, the registration time, the visit type, priority information, insurance card information (if any), the reception type and the reason for visit. A BHYT visit gets the next queue number of the room for the day (BR-18), becomes “Chờ khám” and joins the examination waiting list immediately (BR-15). A Dịch vụ visit becomes “Chờ thanh toán” without a queue number; it gets its number when the Cashier confirms the examination fee (UC-71). The system creates the examination fee receipt with status “Chờ thanh toán” (BR-09, BR-15, BR-27). The system shows MSG21. For a BHYT visit the message includes the queue number and the examination ticket can be printed (UC-41). For a Dịch vụ visit the message has no queue number and the Receptionist can print the payment guide slip (BR-16). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 5): Dịch vụ visit 1.1. The Receptionist selects “Dịch vụ”; no insurance card is entered. 1.2. The use case continues at step 7\. AF-02 (at step 6): The insurance card is not valid 2.1. The card is not found, not valid or expired. The system shows MSG17. 2.2. The system switches the visit type to “Dịch vụ” and discards the card data. The Receptionist informs the patient (BR-13). 2.3. The use case continues at step 7\. AF-03 (at step 6): The card does not belong to the patient 3.1. The card data does not match the patient. The system shows MSG18 and keeps the visit type “BHYT”. 3.2. If the Receptionist corrects the card number, the use case returns to step 6\. 3.3. If the Receptionist selects “Dịch vụ”, the use case continues at step 7\. AF-04 (at step 6): The insurance portal does not answer 4.1. The system shows MSG20 (UC-74). 4.2. If the Receptionist retries, the use case returns to step 6\. 4.3. If the Receptionist selects “Dịch vụ”, the use case continues at step 7\. AF-05 (at step 3): The patient has a follow-up appointment within its validity period (BR-34, BR-124) 5.1. The patient arrives on the appointment date or later, within the validity period (BR-124). The system shows the card “Lịch hẹn tái khám” with the appointment date, the doctor who made it and the suggested room (BR-34, BR-120), and two choices: “Đến tái khám” and “Khám vấn đề khác”. 5.2. If the Receptionist selects “Đến tái khám”, the system links the appointment to this registration, sets Loại tiếp nhận to “Tái khám”, preselects the suggested room (which can still be changed) and sets Nơi giới thiệu to “Tự đến” without allowing a change. The Receptionist can select “Bỏ gắn” to undo the link. 5.3. If the Receptionist selects “Khám vấn đề khác”, the visit is registered as “Khám bệnh” and the appointment is not changed. 5.4. The use case continues at step 4\. When the visit is created with the link, the appointment becomes “Đã đến khám” (BR-121). AF-06 (at step 3): The follow-up appointment is on a later date 6.1. The system shows only “Có lịch hẹn tái khám ngày …”, without “Đến tái khám”. 6.2. The visit is registered as “Khám bệnh”; the appointment stays “Đã hẹn” (BR-34). 6.3. The use case continues at step 4\. AF-07 (at step 10): Go back 7.1. The Receptionist clicks “Quay lại”; the entered data is kept. 7.2. The use case returns to step 4\. AF-08 (at step 11): The patient does not agree with the fee 8.1. The examination fee is the same for every room (BR-137); only the visit type changes the amount the patient pays (BR-27). 8.2. If the patient has a valid insurance card and the Receptionist changes the visit type to “BHYT”, the use case returns to step 6\. 8.3. If the Receptionist clicks “Hủy”, nothing is created and the use case ends.  |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 2 or 12): The patient already has an active visit 1.1. The system shows MSG22; nothing is created (BR-17). 1.2. The use case ends. EF-02 (at step 6 or 10): A required field is empty or has a wrong format 2.1. The system shows MSG02 or MSG05 in the field. 2.2. The use case returns to the step of that field. EF-03 (at step 8 or 12): No suitable room 3.1. No active examination room has a doctor on duty in the current shift, or the selected room has just become unavailable. The system shows MSG53 for the selected room, or MSG102 when no examination room can receive patients (BR-07, BR-96). 3.2. If another room is available, the use case returns to step 9; otherwise it ends. EF-04 (at any step): Session expired or system error 4.1. Nothing is created. 4.2. If the session has expired, the system ends the session and shows the Login screen (UC-01). The use case ends. 4.3. If a system error occurs, the system shows MSG80 on the confirmation screen; the confirmation stays open with the entered data and the use case returns to step 11\. EF-05 (at step 1 or 2): The patient does not exist 5.1. The patient cannot be found (for example, the link points to a patient that does not exist). The system shows that the patient is not found and offers “Về danh sách bệnh nhân”; no registration form is shown and nothing is created. 5.2. The use case ends. EF-06 (at step 1): The user is not allowed to register an examination 6.1. The signed-in user does not have the Receptionist role (BR-02). The system shows MSG13; no registration form is shown and nothing is created. 6.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the visit and its examination fee receipt are created. A BHYT visit has a queue number, is in the waiting list and its ticket can be printed (UC-41). A Dịch vụ visit has a payment guide slip; it gets its queue number when the Cashier confirms the fee, and the Cashier prints its examination ticket (UC-71, BR-16). A linked follow-up appointment is “Đã đến khám”. A Dịch vụ visit not paid by the end of the day becomes 'Đã hủy' and its receipt 'Đã hủy' (BR-22). Failure or cancel: nothing is created. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-02, BR-07, BR-09, BR-11, BR-13, BR-14, BR-15, BR-16, BR-17, BR-18, BR-22, BR-27, BR-34, BR-50, BR-53, BR-94, BR-95, BR-96, BR-120, BR-121, BR-124,  BR-129, BR-137 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG02, MSG05, MSG13, MSG16, MSG17, MSG18, MSG20, MSG21, MSG22, MSG53, MSG80, MSG102 |  |  |

### **8.2 UC-41: Print Examination Ticket** {#8.2-uc-41:-print-examination-ticket}

| Primary Actors | Receptionist | Secondary Actors | Cashier (AF-02), Doctor (AF-03) |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Receptionist, I want to print a slip for a newly registered visit, so that the patient knows where to go next: with a queue number, the patient waits at the room; without one, the patient pays at the cashier counter first (BR-15, BR-16). Included in UC-40 (step 14). |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The visit has been created (UC-40). The health facility information is configured (UC-77). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The system shows “Đăng ký khám thành công” with the registration code, the visit status and the preview of the slip. If the visit has a queue number (BHYT visit), the preview is “Phiếu khám bệnh” (PF-01): patient and visit information, queue number, priority mark (BR-14), room and location, doctor, and “Mời đến khu chờ – thanh toán sau khi có kết luận” (BR-15). If the visit has no queue number (Dịch vụ visit), the preview is “Phiếu hướng dẫn thanh toán”: patient and visit information, room and location, amount to pay at the cashier counter, and “Chưa có số thứ tự. Phiếu này không dùng để vào khám.” (BR-16). The Receptionist clicks “In phiếu khám” or “In phiếu hướng dẫn thanh toán”. The system opens the browser print dialog with the slip; the print time is shown on the edge of the slip. The Receptionist hands the slip to the patient and clicks “Về danh sách bệnh nhân”. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 1): Reprint 1.1. The Receptionist clicks “In lại phiếu khám” on the active visit in the patient profile (UC-36), or on “Đăng ký khám” next to MSG22 (UC-40, EF-01). 1.2. The system shows the slip as the visit is now: the current room and queue number after a transfer (UC-48); the examination ticket with “Đã thanh toán phí khám – mời đến khu chờ” after the fee is paid; otherwise the slip of step 2 or 3\. 1.3. The use case continues at step 4\. After printing, the system stays on the screen where the reprint started. AF-02 (after the examination fee is paid): The Cashier prints the examination ticket 2.1. After confirming the fee (UC-71), the Cashier opens “Phiếu khám” of the visit and clicks “In phiếu khám”. 2.2. The system opens the print dialog with the examination ticket showing the queue number, “Đã thanh toán phí khám – mời đến khu chờ” and the print time. 2.3. The use case ends. AF-03 (after a room transfer): The Doctor prints the examination ticket for the new room 3.1. After the Doctor transfers the patient to another room (UC-48), the system shows “In phiếu khám” on the transfer result. 3.2. The Doctor clicks “In phiếu khám”. The system opens the print dialog with the examination ticket showing the new room and its location, the new queue number and the print time. 3.3. The Doctor hands the ticket to the patient. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 1 or AF-01 step 1.2): The slip cannot be loaded 1.1. The system shows the reason (facility not configured; patient, room or visit not found; or no permission) and “Tải lại phiếu”; the print button is disabled. The visit is kept. 1.2. The use case returns to step 1\. EF-02 (at AF-01 step 1.1): The visit is closed 2.1. “In lại phiếu khám” is not shown for a visit that is Hoàn thành, Đã hủy or Bỏ khám. 2.2. The use case ends. EF-03 (at AF-02 step 2.1): The examination fee is not paid yet 3.1. The system shows the "In phiếu khám" button only for an examination-fee payment whose status is Đã thanh toán. For an unpaid payment, the button is not displayed. 3.2. The use case ends. EF-04 (at any step): Session expired or system error 4.1. Nothing is printed; the visit is kept. 4.2. If the session has expired, the system ends the session and shows the Login screen (UC-01). The use case ends. 4.3. If a system error occurs, the system shows MSG80 and “Tải lại phiếu”. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | A patient with a queue number holds the examination ticket and waits at the room. A patient without a queue number holds the payment guide slip, pays at the cashier counter and gets the examination ticket from the Cashier (AF-02). |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-14, BR-15, BR-16 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG80 |  |  |

### **8.3 UC-42: View Room Queue Status** {#8.3-uc-42:-view-room-queue-status}

| Primary Actors | Receptionist | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Receptionist, I want to see the examination rooms that have a doctor on duty now, with that doctor and today’s number of patients at each step, so that I can send new patients to a suitable room. The column “Bác sĩ còn phải khám” is the same number as at step 8 of UC-40: Chờ khám \+ Đang khám \+ Chờ CLS \+ Chờ kết luận \+ Bỏ lượt (today’s visits of the room that have a queue number and have not ended). |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | 1\.  	The Receptionist is signed in (UC-01). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | 1\.      The Receptionist selects “Hàng đợi phòng khám” in the menu. 2\.      The system shows the active examination rooms (BR-07) that have an active doctor on duty in the current shift (BR-96), grouped by department (A–Z, rooms by room code), with room name, code, location, “Bác sĩ trực” and today’s counts: Chờ thanh toán, Chờ khám, Đang khám, Chờ CLS, Chờ kết luận, Bỏ lượt and Bác sĩ còn phải khám. A skipped visit is counted only as Bỏ lượt; a visit waiting for payment is not counted in Bác sĩ còn phải khám. 3\.      The system refreshes the counts every 10 seconds; the Receptionist can also click “Tải lại”. 4\.      The Receptionist clicks a room row. 5\.      The system opens the room’s waiting list on its own link and shows STT, Bệnh nhân, Ưu tiên, Giờ đăng ký and Trạng thái, with priority visits first and then by queue number (BR-18), 10 visits per page. The list holds today’s visits that are Chờ khám (including skipped visits, shown as “Bỏ lượt”), Đang khám, Chờ CLS or Chờ kết luận; visits waiting for payment are not listed (BR-15). The list refreshes together with the counts. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | 1\.      AF-01 (at step 5): Back to the overview 1.1. The Receptionist clicks “Quay lại”. 1.2. The use case returns to step 2\.   2\.      AF-02 (at step 5): The room has no patient in the queue 2.1. The system shows MSG92. 2.2. The use case ends.   3\.      AF-03 (at step 5): The room in the link can no longer be viewed 3.1. If the room is inactive or has no doctor on duty, the system shows MSG53; if the room does not exist, the system shows MSG39 (“phòng khám”). “Quay lại” is shown. 3.2. The use case returns to step 2\. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | 1\.      EF-01 (at step 2): No room can receive patients 1.1. The system shows MSG102; no room is listed. 1.2. The use case ends.   2\.      EF-02 (at step 1 or 5): The user is not allowed to view the queue 2.1. The system shows MSG13 (BR-02). 2.2. The use case ends.   3\.      EF-03 (at step 2, 3 or 5): Session expired or system error 3.1. No data is changed. 3.2. If the session has expired, the system ends the session and shows the Login screen (UC-01). The use case ends. 3.3. If a system error occurs, the system shows MSG80; counts loaded before stay on screen with the time of the last update, and the use case returns to step 3\. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | The queue status of the rooms is shown. No data is changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-02, BR-07, BR-15, BR-18, BR-96 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG13, MSG39, MSG53, MSG80, MSG92, MSG102 |  |  |

### **8.4 UC-74: Verify Health Insurance** {#8.4-uc-74:-verify-health-insurance}

| Primary Actors | Receptionist | Secondary Actors | Simulated health insurance portal (BHXH) |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Receptionist, I want the system to look up the patient’s health insurance card on the simulated portal, so that insurance is applied only to a valid card with the right coverage rate. If the card is not valid, the visit is registered as Dịch vụ and I inform the patient (BR-13). The portal is simulated, not connected to the national portal. Extends UC-40 (step 6). |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | UC-40 is in progress and “BHYT” is selected. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Receptionist enters the card number. The field converts letters to upper case, removes spaces and accepts up to 15 characters. The system checks the format (BR-50): 10 digits, or 2 upper-case letters and 13 digits. “Xác minh” is enabled only when the format is correct. The Receptionist clicks “Xác minh”. The system takes the 10-digit social insurance number (the number itself, or the last 10 characters of a 15-character card) and sends it to the portal. The portal returns: result code, card status, full name, date of birth (with its type), gender, identification number, card number, valid from, valid to, initial registration facility and coverage rate. The system checks that the result code is “00”, the card is active and the card is valid today (valid from ≤ today ≤ valid to). The system compares the card holder with the patient profile by identification number, full name and date of birth. If either side has no identification number, it compares full name, date of birth and gender instead, and asks the Receptionist to check the card with the patient. The system shows MSG16 with the validity period, the coverage rate and the initial registration facility. Nothing is saved yet. The use case continues at step 7 of UC-40. When the Receptionist confirms the registration (UC-40, step 11), the system queries the portal again and saves on the visit the card number, social insurance number, validity period, initial registration facility and coverage rate, which are used to split every charge (BR-27). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (after step 7): The card number is changed 1.1. The verification result is cleared. 1.2. “Tiếp tục” shows “Vui lòng xác minh thẻ BHYT.” until the card is verified again. The use case returns to step 1\. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 2): The card number is empty or has a wrong format 1.1. If the field is empty, the system shows MSG02 under the field when the Receptionist clicks “Tiếp tục”. 1.2. If the format is wrong, “Xác minh” stays disabled and the system shows MSG05 under the field when the Receptionist clicks “Tiếp tục”. 1.3. The use case returns to step 1\. EF-02 (at step 5 or 9): The card is not found, not active or not valid today 2.1. The system shows MSG17, switches the visit type to “Dịch vụ”, and the Receptionist informs the patient (BR-13). 2.2. The use case continues as in UC-40, AF-02. EF-03 (at step 6): The card holder does not match the patient 3.1. The system shows MSG18 with the data from the portal, the note “Sửa lại số thẻ rồi xác minh lại, hoặc chuyển sang lượt khám dịch vụ.” and the button “Chuyển sang Dịch vụ”. The visit type stays “BHYT”. 3.2. If the Receptionist corrects the card number, the use case returns to step 1\. If the Receptionist clicks “Chuyển sang Dịch vụ”, the use case continues as in UC-40, AF-03. EF-04 (at step 3): The portal does not answer within 10 seconds 4.1. The system shows MSG20 with “Xác minh lại” and “Chuyển sang Dịch vụ”. 4.2. “Xác minh lại” returns to step 3\. “Chuyển sang Dịch vụ” continues as in UC-40, AF-04. EF-05 (at step 3 or 9): Session expired or system error 5.1. Nothing is saved. 5.2. If the session has expired, the system ends the session and shows the Login screen (UC-01). The use case ends. 5.3. If a system error occurs, the system shows MSG80; the entered data is kept and the use case returns to step 3\. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: when the registration is confirmed, the visit keeps the card number, social insurance number, validity period, initial registration facility and coverage rate (BR-27). Failure: insurance is not applied; the visit is Dịch vụ. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-11, BR-13, BR-27, BR-50 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG02, MSG05, MSG16, MSG17, MSG18, MSG20, MSG80 |  |  |

## **9\. Clinical Examination** {#9.-clinical-examination}

### **9.1 UC-43: View Patient Waiting List** {#9.1-uc-43:-view-patient-waiting-list}

| Primary Actors | Doctor | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | The Doctor views, searches and filters today’s visits of their assigned examination room on the “Quản lý khám bệnh” screen. The screen has three tabs: “Danh sách bệnh nhân”, “Chờ kết luận” and “Vắng mặt”. This use case covers the “Danh sách bệnh nhân” tab, which lists the visits waiting for examination, in examination, or waiting for paraclinical services. From this tab the Doctor can call a waiting patient (“Bắt đầu” or “Vắng mặt”, UC-44) or open a visit already started (UC-47). The other tabs belong to UC-54 and UC-45.  |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Doctor is signed in (UC-01) with an active account, has role Doctor and is not required to change the password. The Doctor is assigned to an active examination room (BR-05, BR-19).  |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Doctor opens “Quản lý khám bệnh”. The system identifies the Doctor’s assigned examination room and checks whether the Doctor is on duty there now (BR-55). The system loads today’s visits of that room (date in Asia/Ho\_Chi\_Minh) in the statuses waiting, in examination, waiting for paraclinical services and waiting for conclusion, including skipped visits. The system shows a header with: the current room; the Doctor in charge; “Tổng số bệnh nhân chờ” (the number of waiting visits); the auto-refresh information and the last refresh time. The system shows the tabs with their counts and opens “Danh sách bệnh nhân”. This tab lists the visits that are not skipped and are waiting for examination, in examination, or waiting for paraclinical services. Self-paid visits appear only after the examination fee is paid (BR-15). The system shows the columns: STT, Họ tên, Mã BN, Loại khám, Thời gian đăng ký, Ghi chú, Trạng thái, Thao tác. a. The queue number of a priority patient is shown in red. b. “Ghi chú” shows “Ưu tiên: {reason}” and “Chuyển từ: {room}”, one per line. c. “Trạng thái” shows “Đang chờ”, “Đang khám” or “Chờ CLS”. The system sorts the list: a. Visits in examination first. b. Waiting visits next (BR-14, BR-18): priority patients, by queue number; then transferred patients, by transfer time, then by queue number; then regular patients, by queue number. c. Visits waiting for paraclinical services last, by queue number. d. The first waiting patient is highlighted. The Doctor may search, filter and change pages. a. Search by patient name, patient code or insurance-card number. The search ignores case and accents, and the keyword is at most 100 characters (BR-110). b. Filter by priority (“Ưu tiên”, “Thường”) or visit type (“BHYT”, “Dịch vụ”). “Xóa bộ lọc” clears the search and the filters. c. Choose a page size of 10, 20 or 50 rows (default 10). d. Changing the search, a filter or the page size returns to the first page. The system shows the actions in the “Thao tác” column: a. Waiting visit: “Bắt đầu” goes to UC-44 with the START action; “Vắng mặt” goes to UC-44 with the SKIP action. Both buttons are enabled only while the Doctor is on duty (AF-04) and no other call is being processed. b. Visit in examination or waiting for paraclinical services: no button. Clicking the row opens the examination (UC-47); it is read-only while the patient is away for paraclinical services. The system refreshes the list automatically every 10 seconds, and also when the Doctor clicks the refresh control (UI-04). a. It updates the visits, the tab counts and the last refresh time. b. The tab counts do not depend on the current search and filters. c. The current tab, page, search and filters are kept. End: the use case ends when the Doctor leaves the screen, switches to another tab, goes to UC-44 or opens UC-47. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 5): No visits in the tab1.1. The system shows an empty list with MSG92 and the hint “Danh sách hiển thị lượt khám BHYT và lượt khám dịch vụ đã thanh toán.”1.2. Automatic refreshing continues and picks up new visits. AF-02 (at step 5): The Doctor selects another tab2.1. “Chờ kết luận” continues in UC-54.2.2. “Vắng mặt” continues in UC-45. AF-03 (at step 8): No result matches the search or the filters3.1. The system shows an empty list with MSG01 and the hint “Hãy sửa điều kiện tìm kiếm, bộ lọc hoặc chọn “Xóa bộ lọc”.” The criteria are kept.3.2. The Doctor changes the criteria or selects “Xóa bộ lọc”. AF-04 (at step 2): The Doctor is outside a valid duty shift4.1. The Doctor is not scheduled in the assigned room for the current shift, or the current time is outside that shift’s configured hours.4.2. The system shows MSG48 above the list.4.3. Viewing, searching, filtering, paging and automatic refreshing remain available.4.4. “Bắt đầu” and “Vắng mặt” are disabled, with the tooltip “Ngoài ca trực”.4.5. If a call request is still sent, the system refuses it with DOCTOR\_OFF\_DUTY, shows MSG48 and keeps the visit unchanged. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 2): No valid room assignment1.1. The Doctor has no assignment to an active examination room.1.2. The system returns ROOM\_ASSIGNMENT\_REQUIRED, shows MSG99 and does not load the visits of any other room. EF-02 (at step 2): The account is not an active Doctor2.1. The system refuses with MSG13. EF-03 (at step 3 or 10): Loading error3.1. The system shows MSG80, or MSG96 when the server cannot be reached.3.2. The system keeps the last list that loaded successfully, if any, and lets the Doctor retry.3.3. If the first load fails, no empty-list message is shown. EF-04 (at any step): Session expired4.1. The system shows MSG12 and returns to UC-01. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the Doctor sees today’s visits of the assigned examination room, with the correct ordering, filters, counts, paging and actions. Failure: viewing, searching, filtering, paging, retrying and automatic refreshing never change a visit. A refused call leaves the visit unchanged. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-02, BR-05, BR-14, BR-15, BR-18, BR-19, BR-21, BR-24, BR-55, BR-110  |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG01, MSG12, MSG13, MSG48, MSG80, MSG92, MSG96, MSG99  |  |  |

### **9.2 UC-44: Handle Patient Call** {#9.2-uc-44:-handle-patient-call}

| Primary Actors | Doctor | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | The Doctor calls a waiting patient from “Danh sách bệnh nhân” (UC-43) with “Bắt đầu” or “Vắng mặt”, without a confirmation dialog. “Bắt đầu” starts the examination, assigns the visit to the Doctor and opens the Clinical Examination screen (UC-47). “Vắng mặt” moves the visit to the skipped list (UC-45).  |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Doctor is signed in (UC-01) with an active account and is not required to change the password. The Doctor is assigned to an active examination room and is on duty there now (BR-05, BR-19, BR-55). The visit belongs to that room, is waiting and is not skipped.  |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The patient is present and the Doctor clicks “Bắt đầu”. While the request runs, the buttons are disabled and show “Đang xử lý…”. The system checks the Doctor: an active Doctor account, an active examination room, and on duty in that room now. The system loads the latest visit and checks that it belongs to that room, is waiting and is not skipped. In one transaction (BR-119), the system: assigns the visit to the Doctor; sets it to “Đang khám” and records the start time (BR-20); writes the START action to the audit log (BR-42). The system opens the Clinical Examination screen (UC-47).  |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 1): Patient absent 1.1. The Doctor clicks “Vắng mặt”, and the system runs the checks of steps 2–3. 1.2. In one transaction, the system marks the visit as skipped (it stays waiting), records the skip time and writes the SKIP action to the audit log (BR-21). 1.3. The system shows MSG54 and refreshes UC-43. The visit moves to “Vắng mặt” (UC-45).  |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 2): Account, room or shift not valid1.1. Not an active Doctor: MSG13. No active examination room assigned: MSG99. Off duty: MSG48.1.2. Nothing is saved, and UC-43 is refreshed. EF-02 (at step 3): Visit of another room2.1. MSG13. EF-03 (at step 3): Visit not found3.1. MSG80, and UC-43 is refreshed. EF-04 (at step 3 or 4): Already called or changed meanwhile4.1. The visit is no longer waiting, is already skipped, or another request updated it first: MSG23, and UC-43 is refreshed. Nothing is saved. EF-05 (at step 4 or AF-01 1.2): Save error5.1. The transaction is rolled back. The system shows MSG80, or MSG96 when the server cannot be reached. The Doctor may retry. EF-06: Session expired6.1. MSG12, and the system returns to UC-01. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: “Bắt đầu” sets the visit to “Đang khám” and assigns it to the Doctor. “Vắng mặt” marks it skipped with the skip time and keeps it waiting. Both are recorded in the audit log. Failure: nothing is saved. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-02, BR-05, BR-19, BR-20, BR-21, BR-42, BR-55, BR-119  |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG12, MSG13, MSG23, MSG48, MSG54, MSG80, MSG96, MSG99  |  |  |

### **9.3 UC-45: View Skipped Patient List** {#9.3-uc-45:-view-skipped-patient-list}

| Primary Actors | Doctor | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | The Doctor views and searches today’s skipped visits of their assigned examination room in the “Vắng mặt” tab. A visit is skipped when the patient is absent when called for examination (UC-44) or for the conclusion (UC-54). Skipped paraclinical services are not included.  |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Doctor is signed in (UC-01) with an active account and is not required to change the password. The Doctor is assigned to an active examination room (BR-05, BR-19).  |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | On “Quản lý khám bệnh” (UC-43), the Doctor selects the “Vắng mặt” tab. The system lists today’s skipped visits of the room, ordered by skip time (earliest first), then by queue number (BR-21). The columns are as in UC-43. “Trạng thái” shows the interrupted stage: “Vắng mặt · Chờ khám” or “Vắng mặt · Chờ kết luận”. The Doctor may: search by name, patient code or insurance-card number (BR-110); filter by priority, visit type or interrupted stage; choose 10, 20 or 50 rows per page. Any change returns to page 1; “Xóa bộ lọc” clears the search and filters. Each visit that can be accepted again has “Tiếp nhận lại”, which goes to UC-46. It is enabled only while the Doctor is on duty. The list refreshes every 10 seconds; counts ignore the search and filters, and the page and filters are kept. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 2): No skipped visits1.1. MSG92 with the hint “Bệnh nhân vắng mặt khi được gọi sẽ xuất hiện tại đây.” Refreshing continues. AF-02 (at step 4): No matching result2.1. MSG01. The criteria are kept until the Doctor changes them or selects “Xóa bộ lọc”. AF-03 (at step 5): Outside the duty shift3.1. MSG48 is shown above the list and “Tiếp nhận lại” is disabled. Viewing still works. A request sent anyway is refused by UC-46 with MSG48. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01: Not an active Doctor, or no active examination room1.1. Not an active Doctor: MSG13. No active examination room: MSG99. No data of another room is shown. EF-02 (at step 2 or 6): Loading error2.1. MSG80, or MSG96 when the server cannot be reached. The last list is kept and the Doctor can retry. EF-03: Session expired3.1. MSG12, and the system returns to UC-01. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success and failure: no visit is changed, and no data of another room is shown.  |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-02, BR-05, BR-19, BR-21, BR-22, BR-55, BR-110  |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG01, MSG12, MSG13, MSG48, MSG80, MSG92, MSG96, MSG99  |  |  |

### **9.4 UC-46: Accept Skipped Patient**  {#9.4-uc-46:-accept-skipped-patient}

| Primary Actors | Doctor | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | When a skipped patient returns, the Doctor accepts the visit from the “Vắng mặt” tab (UC-45) with “Tiếp nhận lại”, without a confirmation dialog. Work resumes at the stage that was interrupted: the examination (UC-47) or the conclusion (UC-56).  |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Doctor is signed in (UC-01) with an active account and is not required to change the password. The Doctor is assigned to an active examination room and is on duty there now (BR-05, BR-19, BR-55). The visit is in “Vắng mặt”. A visit skipped at “Chờ kết luận” must already have an assigned Doctor. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The patient returns and the Doctor clicks “Tiếp nhận lại”. While the request runs, the button is disabled and shows “Đang xử lý…”. The system checks the Doctor as in UC-44 step 2\. The system loads the latest visit and checks that it belongs to the room, is skipped, and is at “Chờ khám” or “Chờ kết luận”. In one transaction (BR-119), the system: clears the skipped flag and the skip time; for a visit at “Chờ khám”: assigns it to the Doctor, sets it to “Đang khám” and records the start time (BR-20); for a visit at “Chờ kết luận”: keeps that status and the assigned Doctor; writes the ACCEPT\_SKIPPED action, with the interrupted stage and the new status, to the audit log (BR-42). The system opens UC-47 for a visit at “Chờ khám”, or the conclusion step (UC-56) for a visit at “Chờ kết luận”.  |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 1): The patient has not returned 1.1. The Doctor does nothing; the visit stays in “Vắng mặt” until the end of the day (BR-22).   |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 2): Account, room or shift not valid1.1. Not an active Doctor: MSG13. No active examination room: MSG99. Off duty: MSG48. Nothing is saved. EF-02 (at step 3): Visit of another room2.1. MSG13. EF-03 (at step 3): Visit not found3.1. MSG80, and the list is refreshed. EF-04 (at step 3 or 4): No longer skipped, or changed meanwhile4.1. The visit is no longer skipped, was closed by the end-of-day job (BR-22), or another request updated it first: MSG23, and the list is refreshed. Nothing is saved. EF-05 (at step 4): Save error5.1. The transaction is rolled back. The system shows MSG80, or MSG96 when the server cannot be reached. The visit stays skipped. EF-06: Session expired6.1. MSG12, and the system returns to UC-01. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the visit leaves “Vắng mặt”. A visit at “Chờ khám” becomes “Đang khám” and is assigned to the Doctor; a visit at “Chờ kết luận” keeps its status and Doctor. The action is in the audit log. Failure: nothing is saved, and no visit is accepted twice. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-02, BR-05, BR-19, BR-20, BR-21, BR-22, BR-42, BR-55, BR-119  |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG12, MSG13, MSG23, MSG48, MSG80, MSG96, MSG99 |  |  |

### **9.5 UC-47: Perform Clinical Examination** {#9.5-uc-47:-perform-clinical-examination}

| Primary Actors | Doctor | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | The Doctor examines a patient called in through UC-44 on the “Khám lâm sàng” tab, following outpatient Form 15/BV1. The Doctor records: the reason for visit; the vital signs; the general and body-part findings; the preliminary diagnosis, as one or more ICD-10 codes. From this screen the Doctor goes on to paraclinical orders (UC-49) or to the conclusion (UC-56). |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Doctor is signed in (UC-01) with an active account and is not required to change the password. The Doctor is assigned to an active examination room and is on duty there now (BR-05, BR-19, BR-55). The visit belongs to that room, is assigned to this Doctor, is “Đang khám” and is not skipped. Its medical record is Open (BR-32). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Doctor opens the visit from UC-44, or clicks its row in UC-43. The system checks the Doctor, room, shift and visit. On the first opening it creates the outpatient medical record and the examination sheet, and records the view in the audit log (BR-42). The system shows: the patient and visit details; the drug allergies; the previous visits; the medical history (UC-39); the saved examination data. The Doctor enters or updates: 4.1. “Lý do khám / triệu chứng chính”: prefilled from reception, 2–1,000 characters (BR-95). 4.2. “Sinh hiệu”: at least one value, within the ranges of BR-98. BMI is calculated from weight and height. 4.3. “1. Toàn thân”: at most 4,000 characters. “2. Khám bộ phận”: at most 2,000 characters (BR-99). 4.4. “Chẩn đoán ban đầu (ICD-10)”: one or more codes. Each code must be valid on the visit day, be the most detailed code and fit the patient’s sex (BR-31, BR-46, BR-51, BR-100). The code and name are saved as a snapshot. The Doctor clicks “Lưu”. The system checks the reason for visit and the vital signs, then saves in one transaction (BR-119): the examination data; the vital signs, with the Doctor as measurer; an audit row with the old and new values (BR-42). The system shows MSG03 (“Hồ sơ khám lâm sàng cập nhật thành công.”). The visit stays “Đang khám”. To continue, the Doctor opens the “Chỉ định cận lâm sàng” tab (UC-49) or the “Kết luận” tab (UC-56). The system saves first as in step 5, and also requires at least one preliminary-diagnosis code. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 3): Update medical history or allergies1.1. The Doctor adds or edits an item in UC-39 (BR-23, BR-93). The panel refreshes. AF-02 (at step 3): Transfer the patient2.1. Before the first save, the “Chuyển phòng” tab is available (UC-48). AF-03 (at step 1): Visit waiting for paraclinical services or for the conclusion3.1. The examination opens read-only, and it cannot be saved. AF-04: Leave with unsaved changes4.1. The system shows MSG38 with “Tiếp tục chỉnh sửa” and “Loại bỏ”. Data already saved is kept. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 5 or 7): Invalid data1.1. The message is shown under the field, and nothing is saved: missing field or no vital sign: MSG02; too long: MSG08; vital sign out of range, or diastolic not below systolic: MSG05. EF-02 (at step 7): No preliminary diagnosis2.1. MSG02 under “Chẩn đoán ban đầu”. The tab does not open. EF-03 (at step 4.4): Invalid ICD-10 code3.1. The code is no longer valid, is not the most detailed, or does not fit the patient’s sex: MSG40. EF-04 (at step 2 or 5): Not allowed4.1. Not an active Doctor, or not the Doctor of the visit: MSG13. Off duty: MSG48. No room: MSG99. Record closed: MSG68. Visit not found: MSG39. EF-05 (at step 5): Changed by another request5.1. MSG75; the Doctor reloads. EF-06: Session expired or system error6.1. Session expired: MSG12, and the system returns to UC-01. Server unreachable: MSG96. Other errors: MSG80. Nothing is shown as saved before the server confirms it. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the examination data, the vital signs and the preliminary diagnosis are saved in the open medical record, and the change is in the audit log. The visit stays “Đang khám” until UC-49 or UC-56. Failure: nothing is saved. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-02, BR-05, BR-19, BR-23, BR-31, BR-32, BR-42, BR-46, BR-51, BR-55, BR-93, BR-95, BR-98, BR-99, BR-100, BR-119  |  |  |
| **Messages** | BR-02, BR-05, BR-19, BR-23, BR-31, BR-32, BR-42, BR-46, BR-51, BR-55, BR-93, BR-95, BR-98, BR-99, BR-100, BR-119  |  |  |

### **9.6 UC-48: Transfer Patient to Another Room** {#9.6-uc-48:-transfer-patient-to-another-room}

| Primary Actors | Doctor | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Doctor, I want to transfer a patient I have called in, whose clinical examination has not been saved yet, to another active examination room, so that the patient is examined there without a new visit or a new fee. The patient gets the next queue number of the new room, is marked “Chuyển từ phòng …” and is called after priority patients but before ordinary patients (BR-18, BR-24). |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Doctor is signed in (UC-01), is assigned to an examination room and is working in the current shift (BR-05, BR-19, BR-55). The patient was called into the Doctor’s room (“Đang khám”) and the clinical examination of the visit has not been saved yet. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Doctor opens the clinical examination of a called patient (UC-44). The Doctor clicks “Chuyển phòng”. The system checks that the patient is still called in the Doctor’s room, the clinical examination has not been saved and the Doctor is in the current shift (BR-19, BR-24, BR-55). The system shows “Chuyển phòng khám” with the patient name and code, date of birth, gender, visit code, visit type (with the card for BHYT), current room, current queue number, reason for visit and status, and the fields “Phòng chuyển đến”, “Lý do chuyển” and “Ghi chú”. The system lists the other active examination rooms that have a doctor on duty in the current shift, with code, name, department, location and doctor (BR-07, BR-96). The Doctor selects the destination room, enters the reason (BR-97) and may add a note. The Doctor clicks “Xác nhận chuyển”. The system checks the input and rechecks the conditions of steps 3 and 5\. The system gives the visit the next queue number of the destination room (BR-18) and updates the visit: room, queue number, status “Chờ khám” and the mark “Chuyển từ phòng …”. The visit and its receipts stay the same; no new examination fee is charged (BR-24). The system saves the transfer history: source and destination rooms, old and new queue numbers, reason, note, Doctor and time. The patient is no longer called in the source room and joins the waiting list of the destination room after priority patients and before ordinary patients (BR-18). The system shows MSG24 and the button “In phiếu khám” (UC-41, AF-03). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 6 or 7): The Doctor cancels 1.1. The Doctor clicks “Hủy”; if anything was entered, the system shows MSG38. 1.2. If the Doctor confirms, nothing is changed and the screen closes. 1.3. The use case ends. AF-02 (at step 12): Print the examination ticket 2.1. The Doctor clicks “In phiếu khám”; the ticket of the new room is printed (UC-41, AF-03). 2.2. The use case ends. AF-03 (at step 5): No room can receive the patient 3.1. The system shows MSG102 and “Xác nhận chuyển” stays disabled; the patient stays in the source room. 3.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 3 or 8): The clinical examination has been saved 1.1. The “Chuyển phòng” is disable; nothing is changed. 1.2. The use case ends. EF-02 (at step 8): The reason is too short 2.1. "Xác nhận chuyển" stays disabled until a destination room is selected and a reason is entered. The reason field accepts at most 500 characters; text beyond 500 characters is cut off (BR-97). 2.2. If the reason is shorter than 5 characters, the system shows MSG95 (BR-97). 2.3. The use case returns to step 6\. EF-03 (at step 8): The destination room can no longer receive patients 3.1. The system shows MSG53 and reloads the room list. 3.2. The use case returns to step 5\. EF-04 (at any step): Session expired or system error 4.1. Nothing is changed; a transfer that cannot be completed is rolled back as a whole. 4.2. If the session has expired, the system ends the session and shows the Login screen (UC-01). The use case ends. 4.3. If a system error occurs, the system shows MSG80. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the patient is in the destination room with a new queue number and the mark “Chuyển từ phòng …”, ordered by BR-18. The transfer history is saved; the visit and its receipts are kept and no new examination fee is charged. The examination ticket of the new room can be printed (UC-41). Failure or cancel: the room, queue number and status of the visit are not changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-05, BR-07, BR-18, BR-19, BR-24, BR-55, BR-96, BR-97 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG24, MSG31, MSG38, MSG53, MSG80, MSG95, MSG102 |  |  |

### **9.7 UC-49: Order Paraclinical Services** {#9.7-uc-49:-order-paraclinical-services}

| Primary Actors | Doctor | Secondary Actors | Cashier (collects the paraclinical fee afterwards) |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Doctor, I want to select paraclinical services and confirm the order, then explain the services and the estimated cost to the patient, so that a paraclinical receipt is created and the order lines are routed to the paraclinical rooms: at once for a BHYT visit, after payment for a Dịch vụ visit (BR-25, BR-26, BR-28). Only active services can be ordered (BR-10). |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Doctor is signed in (UC-01), is assigned to an examination room and is working in the current shift (BR-19, BR-55). The visit is "Đang khám" by the Doctor and its medical record is open (UC-47), or the visit is "Chờ kết luận" with this Doctor and the record is not closed (UC-56). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Doctor clicks "Chỉ định cận lâm sàng". The system shows the active paraclinical services with Mã dịch vụ, Tên dịch vụ, Nhóm, Giá viện phí and Giá BHYT, 10 per page, with a search box (code or name) and filters by type (Xét nghiệm, Chẩn đoán hình ảnh, Thăm dò chức năng) and by group (BR-08, BR-10). The Doctor selects one or more services. The preliminary diagnosis from the clinical examination (UC-47) is attached to the order. The system shows the selected services and the estimated cost per service and in total, split into the insurance part and the patient part (BR-27). For a BHYT visit, the estimate uses the card's coverage rate, and the screen notes "Bệnh nhân có thể phải trả ít hơn nếu tổng chi phí BHYT của lượt khám dưới 15% mức lương cơ sở: {amount} đ."; each service shows the performing room assigned by the system: an active room of the service's group with a technician on duty, then the fewest waiting patients, then the lower room code (BR-28). For a Dịch vụ visit, the room shows "Phân phòng sau khi thanh toán"; the room is assigned the same way when the receipt is paid (UC-71). The Doctor clicks "Xác nhận chỉ định". The system checks that the Doctor is still in the current shift, that the visit can still be ordered for and that every selected service is still active. The system creates one paraclinical order with one order line per selected service ("Chờ thanh toán"), with the current prices (BR-09), and one paraclinical receipt ("Chờ thanh toán") with one line per service (BR-26, BR-27). The insurance share of the visit's unpaid receipts is recalculated (BR-27). For a BHYT visit, the order lines are released at once: each order line becomes "Chờ thực hiện" in its assigned room, and the patient pays after the conclusion (BR-26). For a Dịch vụ visit, the order lines wait for payment. The system sets the visit to "Chờ CLS" and shows MSG63. The Doctor explains the services and the estimated cost to the patient (BR-25). The patient agrees. The Doctor prints the order slip (UC-50). For a Dịch vụ visit, the slip shows "Phân phòng sau khi thanh toán"; the Doctor tells the patient to pay at the cashier counter (UC-69, UC-71), and the receipt shows the room and location of each service (UC-72). For a BHYT visit, the patient goes straight to the paraclinical rooms. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 10): The patient refuses some or all services 1.1. The Doctor cancels each refused service and enters the reason (UC-76, BR-41); the receipt is recalculated (BR-25, BR-27). 1.2. If some services remain, the use case continues at step 11 for those services. 1.3. If all services are cancelled, the order and its receipt become "Đã hủy", no slip is printed and the visit becomes "Chờ kết luận" (BR-41); the Doctor concludes the visit (UC-56). The use case ends. AF-02 (at step 3): An insured patient selects a service not covered by insurance 2.1. The system marks the service "Không thuộc BHYT"; it is charged at the clinic price and paid by the patient (BR-26, BR-27). 2.2. The use case continues at step 4\. AF-03 (at step 1): More tests after reviewing results (from UC-56) 3.1. The Doctor opens "Chỉ định cận lâm sàng" again while the visit is "Chờ kết luận". 3.2. The use case continues at step 2\. When the new order is confirmed, it is a separate order with its own order number and receipt; the results of the earlier orders are kept, and the visit goes back from "Chờ kết luận" to "Chờ CLS". |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 5): No service selected 1.1. "Xác nhận chỉ định" stays disabled until at least one service is selected. 1.2. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-02 (at step 6): A selected service was deactivated meanwhile 2.1. The system shows MSG40 and removes the service from the selection. 2.2. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-03 (at step 6): The Doctor is not in a shift 3.1. The shift has ended, even for a visit the Doctor called in before. The system shows MSG48; no order or receipt is created (BR-19). 3.2. The use case ends. EF-04 (at any step): Session expired or system error 4.1. No order or receipt is created. 4.2. If the session has expired, the system ends the session and shows the Login screen (UC-01). The use case ends. 4.3. If a system error occurs, the system shows MSG80. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the paraclinical order and its receipt exist and the visit is "Chờ CLS". BHYT order lines go to their rooms at once; Dịch vụ order lines go only after payment (UC-71). If the patient refuses all services, the order and receipt are "Đã hủy" and the visit is "Chờ kết luận" (BR-41). An unpaid Dịch vụ receipt is cancelled at the end of the day and the visit becomes "Bỏ khám" (BR-22). Failure or cancel: no order and no receipt are created. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-08, BR-09, BR-10, BR-19, BR-22, BR-25, BR-26, BR-27, BR-28, BR-41, BR-55 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG40, MSG48, MSG63, MSG80 |  |  |

### **9.8 UC-76: Cancel Refused Paraclinical Service**

| Primary Actors | Doctor | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Doctor, I want to cancel the paraclinical services that the patient refuses, with a reason, so that the patient is not charged for them and the visit can move on to the conclusion. A service can be cancelled only while it is not paid yet (Dịch vụ visit) or not accepted by a Technician yet (BHYT visit) (BR-25). The receipts are recalculated. When the visit has no service left to perform, it moves to "Chờ kết luận" (BR-41). |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Doctor is signed in (UC-01) and is the Doctor of the visit. The visit is "Chờ CLS" and its medical record has not been closed (BR-32). The Doctor is viewing the paraclinical order list of the visit (UC-54). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Doctor clicks "Hủy" on a service of the order list. "Hủy" is shown only on services that can still be cancelled (BR-25). The system shows the dialog "Hủy dịch vụ {tên dịch vụ}" with the note "Chỉ hủy khi bệnh nhân từ chối thực hiện. Khoản thu sẽ được tính lại." and the field "Lý do hủy"\*.
