The field accepts at most 500 characters, and "Xác nhận hủy" stays disabled while the reason is empty (BR-97). The Doctor enters the reason and clicks "Xác nhận hủy". The system checks that the user is the Doctor of the visit, the visit is still "Chờ CLS", the record is not closed, the service can still be cancelled (BR-25), and the reason has at least 5 characters (BR-97). In one transaction, the system sets the service to "Đã hủy" with the reason, the Doctor and the time, takes the service out of its receipt and recalculates the receipt totals (BR-122). It then recalculates the coverage rate and every pending receipt of the visit; for a BHYT visit, the coverage rate can rise to 100% when the total cost falls below 15% of the base salary (BR-27), records the audit log (BR-42). The system shows MSG70 and refreshes the order list. The cancelled service shows "Lý do: …" under its status (UC-54). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 3): The Doctor closes the dialog 1.1. The Doctor clicks "Đóng" in the dialog. Nothing is changed. 1.2. The use case ends. AF-02 (at step 5): No other service of the slip or the receipt is left 2.1. If every service of the slip is cancelled, the slip becomes "Đã hủy" and "In phiếu chỉ định" is hidden (UC-50, UC-54). 2.2. If every line of the receipt is cancelled, the receipt becomes "Đã hủy" and leaves the Cashier's waiting payment list (BR-37). 2.3. The use case continues at step 6\. AF-03 (at step 5): The visit has no service left to perform 3.1. If every other non-cancelled service of the visit already has a result, or every service is cancelled, the visit becomes "Chờ kết luận" and appears in the room's waiting-for-conclusion list (BR-18, BR-41). MSG70 also says "Không còn dịch vụ cận lâm sàng nào phải làm, lượt khám chuyển sang chờ kết luận." 3.2. The Doctor can conclude the visit (UC-56). 3.3. The use case continues at step 6\. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 4): The user is not the Doctor of the visit 1.1. The system shows MSG13. Nothing is changed. 1.2. The use case ends. EF-02 (at step 4): The service can no longer be cancelled 2.1. The service was paid or accepted by a Technician meanwhile. The system closes the dialog, refreshes the order list and shows MSG30. Nothing is changed. 2.2. The use case ends. EF-03 (at step 4): The reason is too short 3.1. If the reason is shorter than 5 characters, the system shows MSG95 (BR-97). 3.2. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-04 (at step 4): The visit or its medical record changed meanwhile 4.1. If the record is closed, the system shows MSG68. If the visit is no longer "Chờ CLS", or it was changed in another tab, the system shows MSG75. Nothing is changed. 4.2. The use case ends. EF-05 (at any step): Session expired or system error 5.1. Nothing is changed. 5.2. If the session has expired, the system ends the session and shows the Login screen (UC-01). The use case ends. 5.3. If a system error occurs, the system shows MSG80. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the service is "Đã hủy" with its reason. The coverage rate and the pending receipts of the visit are recalculated. A receipt with no line left is cancelled, and a Dịch vụ receipt that falls to 0 becomes "Miễn phí" and its services go to the rooms. The slip is cancelled if all its services are cancelled. The visit is "Chờ kết luận" if no service is left to perform. The change is in the audit log. Failure or cancel: nothing is changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-02, BR-18, BR-25, BR-26, BR-27, BR-28, BR-32, BR-37, BR-41, BR-97, BR-122 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG13, MSG30, MSG68, MSG70, MSG75, MSG80, MSG95 |  |  |

### **9.9 UC-50: Print Paraclinical Order** {#9.9-uc-50:-print-paraclinical-order}

| Primary Actors | Doctor | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Doctor, after confirming a paraclinical order (UC-49), I want to print the order slip, so that the patient knows which paraclinical rooms to go to. The whole order is printed on one sheet, with the performing room and location of each service, or "Phân phòng sau khi thanh toán" for a Dịch vụ visit not paid yet. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Doctor is signed in (UC-01). The order exists, is not cancelled and belongs to a visit of the Doctor (the Doctor who created the order or the Doctor of the visit). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Doctor clicks "In phiếu chỉ định" on an order, right after confirming it (UC-49) or from the order list of the visit. The system checks that the Doctor may print the order. The system builds one sheet for the order. Cancelled and abandoned services are left out; the other services are grouped by performing room, sorted by room code, and keep their order-line order inside each room. Services without a room yet (a Dịch vụ visit not paid yet) are grouped by service group and printed last. The sheet shows the facility information (UC-77), the order number, the patient and visit information (including the BHYT card number for a BHYT visit), the ordering room, the preliminary diagnosis, the list of services with the performing room and location (or "Phân phòng sau khi thanh toán"), the order time and the ordering Doctor's name and signature space. Queue numbers and amounts are not printed; amounts are on the receipt (UC-72). The system opens the browser print dialog with the sheet; the print time is shown on the edge of the sheet. The Doctor gives the sheet to the patient. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 1): Print again 1.1. The Doctor clicks "In phiếu chỉ định" again on an order that is not cancelled. 1.2. The sheet reflects the current order: services cancelled since the last print are left out, services whose room has been assigned since the last print (after payment) show their room, and the new print time is shown. 1.3. The use case continues at step 2\. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 2): The user is not allowed to print the order 1.1. The user is not an active Doctor, or the order does not belong to a visit of the Doctor. The system shows MSG13. 1.2. The use case ends. EF-02 (at step 2): The order does not exist 2.1. The system shows MSG39 ("lượt khám"). 2.2. The use case ends. EF-03 (at step 1): Nothing to print 3.1. "In phiếu chỉ định" is not shown for an order that is cancelled or whose services are all cancelled. 3.2. The use case ends. EF-04 (at step 4): The facility information is not configured 4.1. The system shows "Chưa có thông tin cơ sở khám bệnh, chữa bệnh. Vui lòng liên hệ quản trị viên."; nothing is printed. 4.2. The use case ends. EF-05 (at any step): Session expired or system error 5.1. Nothing is printed and no data is changed. 5.2. If the session has expired, the system ends the session and shows the Login screen (UC-01). The use case ends. 5.3. If a system error occurs, the system shows MSG80. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the order sheet is printed. No order, payment or queue data is changed. Failure: nothing is changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-26, BR-28, BR-120 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG13, MSG39, MSG80 |  |  |

## **10\. Medical Record** {#10.-medical-record}

### **10.1 UC-51: View List Medical Record** {#10.1-uc-51:-view-list-medical-record}

| Primary Actors | Doctor | Secondary Actors | None |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Doctor, I want to search patients and view the list of their visits, so that I can review their examination history. Doctors can view the medical records of all patients (BR-35). |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Doctor is signed in (UC-01). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Doctor selects “Hồ sơ bệnh án” in the menu. The system shows the search form: “Từ khóa tìm kiếm” (“Mã BN, CCCD, Họ tên, SĐT...”), “Từ ngày”, “Đến ngày”, “Phòng khám” (“Tất cả phòng khám” and the rooms), “Chẩn đoán (ICD-10)” (suggestions after 2 characters), “Trạng thái” (“Tất cả trạng thái”, “Đang hoạt động”, “Hoàn thành”, “Bỏ khám”, “Đã hủy”) and the buttons “Tìm kiếm” and “Xóa bộ lọc”. The Doctor enters a keyword and/or filters and clicks “Tìm kiếm”. The system checks the input: the keyword is empty or has 2–100 characters, the ICD-10 text has at most 100 characters and “Từ ngày” is not after “Đến ngày”. The server repeats the checks. The system shows “Danh sách Bệnh nhân” with “Mã bệnh nhân”, “Họ và tên”, “Ngày sinh”, “Giới tính”, “Số lượt khám”, “Ngày khám gần nhất”, “Chẩn đoán gần nhất” and “Lịch sử khám”, 10, 20 or 50 rows per page with “Trang trước” / “Trang sau”. The search is recorded in the audit log. The Doctor clicks “Lịch sử khám” of a patient. The system shows “Lịch sử các lượt khám (mới nhất lên đầu)” with “Mã lượt khám”, “Ngày khám”, “Phòng khám”, “Bác sĩ khám”, “Đối tượng”, “Chẩn đoán cuối cùng”, “Trạng thái” (a skipped visit reads “Đã bỏ qua”) and “Xem chi tiết”, and records the access in the audit log. The Doctor clicks “Xem chi tiết” of a visit; the use case continues in UC-52. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 1): Opened from the clinical examination screen 1.1. On the clinical examination screen (UC-47), the Doctor clicks “Lịch sử khám”. 1.2. The system opens step 7 for the patient of the visit. AF-02 (at step 7): Back to the patient list 2.1. The Doctor clicks “Quay lại danh sách bệnh nhân”. 2.2. The use case returns to step 5 with the same search. AF-03 (at step 3): Clear the filters 3.1. The Doctor clicks “Xóa bộ lọc”. 3.2. The system clears the keyword and the filters; the use case returns to step 3\. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 4): The input is not valid 1.1. The system shows under the field “Vui lòng nhập ít nhất 2 ký tự để tìm kiếm.”, MSG08 (“Vượt quá độ dài tối đa 100 ký tự.”) or MSG50, and “Tìm kiếm” is disabled. 1.2. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-02 (at step 5): No patient matches 2.1. The system shows MSG01 and “Vui lòng thử điều chỉnh lại từ khóa hoặc các tiêu chí bộ lọc.” 2.2. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-03 (at step 7): The patient does not exist 3.1. The system shows MSG39 (“Không tìm thấy bệnh nhân.”). 3.2. The use case returns to step 5\. EF-04 (at step 1): The user is not a Doctor 4.1. The system shows MSG13. 4.2. The use case ends. EF-05 (at any step): Session expired or system error 5.1. The system shows MSG12 or MSG80; no data is changed. 5.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | The patients and their visits are listed. No data is changed. Every search and every opened patient history is recorded in the audit log. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-35; Data rule: Medical data is access-controlled (I.3.3); Security: Audit trail (IV.2.3). |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG01, MSG08, MSG12, MSG13, MSG39, MSG50, MSG80 |  |  |

### **10.2 UC-52: View Medical Record Detail** {#10.2-uc-52:-view-medical-record-detail}

| Primary Actors | Doctor | Secondary Actors | None |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Doctor, I want to view the medical record of a visit, with the timeline of the patient’s other visits, so that I can make decisions based on the patient’s full history (BR-35). |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Doctor is signed in (UC-01). The Doctor has selected a visit in UC-51 or UC-34. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The system opens “Chi tiết Hồ sơ Bệnh án” of the selected visit and records the access in the audit log. The system shows the timeline of the patient’s visits (“Chọn một đợt khám để xem hồ sơ của đợt đó”), the selected one marked “Đang xem”. The system shows “Thông tin hành chính lượt khám” (“Mã lượt khám”, “Phòng khám tiếp nhận”, “Bác sĩ phụ trách”, “Đối tượng khám”, “Lý do vào viện / Triệu chứng ban đầu”, “Lịch sử chuyển phòng khám”) and “Chỉ số sinh hiệu (Vital Signs)” (pulse, temperature, blood pressure, breathing rate, SpO₂, height, weight, BMI). The system shows “Khám lâm sàng & Diễn biến bệnh” (“Quá trình bệnh lý”, “Tiền sử bệnh & yếu tố nguy cơ”, “Khám toàn thân”, “Khám bộ phận”) and “Chỉ định & Kết quả Cận lâm sàng” with only submitted results: lab values with “Khoảng tham chiếu” and “Đánh giá”, imaging description and conclusion, and the result images. The system shows “Chẩn đoán & Kết luận điều trị” (“Chẩn đoán sơ bộ”, “Chẩn đoán cuối cùng”, “Hướng điều trị”, “Lời dặn của bác sĩ”), “Đơn thuốc (Prescription)” and “Hẹn tái khám”. The Doctor selects another visit in the timeline; the system shows that visit from step 1\. The Doctor clicks “Quay lại danh sách hồ sơ” to return to UC-51, or “Xuất hồ sơ bệnh án” to start UC-53. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 7): The visit is the Doctor’s own unfinished visit 1.1. The system shows “Chỉnh sửa ca khám hiện tại”. 1.2. The button opens the clinical examination screen of the visit (UC-47); records of other visits are read-only (BR-35). AF-02 (at step 3): The visit was abandoned 2.1. The system shows the data recorded before the visit was abandoned with the label “Bỏ khám – không có kết luận” (BR-22). 2.2. The use case continues at step 4\. AF-03 (at step 4 or 5): A section has no data 3.1. The system shows “Không có chỉ định cận lâm sàng trong đợt khám này.”, “Không có đơn thuốc trong đợt khám này.” or “Không có lịch hẹn tái khám.” 3.2. The use case continues. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 1): The record does not exist 1.1. The system shows “Không thể hiển thị hồ sơ” and MSG39 (“Không tìm thấy hồ sơ bệnh án.”). 1.2. The use case ends. EF-02 (at step 4): A result image cannot be found 2.1. The system shows MSG39 (“Không tìm thấy tệp kết quả.”). 2.2. The use case continues at step 6\. EF-03 (at any step): Not a Doctor, session expired or system error 3.1. The system shows MSG13, MSG12 or MSG80; no data is changed. 3.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | The medical record is shown read-only. The access is recorded in the audit log. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-22, BR-32, BR-35; Data rule: Medical data is access-controlled (I.3.3). |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG12, MSG13, MSG39, MSG80 |  |  |

### **10.3 UC-53: Export Medical Record** {#10.3-uc-53:-export-medical-record}

| Primary Actors | Doctor | Secondary Actors | None |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Doctor, I want to export a closed medical record as a PDF file, so that it can be given to the patient, an authority or another facility, or kept, with every export logged (BR-35). |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Doctor is viewing a medical record (UC-52). The medical record is closed and has its electronic archive package (UC-58). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Doctor clicks “Xuất hồ sơ bệnh án”. The system shows the dialog “Xuất hồ sơ bệnh án (PDF)” with “Mục đích xuất”\* (“-- Chọn mục đích \--”, “Trao đổi dữ liệu”, “Lưu trữ”, “Cung cấp cho người bệnh”, “Cơ quan có thẩm quyền”) and “Người nhận” (required for “Cung cấp cho người bệnh” and “Cơ quan có thẩm quyền”, at most 200 characters). The Doctor fills in the dialog and clicks “Xuất PDF”. The system checks the purpose and the recipient; the server repeats the checks. The system creates the PDF from the archive package of the record (medical record form 15/BV1 layout) with the health department header, the exporting Doctor and the export time, and keeps a copy. The system records the export in the export log and the audit log (purpose and identifiers only, never the recipient text or medical content). The system downloads “BA-{storage number}-{time}.pdf” and shows MSG34. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 3): The Doctor cancels 1.1. The Doctor closes the dialog. 1.2. No file is created; the use case ends. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 1): The record is not closed yet 1.1. “Xuất hồ sơ bệnh án” is disabled with the tooltip “Chỉ xuất được hồ sơ bệnh án đã đóng.”; the server refuses an export of an open record with the same message. 1.2. The use case ends. EF-02 (at step 4): The input is not valid 2.1. The system shows MSG02 (“Mục đích xuất là bắt buộc.” or “Người nhận là bắt buộc.”), MSG05 for an unknown purpose or MSG08 (“Vượt quá độ dài tối đa 200 ký tự.”) under the field. 2.2. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-03 (at step 5): The file cannot be created or stored 3.1. The system shows MSG80; the failed export is recorded in the export log. 3.2. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-04 (at any step): Not a Doctor or session expired 4.1. The system shows MSG13 or MSG12; no file is created. 4.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the PDF is downloaded and the export is logged. No data of the record is changed. Failure or cancelled: no file is downloaded. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-32, BR-35, BR-43; Security: Audit trail (IV.2.3). |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG02, MSG05, MSG08, MSG12, MSG13, MSG34, MSG80 |  |  |

## **11\. Examination Conclusion** {#11.-examination-conclusion}

### **11.1 UC-54: View Paraclinical Ordered List** {#11.1-uc-54:-view-paraclinical-ordered-list}

| Primary Actors | Doctor | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Doctor, I want to see the paraclinical services I ordered for a patient's visit, so that I can follow their status, open each result and print the order slip. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Doctor is signed in (UC-01) and assigned to an examination room (BR-05). The Doctor has opened a visit of the room (UC-43). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Doctor opens the "Chỉ định cận lâm sàng" tab of the visit. The system shows the order slips of the visit, newest first. Each slip shows "Chỉ định lúc dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm" and the button "In phiếu chỉ định". Under each slip, the system lists its orders. Each order shows Mã chỉ định, Tên dịch vụ, Phòng thực hiện and Trạng thái, with the buttons "Xem kết quả" and "Hủy". If an order has no room yet, Phòng thực hiện shows "Phân phòng sau khi thanh toán" for an unpaid Dịch vụ visit, otherwise "Chưa xếp phòng" (BR-26, BR-28). A cancelled order also shows "Lý do: …" under its status. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 2): The visit has no order slip 1.1. The system shows MSG92. 1.2. The use case ends. AF-02 (at step 3): View an order's result 2.1. "Xem kết quả" is available only on orders with status "Đã có kết quả". 2.2. The Doctor clicks the order row or "Xem kết quả". 2.3. The result opens right below the row. The use case continues in UC-55. AF-03 (at step 3): Cancel a refused service 3.1. "Hủy" is shown only on orders that can still be cancelled: not paid yet (Dịch vụ visit) or not accepted by a Technician yet (BHYT visit) (BR-25). 3.2. The Doctor clicks "Hủy". The use case continues in UC-76. AF-04 (at step 2): Print the order slip 4.1. "In phiếu chỉ định" is hidden when the slip is "Đã hủy", when every order of the slip is "Đã hủy", or when the visit is "Bỏ khám". 4.2. The Doctor clicks "In phiếu chỉ định". The use case continues in UC-50. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 1): The user is not a Doctor 1.1. The system shows MSG13. 1.2. The use case ends. EF-02 (at step 1): The Doctor is not assigned to any room 2.1. The system shows MSG99. 2.2. The use case ends. EF-03 (at any step): Session expired or system error 3.1. Nothing is changed. 3.2. If the session has expired, the system ends the session and shows the Login screen (UC-01). The use case ends. 3.3. If a system error occurs, the system shows MSG80. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | The paraclinical orders of the visit are shown. No data is changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-02, BR-05, BR-25, BR-26, BR-28 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG13, MSG80, MSG92, MSG99 |  |  |

### **11.3 UC-56: Conclude Examination** {#11.3-uc-56:-conclude-examination}

| Primary Actors | Doctor | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Doctor, I want to record the final diagnosis in words with its ICD-10 codes, the treatment plan, the treatment result and the advice, so that the visit can be closed. The Doctor can conclude a visit of today that is assigned to them even after the shift has ended (BR-19, BR-20). |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Doctor is signed in (UC-01) and assigned to an examination room (BR-05). The visit belongs to the Doctor's room and is "Đang khám" or "Chờ kết luận". The medical record of the visit has not been closed (BR-32, BR-35). The "Kết luận & Hẹn tái khám" tab is enabled. That means one of these is true (BR-30, BR-41): every non-cancelled paraclinical order has a result; the patient refused all paraclinical services; no service was ordered. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Doctor opens the "Kết luận & Hẹn tái khám" tab of the visit. The system checks the permission, the room, the shift, the visit and the record status (BR-02, BR-05, BR-19, BR-20, BR-32). The system shows the preliminary diagnosis from UC-47 for reference, and the conclusion form with any saved data. The form has: Chẩn đoán\*, Bệnh chính (ICD-10)\*, Bệnh kèm theo (ICD-10), Hướng điều trị\*, Kết quả điều trị, Lời dặn\*, Tóm tắt bệnh án and Ghi chú (BR-106). The Doctor writes the diagnosis in words and selects the main and secondary diagnoses from the ICD-10 catalog. ICD-10 codes are searched by code or name among active codes. Each selected code is saved with its name at the time of selection (BR-31, BR-46). The Doctor fills in the other fields. The Doctor clicks "Lưu kết luận". The system validates the input (BR-31, BR-51, BR-106). The system saves the conclusion with the responsible Doctor and the time. It also stores the diagnosis codes as the main code followed by the secondary codes in the selected order, separated by ";" (e.g. "J02.9;K29.7"); the Doctor does not enter them (BR-106). The system records the audit log with the before and after values (BR-42). The system shows MSG03. The record stays open. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 6): The main diagnosis code is discouraged 1.1. The system shows MSG66 (BR-51). 1.2. If the Doctor keeps the code, the use case continues at step 7\. Otherwise, the use case returns to step 4\. AF-02 (at step 3): The conclusion was saved before 2.1. The system shows the saved conclusion in the form. 2.2. If a prescription has been submitted successfully, "Bệnh chính" and "Bệnh kèm theo" are read-only, because they were sent with the prescription (BR-47). The other fields can still be edited. 2.3. The use case continues at step 4\. AF-03 (at step 4): Leave with unsaved changes 3.1. The Doctor leaves the tab. The system shows MSG38. 3.2. If the Doctor selects "Tiếp tục chỉnh sửa", the use case returns to step 4\. 3.3. If the Doctor selects "Loại bỏ", unsaved changes are discarded, saved data is kept and the use case ends. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 2): No permission, or, within the shift, the visit is not in the Doctor's room or is assigned to another Doctor 1.1. The system shows MSG13 and prevents updates. 1.2. The use case ends. EF-02 (at step 2): Outside the shift, and the visit is not assigned to the Doctor today 2.1. The system shows MSG48 (BR-19, BR-20). 2.2. The use case ends. EF-03 (at step 2 or 7): The visit can no longer be concluded 3.1. If the medical record is already closed (for example, the Doctor closed it in another tab, UC-58), the system shows MSG68. 3.2. If the visit is no longer "Đang khám" or "Chờ kết luận", or was skipped (for example, the Doctor ordered more paraclinical services in another tab, or the visit was ended at the end of the day), the system shows MSG75. 3.3. Nothing is saved. The use case ends. EF-04 (at step 6): The ICD-10 code cannot be used 4.1. If the code is not active today, the system shows MSG40. 4.2. If the code has more detailed codes, the system shows MSG110. 4.3. If the code does not apply to the patient's sex, the system shows MSG111. 4.4. The use case returns to step 4\. EF-05 (at step 6): A required field is empty 5.1. If Chẩn đoán, Hướng điều trị or Lời dặn is empty or contains only spaces, the system shows MSG02 under the field. 5.2. The use case returns to step 4\. EF-06 (at step 6): The main or secondary diagnoses are invalid 6.1. If there is no main diagnosis, or the main diagnosis is repeated as a secondary diagnosis, the system shows MSG64. A secondary diagnosis selected twice is kept once. 6.2. If the code cannot be used as a main diagnosis, the system shows MSG65 (BR-51). 6.3. If more than 12 secondary diagnoses are selected, the system shows MSG112 (BR-106). 6.4. The use case returns to step 4\. EF-07 (at step 7): The conclusion was changed meanwhile 7.1. If the conclusion was changed in another tab, the system shows MSG75. Nothing is saved. 7.2. The use case ends. EF-08 (at any step): Session expired or system error 8.1. Nothing is saved. 8.2. If the session has expired, the system ends the session and shows the Login screen (UC-01). The use case ends. 8.3. If a system error occurs, the system shows MSG80. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the conclusion is saved in the visit’s medical record and recorded in the audit log. The record stays open for prescribing (UC-59, UC-90), follow-up (UC-61) and closing (UC-58). Failure or cancel: invalid data is not saved; previously saved data is kept. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-02, BR-05, BR-19, BR-30, BR-31, BR-32, BR-41, BR-42, BR-46, BR-47, BR-51, BR-55, BR-106 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG02, MSG03, MSG08, MSG12, MSG13, MSG38, MSG40, MSG48, MSG64, MSG65, MSG66, MSG68, MSG75, MSG80, MSG110, MSG111, MSG112 |  |  |

### **11.4 UC-57: Print Conclusion** {#11.4-uc-57:-print-conclusion}

| Primary Actors | Doctor | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Doctor, I want to print the confirmed examination conclusion, so that the patient keeps the result of the visit. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Doctor is signed in (UC-01) and is the Doctor of the visit. The medical record of the visit has been closed (UC-58). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Doctor clicks “In kết luận” on the visit. The system shows a preview of the conclusion slip: facility information (UC-77), patient information, visit code, visit date, examination room, final diagnosis with the main and secondary ICD-10 codes, treatment plan, treatment outcome, advice and the Doctor’s academic title and full name. The Doctor clicks “In”. The system sends the slip to the printer. |  |  |

The use case continues at step 2\. AF-02 (at step 3): Close the preview 2.1. The Doctor closes the preview; nothing is printed. 2.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 1): The conclusion is not confirmed yet 1.1. The system shows MSG61. 1.2. The use case ends. EF-02 (at step 2): The Doctor is not the Doctor of the visit 2.1. The system shows MSG13. Nothing is printed. 2.2. The use case ends. EF-03 (at any step): Session expired or system error 3.1. If the session has expired, the system ends the session and shows the Login screen (UC-01). If a system error occurs, the system shows MSG80. 3.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | The conclusion slip is printed. No data is changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-02, BR-31, BR-32, BR-35 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG12, MSG13, MSG49, MSG61, MSG80 |  |  |

### **11.5 UC-58: Close Medical Record** {#11.5-uc-58:-close-medical-record}

| Primary Actors | Doctor | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Doctor, I want to confirm the conclusion and close the medical record in one action, so that the visit is completed, the record is locked and archived, and the remaining charges go to the Cashier (BR-32). The Doctor can close a visit of today that is assigned to them even after the shift has ended (BR-19, BR-20). |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Doctor is signed in (UC-01) and assigned to the examination room (BR-05). Within the shift, the visit belongs to the Doctor's room. Outside the shift, the Doctor can only close a visit of today that is assigned to them (BR-19, BR-20). The conclusion of the visit has been saved (UC-56) and has no unsaved changes. Otherwise "Xác nhận kết luận" is disabled and the screen shows a hint to save the conclusion first. The medical record has not been closed. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Doctor clicks "Xác nhận kết luận". The system checks that every non-cancelled paraclinical order has a result (BR-30, BR-41), and that the prescription, if any, has been accepted by the national prescription system (BR-47). The system shows MSG27 with "Loại hồ sơ lưu trữ". The default is "Thông thường (10 năm)"; Tai nạn lao động, Tai nạn giao thông and Tâm thần are kept 20 years (BR-44, BR-126). The Doctor selects the category if needed and confirms. In one transaction, the system fixes the coverage rate and recalculates the pending charges (BR-27), locks the conclusion and the follow-up appointment if any, sets the visit to "Hoàn thành" with the closing time, and records the audit log (BR-42). For a BHYT visit, the pending charges stay "Chờ thu" and appear in the Cashier's waiting payment list (UC-69). Charges whose patient amount is 0 become "Miễn phí" (BR-15, BR-37). The system creates the archive record: archive number, data package, hash, and the retention date by the selected category (BR-44, BR-126). The system removes the visit from the room's lists and shows "Đã xác nhận kết luận. Lượt khám {mã lượt khám} đã hoàn thành." It then offers to print the conclusion (UC-57), the prescription (UC-60, if any) and the follow-up slip (UC-62, if any), or to go back to the waiting list ("Về danh sách chờ"). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 4): The Doctor does not confirm 1.1. The Doctor clicks "Hủy" in MSG27. Nothing is changed and the record stays open. 1.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 1): No permission, or outside the scope of the Doctor 1.1. If the user has no permission, or the visit is not the Doctor's, the system shows MSG13. 1.2. If it is outside the shift and the visit is not assigned to the Doctor today, the system shows "Bạn không được phân công phòng khám này hoặc đang ngoài ca trực." (BR-19, BR-20). 1.3. The use case ends. EF-02 (at step 2): Some paraclinical orders have no result 2.1. The system shows MSG25. 2.2. The use case ends. EF-03 (at step 2 or 5): The prescription has not been accepted 3.1. The system shows MSG67 with a link to the "Kê đơn" tab (BR-47). 3.2. The use case ends. EF-04 (at step 1 or 5): The record is already closed 4.1. The system shows MSG68. Nothing is changed. 4.2. The use case ends. EF-05 (at step 1 or 5): The visit is no longer "Đang khám" or "Chờ kết luận" 5.1. The system shows MSG75. Nothing is changed. 5.2. The use case ends. EF-06 (at step 5): The conclusion was changed in another tab after the check 6.1. The system shows MSG75. Nothing is changed. 6.2. The use case ends. EF-07 (at any step): Session expired or system error 7.1. The whole transaction is rolled back and the record stays open. 7.2. If the session has expired, the system ends the session and shows the Login screen (UC-01). The use case ends. 7.3. If a system error occurs, the system shows MSG80. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the conclusion is confirmed and the visit is "Hoàn thành". The record is locked, cannot be edited (BR-32, BR-35), and is archived with the retention date of the selected category (BR-126). BHYT charges wait for payment at the Cashier (BR-15). Failure or cancel: nothing is changed. The record stays open. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-02, BR-05, BR-15, BR-19, BR-20, BR-27, BR-30, BR-32, BR-35, BR-37, BR-41, BR-42, BR-44, BR-47, BR-126 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG13, MSG25, MSG27, MSG67, MSG68, MSG75, MSG80 |  |  |

### **11.6 UC-59: Prescribe Medication** {#11.6-uc-59:-prescribe-medication}

| Primary Actors | Doctor | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | s a Doctor, I want to create an electronic prescription from the medicine catalog, so that it can be sent to the national prescription system (simulated) and printed for the patient. The facility does not sell or dispense medication, so receipts never include drug costs (BR-33). The Doctor can finish the prescription for the visits of today that they called in, even after the shift has ended (BR-19, BR-20). |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Doctor is signed in (UC-01) and assigned to the examination room (BR-05). Within the shift, the visit belongs to the Doctor's room. Outside the shift, the Doctor can still prescribe for the visits of today that they called in; other visits cannot be changed (BR-19, BR-20). The conclusion of the visit has been saved (UC-56). Otherwise the tab shows MSG105. The medical record of the visit is not closed (BR-32). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Doctor opens the "Đơn thuốc" tab of the visit. The system checks the permission, the room, the shift, the conclusion, the record status and that the Doctor has a prescriber link code (BR-02, BR-05, BR-19, BR-20, BR-32, BR-49). The system shows the saved diagnosis, the patient's drug allergies for reference (BR-23), and the prescription form. Each drug line has "Thuốc", "Liều mỗi lần", "Số lần/ngày", "Số ngày", "Số lượng" and "Cách dùng". The prescription also has "Lưu ý" and "Lời dặn". The Doctor selects drugs from the active catalog and fills in each line. Only "Thông thường" drugs with a BYT code are shown (BR-33). The Doctor clicks "Lưu". The system checks the input (BR-107): at least one drug line, and no drug repeated; "Liều mỗi lần" 1–50 characters; "Số lần/ngày" 1–24; "Số ngày" 1–30, or up to 90 when the main or a secondary diagnosis is in Appendix VII of Circular 26/2025/TT-BYT; "Số lượng" greater than 0 and at most 9,999, with at most 2 decimal places; "Cách dùng" 2–255 characters; "Lưu ý" and "Lời dặn" at most 2,000 characters each. The system saves the prescription (one per visit, BR-33). On the first save, it generates the prescription code (BR-52). The change is recorded in the audit log (BR-42). The system shows MSG03. The Doctor can send the prescription (UC-90). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 3): The visit already has a prescription 1.1. The system shows the saved prescription for editing. The prescription code does not change (BR-52). 1.2. The use case continues at step 4\. AF-02 (at step 4): Remove a drug line 2.1. The Doctor clicks "Xóa" on a line. The system removes it. 2.2. The use case returns to step 4\. AF-03 (at step 4): Cancel 3.1. The Doctor clicks "Hủy". If there are unsaved changes, the system shows MSG38. 3.2. If the Doctor selects "Tiếp tục chỉnh sửa", the use case returns to step 4\. 3.3. If the Doctor selects "Loại bỏ", unsaved changes are discarded and the use case ends |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 2): The Doctor cannot prescribe for this visit 1.1. If the user has no permission, or the visit is not the Doctor's, the system shows MSG13. 1.2. If it is outside the shift and the visit was not called in by this Doctor today, the system shows "Bạn không được phân công phòng khám này hoặc đang ngoài ca trực." (BR-19, BR-20). 1.3. If the conclusion has not been saved, the system shows MSG105. 1.4. If the medical record is closed, the system shows MSG68. 1.5. The use case ends. EF-02 (at step 2): The prescription has already been sent successfully 2.1. The system shows the prescription read-only with MSG88 (BR-47). 2.2. The use case ends. EF-03 (at step 4 or 6): The input is invalid 3.1. If a drug is inactive, the system shows MSG40. If it is not in the "Thông thường" group, the system shows MSG103 (BR-33). 3.2. If the same drug is selected twice, the system shows MSG89. 3.3. If a required field is empty, or a value is invalid or too long, the system shows MSG02, MSG05 or MSG08 under the field. If "Số ngày" is more than 30 and no diagnosis is in Appendix VII, the system shows MSG106. 3.4. The use case returns to step 4\. EF-04 (at step 7): The prescription or the record changed meanwhile 4.1. If the prescription was changed in another tab, the system shows MSG75. If the record was closed, the system shows MSG68. Nothing is saved. 4.2. The use case ends. EF-05 (at any step): Session expired or system error 5.1. Nothing is saved. 5.2. If the session has expired, the system ends the session and shows the Login screen (UC-01). The use case ends. 5.3. If a system error occurs, the system shows MSG80. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the visit has one saved prescription with a unique code, ready to be sent (UC-90). No receipt is created for medication (BR-33). Failure or cancel: no change is saved. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-02, BR-05, BR-19, BR-23, BR-32, BR-33, BR-42, BR-47, BR-49, BR-52, BR-55, BR-65, BR-107, BR-119 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG02, MSG03, MSG05, MSG08, MSG13, MSG38, MSG40, MSG68, MSG75, MSG80, MSG88, MSG89, MSG103, MSG105, MSG106 |  |  |

### **11.7 UC-60: Print Prescription** {#11.7-uc-60:-print-prescription}

| Primary Actors | Doctor | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Doctor, I want to print the submitted prescription with its code, so that the patient can buy the medication outside the facility (BR-33). |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Doctor is signed in (UC-01). The prescription of the visit has been submitted successfully (UC-90). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Doctor clicks "In đơn thuốc". The system shows a preview of the prescription with the facility information (UC-77), the prescription code (BR-52), the patient information (name, age, gender, address, and the insurance card number if any), the main and secondary diagnoses with ICD-10 codes, the drug lines, the notes and advice, the follow-up date if any, and the Doctor's academic title and full name. The Doctor clicks "In". The system opens the print dialog with the print time on the edge of the slip. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 1): Reprint from the medical record 1.1. The Doctor opens the visit in the medical record (UC-52) and clicks "In đơn thuốc". 1.2. The use case continues at step 2\. AF-02 (at step 3): Close the preview 2.1. The Doctor closes the preview. Nothing is printed. 2.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 1): The prescription has not been sent successfully 1.1. The system shows MSG90. 1.2. The use case ends. EF-02 (at step 2): The facility information is not configured 2.1. The system shows "Chưa có thông tin cơ sở khám bệnh, chữa bệnh. Vui lòng liên hệ quản trị viên." Nothing is printed. 2.2. The use case ends. EF-03 (at any step): Session expired or system error 3.1. Nothing is printed and no data is changed. 3.2. If the session has expired, the system ends the session and shows the Login screen (UC-01). The use case ends. 3.3. If a system error occurs, the system shows MSG80. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | The print dialog of the prescription is opened. No data is changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-02, BR-33, BR-47, BR-52 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG80, MSG90 |  |  |

### **11.8 UC-61: Create Follow-up Appointment** {#11.8-uc-61:-create-follow-up-appointment}

| Primary Actors | Doctor | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Doctor, I want to set a follow-up date and advice for a patient who needs periodic monitoring, so that the patient comes back on time. Each visit has at most one appointment, and it is used once, within its validity period (BR-34, BR-124). The Doctor can schedule the appointment for a visit of today that is assigned to them even after the shift has ended (BR-19, BR-20). |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Doctor is signed in (UC-01) and assigned to the examination room (BR-05). Within the shift, the visit belongs to the Doctor's room. Outside the shift, the Doctor can only schedule for a visit of today that is assigned to them (BR-19, BR-20). The conclusion of the visit has been saved (UC-56). The medical record of the visit is not closed (BR-32). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Doctor opens the "Hẹn tái khám" tab of the visit. The system checks the permission, the room, the shift, the conclusion and the record status (BR-02, BR-05, BR-19, BR-20, BR-32). The system shows the form: "Ngày tái khám"\* and "Lời dặn tái khám". The Doctor fills in the form and clicks "Lưu". The system checks the input (BR-108): the date is after the visit date and at most 365 days later, and the advice is at most 2,000 characters. The system saves the appointment with status "Đã hẹn", linked to the visit and the patient. It generates the appointment slip number (BR-53) and records the audit log (BR-42). The system shows MSG04. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 3): The visit already has an appointment 1.1. The system shows the saved appointment for editing. 1.2. The Doctor changes it and clicks "Lưu". The system checks it as in step 5, saves it, records only the changed fields in the audit log, and shows MSG03. Saving without any change records nothing. 1.3. If the prescription has already been sent, the system shows "Đơn thuốc đã gửi với ngày tái khám {ngày}. Lịch hẹn thay đổi sau khi gửi không làm thay đổi đơn đã gửi." The sent prescription is not changed (BR-47). 1.4. The use case ends. AF-02 (at step 4): Cancel 2.1. The Doctor clicks "Hủy". If there are unsaved changes, the system shows MSG38. 2.2. If the Doctor selects "Tiếp tục chỉnh sửa", the use case returns to step 4\. 2.3. If the Doctor selects "Loại bỏ", unsaved changes are discarded and the use case ends. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 2): No permission, or outside the scope of the Doctor 1.1. If the user has no permission, or the visit is not the Doctor's, the system shows MSG13. 1.2. If it is outside the shift and the visit is not assigned to the Doctor today, the system shows "Bạn không được phân công phòng khám này hoặc đang ngoài ca trực." (BR-19, BR-20). 1.3. The use case ends. EF-02 (at step 2): The medical record is closed 2.1. The system shows MSG68. 2.2. The use case ends. EF-03 (at step 2 or 6): The visit has no saved conclusion 3.1. The system shows "Vui lòng lưu kết luận trước khi hẹn tái khám." Nothing is saved. 3.2. The use case ends. EF-04 (at step 5): The date is empty 4.1. The system shows MSG02. 4.2. The use case returns to step 4\. EF-05 (at step 5): The date is not after the visit date, or more than 365 days later 5.1. If the date is not after the visit date, the system shows MSG33. If it is more than 365 days after the visit date, the system shows "Ngày tái khám không được quá 365 ngày sau ngày khám." 5.2. The use case returns to step 4\. EF-06 (at step 5): The advice is too long 6.1. The system shows MSG08. 6.2. The use case returns to step 4\. EF-07 (at step 6): The appointment or the visit changed meanwhile 7.1. If the appointment was changed in another tab, the system shows MSG75. Nothing is saved. 7.2. If the visit is no longer "Đang khám" or "Chờ kết luận", the system shows MSG13. Nothing is saved. 7.3. The use case ends. EF-08 (at any step): Session expired or system error 8.1. Nothing is saved. 8.2. If the session has expired, the system ends the session and shows the Login screen (UC-01). The use case ends. 8.3. If a system error occurs, the system shows MSG80. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the visit has one appointment with status "Đã hẹn" and a unique slip number. It is locked when the record is closed (UC-58). At reception it can be used from the follow-up date until the end of its validity period (BR-34, BR-124). Failure or cancel: no change is saved. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-02, BR-05, BR-19, BR-20, BR-32, BR-34, BR-42, BR-47, BR-53, BR-108, BR-124 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG02, MSG03, MSG04, MSG08, MSG13, MSG33, MSG38, MSG68, MSG75, MSG80 |  |  |

| Primary Actors | Doctor | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Doctor, I want to print the follow-up appointment slip, so that the patient knows when to come back (BR-34). |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Doctor is signed in (UC-01). A follow-up appointment has been saved for the visit (UC-61). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Doctor clicks “In giấy hẹn”. The system shows a preview of the slip with the facility information (UC-77), the appointment slip number (BR-53), the patient code, name and date of birth, the diagnosis, the follow-up date and the validity period (BR-124), the advice, and the Doctor's academic title and full name. The Doctor clicks "In". The system opens the print dialog with the print time on the edge of the slip. |  |  |

The use case continues at step 2\. AF-02 (at step 3): Close the preview 2.1. The Doctor closes the preview. Nothing is printed. 2.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 2): The facility information is not configured 1.1. The system shows "Chưa có thông tin cơ sở khám bệnh, chữa bệnh. Vui lòng liên hệ quản trị viên." Nothing is printed. 1.2. The use case ends. EF-02 (at any step): Session expired or system error 2.1. Nothing is printed and no data is changed. 2.2. If the session has expired, the system ends the session and shows the Login screen (UC-01). The use case ends. 2.3. If a system error occurs, the system shows MSG80. The use case ends. |  |  |
