## **12\. Paraclinical Service** {#12.-paraclinical-service}

### **12.1 UC-63: View Waiting Paraclinical List** {#12.1-uc-63:-view-waiting-paraclinical-list}

| Primary Actors | Technician | Secondary Actors | None |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Technician, I want to see the paraclinical services routed to my room, split into patients who have not arrived yet, patients in the room queue and skipped patients, so that I know whom to confirm and call next. Services reach the room after payment is confirmed or, for an insurance visit or a zero-amount order, as soon as they are ordered (BR-26), and are routed to an active room of the service group (BR-28). |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Technician is signed in and is assigned to an Active paraclinical room (UC-15). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Technician opens “Danh sách chờ & Phân loại” and selects their paraclinical room. The system shows today’s figures of the room and three tabs: “Chờ tiếp nhận / Chưa đến” (default), “Hàng đợi vào phòng” and “Đã bỏ qua”. Tab “Chờ tiếp nhận / Chưa đến” lists the released services of the room whose patient has not been confirmed present yet (no queue number). Tab “Hàng đợi vào phòng” lists the services whose patient was confirmed present and has a queue number, including services in progress and services waiting for their result. Each row shows: queue number, priority mark, patient name and code, visit type, services, ordering doctor and room, time and status. Services of the same order slip in the same room are shown together. The system orders the lists: priority patients first, then patients already present, then by queue number, then by order time (BR-14, BR-18). The system refreshes the list every 10 seconds while the screen is visible (UI-04). The Technician confirms a patient present or calls the next patient in the room queue. The use case continues in UC-65. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 3): Search and filter 1.1. The Technician types a keyword (patient code, order code, full name, citizen ID or insurance number) or filters by ordering room or status. 1.2. The system shows the matching rows. 1.3. The use case continues at step 8\. AF-02 (at step 3 or 4): The tab is empty 2.1. The system shows an empty-list message in the tab. 2.2. The use case continues at step 7\. AF-03 (at step 2): The Technician opens “Đã bỏ qua” 3.1. The system shows the skipped patients of the room with their skip time. 3.2. The use case continues in UC-45. AF-04 (at step 1): The Technician is not on duty in the room now 4.1. The system shows the lists read-only with MSG48; the actions are disabled. 4.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 1): The Technician is not assigned to any room 1.1. The system shows MSG99 and an empty list. 1.2. The use case ends. EF-02 (at any step): Session expired or system error 2.1. The system shows MSG12 or MSG80 and keeps the last loaded list. 2.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | The Technician sees the lists of their room. No data is changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-14, BR-18, BR-19, BR-26, BR-28; UI-04 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG12, MSG48, MSG80, MSG99 |  |  |

### **12.2 UC-64: View Pending Result List** {#12.2-uc-64:-view-pending-result-list}

| Primary Actors | Technician | Secondary Actors | None |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Technician, I want to see the services of my room that were performed but whose results are not submitted yet, so that every result is entered and submitted on time. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Technician is signed in and is assigned to an Active paraclinical room. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Technician opens “Nhập kết quả” and selects their paraclinical room. The system shows the figures of the room (total, not started, draft saved, waiting 30 minutes or more) and the services of the room that were performed but whose result is not submitted (BR-29): patient name and code, order code, service, ordering doctor and room, time since it was performed and whether a draft is saved. The system orders the list: priority patients first, then by queue number. The Technician selects a service and opens its result form. The use case continues in UC-67. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 2): Search and filter 1.1. The Technician types a keyword (patient name or code, order code, citizen ID, insurance number or service name) or filters by status (not started / draft saved) or ordering room. 1.2. The system shows the matching services. 1.3. The use case continues at step 4\. AF-02 (at step 2): The list is empty 2.1. The system shows an empty-list message. 2.2. The use case ends. AF-03 (at step 1): The Technician is not on duty in the room now 3.1. The list is read-only with MSG48; only the technician who performed a service can record its result (BR-29). 3.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 1): The Technician is not assigned to any room 1.1. The system shows MSG99. 1.2. The use case ends. EF-02 (at any step): Session expired or system error 2.1. The system shows MSG12 or MSG80. 2.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | The pending results of the room are shown. No data is changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-19, BR-29 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG12, MSG48, MSG80, MSG99 |  |  |

### **12.3 UC-65: Accept Paraclinical Order** {#12.3-uc-65:-accept-paraclinical-order}

| Primary Actors | Technician | Secondary Actors | None |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Technician, I want to confirm that a patient has arrived at my room, call the patients of the room queue and accept the one who comes in, so that I can start performing the service; if the patient is absent, the service moves to the skipped list (BR-20, BR-21). Only released services (paid, or insurance and zero-amount orders) can be confirmed (BR-26). |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Technician is viewing the lists of their room (UC-63) and is on duty in the room. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | In tab “Chờ tiếp nhận / Chưa đến”, the Technician clicks “Xác nhận có mặt” on the patient who has arrived at the room. The system checks that the service is released (paid, or an insurance or zero-amount order – BR-26), still waiting and not checked in yet. The system gives the next paraclinical queue number of the room for today to the service and to the other waiting services of the same order slip in the same room, records the check-in time and the technician, writes the audit log and moves the patient to tab “Hàng đợi vào phòng”. The Technician calls the patients in the order of the room queue. When the patient comes in, the Technician clicks “Tiếp nhận”. The system sets the service, and the other checked-in waiting services of the same order slip in the same room, to In Progress, assigns them to the Technician with the start time and writes the audit log. The system shows the service as In Progress with the actions “Đã thực hiện” and “Trả về” (UC-66). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 5): The patient is absent 1.1. The Technician clicks “Bỏ qua”. 1.2. The system marks the service, and the other waiting services of the same order slip in the same room, as skipped with the skip time and moves them to tab “Đã bỏ qua” (BR-21). 1.3. The use case ends; the patient can be accepted again later (UC-46). AF-02 (at step 6): Several services of the same order slip in the room 2.1. All checked-in waiting services of that slip in the room are accepted together. 2.2. The use case continues at step 7\. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 2): The service is not paid 1.1. The system shows an error; the patient is not checked in. 1.2. The use case ends. EF-02 (at step 2): The patient is already checked in or the service is no longer waiting 2.1. The system shows an error and refreshes the list. 2.2. The use case returns to step 1\. EF-03 (at step 5): The patient has not been confirmed present 3.1. The system does not accept the service; the Technician confirms the patient present first. 3.2. The use case returns to step 1\. EF-04 (at any step): The Technician is not on duty in the room 4.1. The system shows MSG48; nothing is changed. 4.2. The use case ends. EF-05 (at any step): Session expired or system error 5.1. The system shows MSG12 or MSG80; nothing is changed. 5.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Present: the order is In Progress and assigned to the Technician. Absent: the order is Skipped until the patient returns (UC-46) or the day ends; at the end of the day it is cancelled and the visit becomes Abandoned (BR-22). |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-18, BR-19, BR-20, BR-21, BR-22, BR-26 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG12, MSG48, MSG80 |  |  |

### **12.4 UC-66: Perform Paraclinical Order**

| Primary Actors | Technician | Secondary Actors | None |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Technician, I want to confirm that the accepted service has been performed, so that the order status is updated and the result can be entered. The service itself (ultrasound, X-ray, CT, MRI, endoscopy, ECG, laboratory tests) is performed with the equipment outside the system; results are entered manually (SW-04). |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The order is In Progress and assigned to the Technician (UC-65 or UC-46). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Technician performs the service with the patient (with the paraclinical doctor where required, e.g. ultrasound or endoscopy teams). The Technician clicks “Đã thực hiện” on the service. The system sets the service, and the other services of the same order slip in the same room that this Technician is performing, to Performed with the performed time, and adds them to the pending result list (UC-64). The system shows MSG03 (“Chỉ định cập nhật thành công.”); the service now appears in “Nhập kết quả” (UC-64, UC-67). The patient goes to the next paraclinical room if the visit has other orders, or waits for the results and then returns to the original Doctor. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 2): The result is entered right away (e.g. ECG) 1.1. While the service is still In Progress, the Technician opens its result form and enters the result (UC-67); a service In Progress or Performed by this Technician can receive a result. 1.2. The use case continues in UC-67. AF-02 (at step 1): The service cannot be performed now 2.1. The Technician clicks “Trả về”, picks a reason (“Bệnh nhân chưa chuẩn bị (chưa nhịn ăn, chưa uống nước, chưa nhịn tiểu…)”, “Máy/thiết bị gặp sự cố”, “Bệnh nhân cần chờ bác sĩ chuyên khoa”) or types one in “Lý do \*” (at most 500 characters). 2.2. The system puts the service back to Waiting in the room queue with its queue number, records the reason in the audit log and shows “Đã trả chỉ định về hàng chờ.” 2.3. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at AF-02 step 2.1): The reason is empty or too long 1.1. The system shows “Lý do trả về hàng chờ là bắt buộc.” or “Vượt quá độ dài tối đa 500 ký tự.” (MSG08); the server repeats the check. 1.2. The use case returns to AF-02 step 2.1. EF-02 (at step 2): The service is not In Progress or not assigned to this Technician 2.1. The system shows “Chỉ định không còn ở trạng thái đang thực hiện. Vui lòng tải lại danh sách.” or MSG13. 2.2. The use case ends. EF-03 (at step 3): Session expired or system error 3.1. The system shows MSG12 or MSG80 (“Đã có lỗi hệ thống. Vui lòng thử lại sau.”); the service stays In Progress. 3.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the order is Performed and waits for its result. Failure: the order stays In Progress. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-19, BR-29 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG03, MSG08, MSG12, MSG13, MSG80 |  |  |

 

### **12.5 UC-67: Record Paraclinical Result**

| Primary Actors | Technician | Secondary Actors | Cloudinary Upload API (result files) |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Technician, I want to enter, review and submit the result of a service I performed (content, conclusion, files), so that it is attached to the patient's medical record and sent to the examining Doctor. A Technician can only record results for services they performed, and a submitted result cannot be edited (BR-29). |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The order is Performed (or In Progress, UC-66 AF-01) and the Technician is its performer. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Technician opens the order from the pending result list (UC-64). The system shows the result form with the patient, the service and the preliminary diagnosis. For a laboratory test: sample time (not in the future) and one value per parameter of the service with its unit and reference range; the system suggests the abnormal flag (low, high or abnormal – BR-133). For imaging and functional tests: technique (CT/MRI), description (every section is required for endoscopy and ECG), conclusion\*, recommendation, image link and result images (JPG or PNG only, at most 10 images, each at most 10 MB; a laboratory test has no images). The Technician may select the instrument used and click “Điền mẫu” to fill the normal-result template of the service. The Technician enters the result and uploads the files. The system uploads the files to the file storage (Cloudinary Upload API) and keeps their protected links. The Technician clicks Save draft to review, then Submit. The system checks the required fields and the images: an imaging or functional result needs at least one uploaded image or an image link, and a selected instrument must belong to the room and match the service type. The system asks for confirmation (MSG06): “Bạn có chắc muốn gửi kết quả? Sau khi gửi, kết quả bị khóa và không thể sửa.” with “Gửi kết quả”. The Technician confirms. The system saves and locks the result, sets the order to Completed, attaches the result to the medical record of the visit and records it in the audit log (BR-29). The system checks whether every order of the visit has a result; if so, the visit at once becomes Waiting for Conclusion and appears in the conclusion waiting list of the original room (UC-54) (BR-18, BR-28). The system shows “Đã lưu kết quả và gửi cho bác sĩ chỉ định.” and the action “In phiếu kết quả” (UC-68). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 5): Save draft only 1.1. The Technician clicks Save draft. 1.2. The system saves the draft without locking it and shows “Đã lưu nháp kết quả.” (MSG03); the service stays in “Nhập kết quả”. 1.3. The use case ends. AF-02 (at step 10): Other orders of the visit are still not completed 2.1. The visit stays Waiting for Paraclinical; the Doctor sees the progress (UC-54). 2.2. The use case continues at step 11\. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 6): A field is missing or not valid 1.1. The system marks the fields (“Vui lòng nhập {field}.”, “Phải là số”, “Vui lòng tải lên ít nhất 1 ảnh kết quả.”, “Link xem ảnh không đúng định dạng.”) and shows “Vui lòng sửa các ô được đánh dấu.”; an image that is not JPG/PNG or is over 10 MB, or an 11th image, is refused (“Ảnh không hợp lệ: chỉ nhận ảnh JPG hoặc PNG tối đa 10 MB.”, “Mỗi kết quả chỉ được đính kèm tối đa 10 ảnh.”). 1.2. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-02 (at step 4): The upload fails 2.1. The system shows “Không tải được ảnh lên kho lưu trữ. Vui lòng thử lại.” (or that the storage is not configured); the entered text is kept. 2.2. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-03 (at step 6): The selected instrument is no longer available 3.1. The system shows MSG40 (“Máy thực hiện đã chọn hiện không còn khả dụng. Vui lòng chọn mục khác.”). 3.2. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-04 (at step 1): The Technician is not the performer, or the service was not performed yet 4.1. The form is read-only and the system shows “Bạn không có quyền thực hiện thao tác này. Chỉ người thực hiện dịch vụ mới được nhập kết quả.” (MSG13), or “Chỉ định chưa được xác nhận thực hiện nên chưa thể nhập kết quả.” 4.2. The use case ends. EF-05 (at step 1): The result was already submitted 5.1. The system shows “Kết quả đã được gửi nên không thể sửa nữa.”; the result is read-only. 5.2. The use case ends. EF-06 (at step 9): Session expired or system error 6.1. The system shows MSG12 or MSG80; the result is not submitted. 6.2. The use case returns to step 5\. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the result is locked and attached to the medical record; the order is Completed; when all orders are completed the visit is Waiting for Conclusion. Failure: the result is not submitted (a draft may be saved). |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-18, BR-19, BR-28, BR-29; Data rules: One result per order item, Medical data is access-controlled (I.3.3); SW-04 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG02, MSG03, MSG05, MSG06, MSG12, MSG13, MSG40, MSG80 |  |  |

 

### **12.6 UC-68: Print Paraclinical Result**

| Primary Actors | Technician | Secondary Actors | None |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Technician, I want to print the paraclinical result for the patient, so that the patient keeps a paper copy of the result. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The result of the order has been submitted (UC-67). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Technician clicks “In phiếu kết quả” on a submitted result. The system builds the result form (PF-03): hospital name, patient information, registration code, service, ordering Doctor, result content, images (if any), result conclusion, Technician (and paraclinical doctor), performed and submitted time. The system records the print and opens the browser print dialog with a preview; from the second print the button reads “In lại (bản sao)” and the form is marked “BẢN SAO”. The Technician hands the result to the patient. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 1): Reprint 1.1. The Technician opens the completed service again and clicks “In lại (bản sao)”. 1.2. The use case continues at step 2; the form is marked “BẢN SAO”. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 1): The result is not submitted yet 1.1. The print button is not available (drafts cannot be printed). 1.2. The use case ends. EF-02 (at step 2): The clinic information is missing or the Technician is not the performer 2.1. The system shows “Chưa cấu hình thông tin phòng khám (UC-77) nên chưa in được phiếu kết quả.” or “Chỉ người thực hiện dịch vụ mới in phiếu kết quả.”; nothing is printed. 2.2. The use case ends. EF-03 (at step 3): The print fails 3.1. The system shows “Không thể in phiếu kết quả. Vui lòng kiểm tra máy in và thử lại.” 3.2. The use case returns to step 1\. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | The patient receives the printed result. No data is changed (the print is logged). |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-29 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG13 |  |  |

## **13\. Payment** {#13.-payment}

### **13.1 UC-69: View Waiting Payment List**

| Primary Actors | Cashier | Secondary Actors | None |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Cashier, I want to see the pending receipts created automatically by the system — examination fee receipts at registration and paraclinical receipts when a Doctor confirms an order — so that I can collect the fees of the patients at the counter. Receipts are generated by the system; the Cashier cannot create them manually (BR-36). |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Cashier is signed in (UC-01). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | *The Cashier opens the Cashier Dashboard (home screen after sign-in) or selects Waiting Payment List. The system shows the receipts with status Pending: receipt number, type (Examination fee / Paraclinical fee), registration code, patient code and name, priority mark, visit type and coverage rate, created time, total amount, insurance amount, patient amount (BR-27). The system orders the list by created time (priority patients highlighted) and refreshes it automatically (UI-04). The Cashier filters by type or searches (UC-70) for the patient at the counter. The Cashier selects a receipt. The use case continues in UC-71.* |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 2): The list is empty 1.1. The system shows MSG01. 1.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 1): The user is not a Cashier 1.1. The system shows MSG13. 1.2. The use case ends. EF-02 (at any step): Session expired or system error 2.1. The system shows MSG12 or MSG80. 2.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | The pending receipts are shown. No data is changed. Receipts still Pending at the end of the day are cancelled by the end-of-day job (BR-22). |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-15, BR-22, BR-26, BR-27, BR-36, BR-37; Permission Matrix 4.4 (Invoice) |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG01, MSG12, MSG13, MSG80 |  |  |

 

### **13.2 UC-70: Search Payment**

| Primary Actors | Cashier | Secondary Actors | None |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Cashier, I want to search for a receipt by receipt number, patient name or code, or registration code, so that I can quickly find the receipt of the patient at the counter or answer a question about a past payment. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Cashier is signed in (UC-01). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Cashier enters a keyword in the search box of the payment management screen, and may choose a status, a type and a date range. The system validates the keyword (at least 2 characters) and the date range (from date not after to date – BR-111). The system searches all receipts (Pending, Paid, Exempt, Cancelled) by receipt code (HD…), receipt number (PT…), registration code, patient code (case-insensitive) or patient name (case- and accent-insensitive – BR-110), with the optional filters status, type and creation date range. The system shows the matching receipts: receipt code / visit, patient, payment type, amount to collect, status. The Cashier selects a receipt: a Pending receipt opens Confirm Payment (UC-71); a Paid receipt opens its detail with Print (UC-72); a Cancelled receipt opens read-only. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | None |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 2): Keyword too short or start date after end date 1.1. The system shows “Từ khóa tìm kiếm phải có ít nhất 2 ký tự.” or “Khoảng thời gian không hợp lệ: ngày bắt đầu phải trước hoặc bằng ngày kết thúc.” and does not search; the server repeats the checks. 1.2. The use case returns to step 1\. EF-02 (at step 4): No receipt matches 2.1. The system shows “Không tìm thấy kết quả phù hợp.” 2.2. The use case returns to step 1\. EF-03 (at any step): Session expired or system error 3.1. The system shows MSG12 or MSG80. 3.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | The matching receipts are shown. No data is changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-36, BR-37, BR-110, BR-111 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG12, MSG80 |  |  |

 

### **13.3 UC-71: Confirm Payment**

| Primary Actors | Cashier | Secondary Actors | PayOS (bank-transfer QR) |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Cashier, I want to confirm that the patient has paid a receipt and record the payment method, so that the patient can continue: an examination fee puts the visit in the room's examination waiting list, and a paraclinical fee releases the orders of UC-49 and routes them to the least busy room that performs each service (BR-15, BR-26, BR-28). A visit whose examination fee has a patient amount pays it before the examination, and pays one paraclinical fee for each order before the paraclinical rooms. The software only records the "paid" confirmation (BR-36). A pending receipt of an insurance visit can be paid only after the Doctor concludes the visit (BR-15, BR-26). |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Cashier has selected a Pending receipt (UC-69 or UC-70). The patient is at the counter. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The system shows the receipt detail: receipt code, type, patient, registration code, visit type and coverage rate, and the lines: service, code, quantity, unit price, insurance amount, patient amount; totals (BR-27). Receipts never contain medication (BR-33). The Cashier tells the patient the amount to pay. The Cashier chooses Collect cash (Thu tiền mặt tại quầy), or shows the PayOS bank-transfer QR code (Thanh toán QR PayOS – BR-109). The system checks that the receipt is still Pending (the receipt is locked while it is confirmed – BR-118). For cash, the system shows the dialog “Xác nhận thu tiền mặt” with the amount and “Ghi chú (tùy chọn)”; for PayOS, the system shows the QR code with its expiry countdown and checks the payment every 3 seconds. The Cashier confirms (for PayOS: the payment is confirmed only when PayOS itself reports it paid). The system sets the receipt to Paid with the payment method, Cashier, paid time and receipt number (PT \+ date \+ receipt code – BR-53), and records it in the audit log (BR-37). The system continues the visit according to the receipt type: – Examination fee: the visit gets its queue number, becomes Waiting and appears in the examination waiting list of its room (BR-15, BR-18); – Paraclinical fee: each service becomes Waiting and is routed to the active room of its service group that has a technician on the current shift and the fewest waiting services (if no room has a technician on shift, among all active rooms; ties: lower room code – BR-26, BR-28). The patient gets a paraclinical queue number when the Technician confirms they are present (UC-65). The system shows “Đã xác nhận thanh toán phiếu {receipt number}.” with the queue number and room (examination fee) or the room and queue of each paraclinical service, and opens the receipt print (UC-72). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 2): The patient does not agree to pay now 1.1. The Cashier closes the receipt without confirming; it stays Pending. 1.2. If it is not paid by the end of the day, it is cancelled and the visit becomes Abandoned (BR-22). 1.3. The use case ends. AF-02 (at step 8): No Active room performs a service 2.1. The order stays Waiting without a room. 2.2. The system warns the Cashier ("Chưa có phòng đang hoạt động cho …") and the audit entry lists the service. 2.3. The use case continues at step 9\. AF-03 (at step 3): The receipt belongs to an insurance visit that is not concluded yet 3.1. Instead of the payment buttons the system shows “Chờ kết luận (BHYT)”; if the payment is still attempted, the server refuses it and the system shows “Lượt khám BHYT chỉ thanh toán sau khi bác sĩ xác nhận kết luận.” 3.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 4): The receipt is no longer Pending (already paid, exempt or cancelled) 1.1. The system shows “Phiếu thu {receipt number} đã được {thanh toán / miễn phí / hủy}.” and reloads the receipt list. 1.2. The use case ends. EF-02 (at step 7): Session expired or system error 2.1. The system shows MSG12, MSG13 or MSG80 (“Đã xảy ra lỗi. Vui lòng thử lại hoặc liên hệ quản trị viên.”). 2.2. The receipt stays Pending (all or nothing); the use case returns to step 3\. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the receipt is Paid and cannot be edited or deleted; the patient is in the room's examination waiting list (examination fee) or each order is in the waiting list of its paraclinical room (paraclinical fee). Failure / Cancelled: the receipt stays Pending. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-15, BR-18, BR-22, BR-26, BR-27, BR-28, BR-33, BR-36, BR-37, BR-53, BR-109, BR-118; Data rule: Paid payments are permanent (I.3.3) |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG12, MSG13, MSG80 |  |  |

 

### **13.4 UC-72: Print Payment Receipt**

| Primary Actors | Cashier | Secondary Actors | None |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Cashier, I want to print the receipt for the patient after the payment is confirmed, so that the patient has proof of payment and, for paraclinical fees, knows the rooms to go to. Receipts can only be printed after payment is confirmed, or when the receipt is Exempt (BR-36, BR-37). |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The receipt is Paid (UC-71) or Exempt. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Cashier clicks Print Receipt (In phiếu thu) on the receipt detail (the system also opens the print right after UC-71 on that screen). The system builds the receipt (PF-06): facility name, receipt number, patient name and code, registration code, visit type and coverage rate, room, lines with service, unit price, insurance amount and patient amount, totals, payment method, Cashier, paid time. For a paraclinical receipt, the system adds the assigned room of each service (BR-28), or "Chưa có phòng thực hiện" (UC-71 AF-02); for an examination fee receipt, the room and queue number of the visit. The system records the print in the audit log, shows a preview and opens the print dialog of the browser. The Cashier hands the receipt to the patient. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 1): Reprint (from UC-70 or UC-73) 1.1. The Cashier opens a Paid receipt and clicks Print. 1.2. From the second print, the receipt is marked "BẢN SAO" and the reprint is logged. 1.3. The use case continues at step 4\. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 1): The receipt is not Paid or Exempt 1.1. The system shows “Chỉ in được phiếu thu sau khi đã xác nhận thanh toán.” and does not print. 1.2. The use case ends. EF-02 (at step 4): The printer fails 2.1. Printing is done by the browser print dialog, which does not report printer errors to the system; the Cashier prints again from the receipt detail. 2.2. The payment is not affected; the use case ends. EF-03 (at any step): Session expired or system error 3.1. The system shows MSG12, MSG13 or MSG80. 3.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | The patient receives the printed receipt. No business data is changed; each print is in the audit log. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-27, BR-28, BR-33, BR-36, BR-37 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG12, MSG13, MSG80 |  |  |

 

### **13.5 UC-73: View Payment History**

| Primary Actors | Cashier | Secondary Actors | None |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Cashier, I want to view the history of receipts that have been paid or cancelled, so that I can check what I collected during my shift and answer patients' questions. Paid receipts cannot be changed (BR-37). |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Cashier is signed in (UC-01). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Cashier selects Payment History (Lịch sử thanh toán). The system shows the filters: From date and To date (default: today), Status (Tất cả, Đã thanh toán, Đã hủy), Type (Phí khám, Cận lâm sàng), Payment method (Tiền mặt, Chuyển khoản, Thẻ), Cashier (Của tôi – default, Tất cả thu ngân), Sort (time newest/oldest, amount highest/lowest) and a keyword (receipt code, receipt number, registration code, patient code or patient name; at least 2 characters). The Cashier selects the filters and clicks “Tìm kiếm”. The system shows the receipts whose paid or cancelled time is in the range: receipt number, type, status, patient, registration code, time, payment method, patient amount, insurance amount; plus the patient amount per payment method and the total over all matching Paid receipts. The Cashier selects a receipt. The system shows its detail (lines, amounts) and the Print action for Paid receipts (UC-72). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | **None** |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 3): Start date after end date, or keyword too short 1.1. The system shows “Khoảng thời gian không hợp lệ: ngày bắt đầu phải trước hoặc bằng ngày kết thúc.” or “Từ khóa tìm kiếm phải có ít nhất 2 ký tự.” and does not search; the server repeats the checks. 1.2. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-02 (at step 4): No receipt matches 2.1. The system shows “Không tìm thấy kết quả phù hợp.” 2.2. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-03 (at any step): Session expired or system error 3.1. The system shows MSG12 or MSG80. 3.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | The payment history is shown. No data is changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-22, BR-36, BR-37, BR-111 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG12, MSG80 |  |  |

## **14\. System Administration**

### **14.1 UC-77: Update Clinic Facility Information** 

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to declare and update the information of the clinic facility (facility code, name, address, phone, operating licence number, organization form), so that it is printed correctly on examination tickets, receipts and other documents. The facility code cannot change once a visit exists, because it is printed on examination documents (BR-48). |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in and does not have to change the password first (UC-01, UC-03). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin opens Hospital Information (Thông tin bệnh viện). The system shows the current information and its status (code locked or still changeable, last updated), or an empty form with the button "Khai báo cơ sở" when the facility has not been declared yet. The Admin edits the fields: Facility code (Mã cơ sở KBCB)\*, Facility name\*, Address\*, Phone\*, Operating licence number\*, Organization form\*. The facility code field is disabled when a visit exists. The Admin clicks Save (Lưu thay đổi). The button stays disabled until a field changes. The system checks the fields (BR-66): facility code exactly 5 digits; name at most 255 characters; address at most 1,024 characters; phone: mobile 0\[3\|5\|7\|8\|9\] \+ 8 digits, landline 02 \+ 9 digits, or 1800/1900 hotline; licence number at most 100 characters; organization form chosen from the list. Leading and trailing spaces are removed. The server repeats the check. The system checks that the information was not changed by another user since it was opened (BR-119) and that the facility code is not changed after the first visit (BR-48). The system saves the information and records the changed fields with old and new values in the audit log. The system shows “Đã cập nhật thông tin cơ sở.” (or “Đã khai báo thông tin cơ sở.” for the first declaration) and the saved information. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 4): The address or the organization form was changed 1.1. The system reminds the Admin to check the operating licence number ("Kiểm tra giấy phép hoạt động"). 1.2. The Admin clicks "Vẫn lưu" to continue, or "Quay lại sửa" to return to step 3\. 1.3. The use case continues at step 5\. AF-02 (at step 4): Nothing was changed 2.1. Save stays disabled; nothing is saved and no audit entry is written. 2.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 5): Required field empty, too long or wrong format 1.1. The system shows under the field “Vui lòng nhập {field}.”, “{field} không được vượt quá {max} ký tự.”, “Mã cơ sở KBCB gồm đúng 5 chữ số.” or “Số điện thoại không đúng định dạng.”, with “Vui lòng sửa các ô được đánh dấu.”; the server answers “Một số thông tin chưa hợp lệ. Vui lòng kiểm tra lại.” for a value it refuses. 1.2. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-02 (at step 6): The facility code is changed after the first visit 2.1. The system shows MSG91, reloads the saved code and keeps the other edits. 2.2. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-03 (at step 6): The information was changed by another user 3.1. The system shows “Thông tin cơ sở vừa được thay đổi bởi thao tác khác. Dữ liệu mới nhất đã được tải lại, vui lòng kiểm tra rồi lưu lại.” and reloads the latest information. 3.2. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-04 (at step 1): The user is not an Admin 4.1. The system shows MSG13. 4.2. The use case ends. EF-05 (at any step): Session expired or system error 5.1. The system shows MSG12, MSG96 (server cannot be reached) or MSG80. 5.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the facility information is saved and used on documents printed afterwards; documents already printed are not changed. The change is in the audit log. Failure: nothing is changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-48, BR-66, BR-119 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG12, MSG13, MSG80, MSG91, MSG96 |  |  |

### **14.1 UC-78: View Audit Log** 

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to search and view the business audit log, so that I can trace who did what, when and on which data (BR-42). The log can only be viewed; it cannot be changed or deleted. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in (UC-01). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin selects “Quản trị hệ thống” \> “Nhật ký hệ thống” in the menu. The system shows the page “Nhật ký hệ thống” (“Ai đã làm gì, lúc nào, trên dữ liệu nào. Nhật ký chỉ xem, không sửa hay xóa được.”) with the filters “Từ khóa” (“Tìm theo tên đăng nhập, họ tên người thực hiện, số vào viện hoặc mã...”), “Từ ngày”, “Đến ngày”, “Hành động” (Tạo mới, Cập nhật, Hủy, Xóa, Khôi phục, Khóa, Mở khóa, Xem dữ liệu, In, Xuất dữ liệu, Ký số), “Đối tượng” (accounts, facility, patients, visits, medical records, prescriptions, payments, services…) and “Kết quả” (Thành công / Thất bại). The system displays the entries, newest first, 20 per page: “Thời gian” (clinic time), “Người thực hiện” (full name and role, “Tác vụ tự động” for a background job), “Hành động”, “Đối tượng”, “Số vào viện”, “Kết quả” and “Chi tiết”, with the total and the page size selector “Số dòng/trang”. The Admin changes the keyword or the filters. The system reloads the list from page 1\. The keyword is matched literally (“%” and “\_” are not wildcards) against the username, the full name, the visit number and the entity code; a full identifier finds that exact row. The Admin clicks “Chi tiết” of an entry. The system shows “Chi tiết nhật ký” with the time, actor, action, entity, outcome, “Mã yêu cầu”, “Địa chỉ IP” and “Dữ liệu ghi nhận” (“Trường”, “Giá trị cũ”, “Giá trị mới”; “Không có dữ liệu chi tiết.” when nothing was recorded). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 3): Change page or refresh 1.1. The Admin changes the page, the number of rows per page, or clicks “Làm mới”. 1.2. The system shows the requested page with the same filters. 1.3. The use case returns to step 4\. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 4): “Từ ngày” is after “Đến ngày” 1.1. The system shows “Từ ngày không được sau đến ngày.” and does not search. 1.2. The use case returns to step 4\. EF-02 (at step 5): No entry matches 2.1. The system shows “Không có nhật ký nào khớp với điều kiện tìm kiếm.” 2.2. The use case returns to step 4\. EF-03 (at step 3 or 7): The data cannot be loaded 3.1. The system shows “Không thể tải nhật ký hệ thống. Vui lòng thử lại.” or, in the detail, “Không thể tải chi tiết nhật ký. Vui lòng thử lại.” (“Không tìm thấy dòng nhật ký này.” when the entry does not exist). 3.2. The use case returns to step 4\. EF-04 (at step 1): The user is not an Admin or the session has ended 4.1. The system shows MSG13, or opens the “Đăng nhập” screen (UC-01) when the session has ended. 4.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | The requested audit log entries are displayed. No data is changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-42; Security: Audit trail (IV.2.3). |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG13 |  |  |

### **14.2 UC-79: View Record Archive**

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to search the electronic archive of closed medical records with their retention period and integrity hash, so that I can find a record to keep, check or export (UC-80). |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in (UC-01). A medical record is archived when it is closed (UC-58): its archive package is frozen and its SHA-256 hash is stored. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin selects “Hồ sơ bệnh án” \> “Lưu trữ hồ sơ” in the menu. The system displays the archived records, 10 per page: “Số lưu trữ”, “Số hồ sơ / Lượt khám”, “Bệnh nhân” (full name, gender, age), “Thời điểm đóng & lưu trữ”, “Thời hạn bảo quản” (retention type, years and expiry date), “Mã băm toàn vẹn (SHA-256)” and “Thao tác” (“Kết xuất (XML/JSON)”). The Admin types a keyword (“Tìm theo số lưu trữ, số BA, mã BN, tên bệnh nhân, mã lượt khám...”) and/or selects the retention type (“Tất cả loại lưu trữ”, “Tiêu chuẩn (10 năm)”, “Bệnh mạn tính (15 năm)”, “Nghiên cứu khoa học (20 năm)”, “Lưu trữ vĩnh viễn”, “Khác”) and the expiry range (“Hết hạn từ … đến …”). The system shows the matching records from page 1\. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 2 or 4): Change page or refresh 1.1. The Admin changes the page or the page size, or clicks “Làm mới”. 1.2. The system reloads the list with the same conditions. 1.3. The use case returns to step 3\. AF-02 (at step 2 or 4): Export a record 2.1. The Admin clicks “Kết xuất (XML/JSON)” on a record. 2.2. The use case continues in UC-80. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 4): No record matches 1.1. The system shows “Chưa có hồ sơ lưu trữ nào khớp với điều kiện tìm kiếm.” 1.2. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-02 (at step 2 or 4): The list cannot be loaded 2.1. The system shows “Không thể tải danh sách lưu trữ hồ sơ bệnh án. Vui lòng thử lại sau.” 2.2. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-03 (at step 1): The user is not an Admin or the session has ended 3.1. The system shows MSG13, or opens the “Đăng nhập” screen (UC-01) when the session has ended. 3.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | The archived records are listed. No data is changed. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-42, BR-43; OR-01. |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG13 |  |  |

 

### **14.3 UC-80: Export Medical Record Data (XML/JSON)** 

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to export the data of a closed medical record as an XML (Official Dispatch 365/TTYQG) or JSON (EMR exchange) file for a stated legal purpose and recipient, so that the record can be exchanged or handed over lawfully (Law 15/2023/QH15, Article 69). |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in (UC-01) and is viewing the archive list (UC-79). The medical record is closed and has its archive package. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin clicks “Kết xuất (XML/JSON)” on a record. The system opens “Kết xuất Dữ liệu Bệnh án EMR (Admin)” with the record numbers, the format buttons “Dữ liệu XML” (“Theo Công văn 365/BYT”, selected) and “Dữ liệu JSON” (“Chuẩn liên thông EMR”), and the purpose: “Liên thông y tế / Chuyển tuyến điều trị”, “Lưu trữ hồ sơ điện tử cơ sở”, “Cung cấp cho người bệnh / Người đại diện” or “Cung cấp cho cơ quan có thẩm quyền”. The Admin selects the format and the purpose and fills in the recipient fields of that purpose: the receiving facility name\* and code (exchange); nothing (internal archive, recipient “Lưu trữ nội bộ”); “Bản thân người bệnh” (name and citizen ID from the profile, read-only) or “Người đại diện hợp pháp” with full name\*, citizen ID\* and the document date (patient); the authority type\* (Công an, Tòa án, Viện kiểm sát, Thanh tra y tế / Quản lý nhà nước, Khác…), authority name\*, document number\*, document date\* and the reason (authority). The Admin clicks the download button (“Tải tệp XML” / “Tải tệp JSON”). The system checks the fields: facility name ≤ 255 and code ≤ 50 characters; representative name ≤ 255 characters and citizen ID of exactly 12 digits; authority type “Khác” needs the type (≤ 100), authority name ≤ 255, document number ≤ 100; a document date is not after today. The server repeats the checks. The system builds the file from the frozen archive package of the record, computes its SHA-256 hash and records the export in the export log and the audit log. The system downloads the file, shows “Đã kết xuất dữ liệu {XML\|JSON} thành công.” and the file name with its SHA-256 hash in the dialog. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 4): The Admin cancels 1.1. The Admin closes the dialog. 1.2. No file is created; the use case ends. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 5): A field is missing or not valid 1.1. The system shows the message under the field, e.g. “Tên cơ sở khám bệnh, chữa bệnh nhận là bắt buộc.”, “Họ và tên người đại diện là bắt buộc.”, “Số CCCD phải gồm đúng 12 chữ số.”, “Vui lòng chọn loại cơ quan.”, “Tên cơ quan / đơn vị là bắt buộc.”, “Số văn bản yêu cầu là bắt buộc.”, “Ngày văn bản là bắt buộc.” or “Ngày văn bản không được sau ngày hiện tại.”; the server answers “Thông tin người/cơ quan tiếp nhận không hợp lệ theo quy định.” for other recipient errors. 1.2. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-02 (at step 6): The record is not closed 2.1. The system shows “Chỉ được kết xuất dữ liệu đối với hồ sơ bệnh án đã đóng.” 2.2. The use case ends. EF-03 (at step 6): Server or network error, or session ended 3.1. The system shows “Không thể xuất dữ liệu hồ sơ bệnh án. Vui lòng thử lại sau.”, or opens the “Đăng nhập” screen (UC-01) when the session has ended. 3.2. No file is downloaded. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the XML or JSON file is downloaded; the export (format, purpose, recipient, SHA-256, Admin, time) is recorded in the export log and the audit log. Failure or cancelled: no file is downloaded. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-42, BR-43; Law 15/2023/QH15 Article 69; Official Dispatch 365/TTYQG-GPQLCL. |  |  |
| **Messages** | None |  |  |

## **15\.  Shift schedule management**

### **15.1 UC-85 View Work Schedule**

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to view the weekly duty schedule of every room by shift (Ca Sáng / Ca Chiều), so that I can see who works where and plan the coming days. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in (UC-01). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin selects “Lịch trực” in the menu. The system takes the current week (Monday to Sunday, clinic time) and loads the shift times of that week and its assignments. The system shows “Lịch trực” (“Quản lý, phân công và thiết lập lịch làm việc theo tuần (Ca Sáng: hh:mm \- hh:mm & Ca Chiều: hh:mm \- hh:mm)”), the statistic cards (“Tổng ca trực tuần này”, “Nhân sự tham gia trực”, morning and afternoon counts) and the weekly matrix: one row per room grouped by department (an inactive room is marked “(Tạm ngừng)”), one column per day “Thứ 2” … “Chủ Nhật” with its date (today highlighted), and per shift the assigned staff (full name, Bác sĩ / Kỹ thuật viên) or an empty cell; a shift that has ended is marked “(Đã kết thúc)”. The Admin moves to the previous or next week or back to “Tuần này”, and filters the shift (all shifts, Ca Sáng or Ca Chiều). The system reloads and shows the selected week and shift. The Admin clicks a cell: an empty cell continues in UC-96, an assigned cell opens “Chi tiết ca trực” (UC-97, UC-98). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 3): Change the shift times of the week 1.1. The Admin clicks the clock button (“Chỉnh sửa khung giờ ca trực (Ca Sáng & Ca Chiều) cho tuần này”). 1.2. The system shows the start and end times of “Ca sáng” and “Ca chiều”; “Mặc định” resets them to 08:00 \- 11:30 and 13:00 \- 17:30. 1.3. The Admin changes the times and clicks “Lưu thay đổi”. The system checks that both times of each shift are entered, the morning times are within 00:00–11:59, the afternoon times within 12:00–23:59, and each start is before its end (the server repeats the checks). 1.4. The system saves the times for that week only and shows “Đã cập nhật khung giờ ca trực cho tuần thành công”. The use case returns to step 3\. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 3): The schedule cannot be loaded 1.1. The system shows “Không thể tải lịch trực tuần này”. 1.2. The use case returns to step 4\. EF-02 (at step 6): The cell cannot be used 2.1. A past empty cell shows “Ca trực trong quá khứ chưa phân công không thể thao tác”; a cell of an inactive room shows “Phòng đang tạm ngừng hoạt động \- Không thể phân công”. 2.2. The use case returns to step 4\. EF-03 (AF-01): The shift times are not valid 3.1. The system shows the message of the failed check, e.g. “Vui lòng nhập đầy đủ giờ bắt đầu và giờ kết thúc cho Ca Sáng” or “Giờ bắt đầu ca chiều phải trước giờ kết thúc ca chiều”; nothing is saved. 3.2. The use case returns to AF-01 step 3\. EF-04 (at step 1): The user is not an Admin or the session has ended 4.1. The system shows MSG13, or the “Đăng nhập” screen (UC-01). 4.2. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | The weekly schedule is shown; only the shift times may be changed (AF-01). |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-05 |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG13 |  |  |

### **15.2 UC-86 Create Shift Assignment**

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to assign a doctor or technician of a room to a shift of a day, or copy last week’s schedule, so that every active room has staff on duty. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is viewing the weekly schedule (UC-95). The staff member is assigned to the room (UC-15). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin clicks an empty cell (“Nhấn để phân công ca sáng/chiều”) of an active room for a shift that has not ended. The system shows “Phân công ca trực mới” with “Ngày trực”, the shift, “Phòng làm việc chỉ định” and the staff list (“-- Chọn bác sĩ tại phòng này \--”): only the Doctors (clinical room) or Technicians (paraclinical room) assigned to this room, with “Phòng có N … phụ trách”, and a note field (“Ví dụ: Trực chính, khám cấp cứu...”). The Admin selects the staff member, optionally enters a note and clicks “Lưu phân công”. The system checks that the shift has not ended (not a past day; today’s shift is not past its end time), the staff member is a Doctor for a clinical room or a Technician for a paraclinical room, the staff member has no other assignment in this shift on that day and the room has nobody else in this shift. The system saves the assignment with the assigner and shows “Đã phân công ca trực thành công”; the matrix shows the staff member in the cell. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 1): Copy last week 1.1. The Admin clicks “Sao chép tuần trước”. 1.2. The system asks for confirmation: all assignments of last week will be copied to this week; assignments of this week from today on are replaced, while past days and today’s shifts with patients keep their assignments. 1.3. After confirmation the system copies the assignments and shows “Đã sao chép thành công N ca trực từ tuần trước sang tuần này”. 1.4. The use case ends. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 3): No staff member is selected 1.1. The system shows “Vui lòng chọn bác sĩ trực” (or “Vui lòng chọn kỹ thuật viên trực”). 1.2. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-02 (at step 4): A check fails 2.1. The system shows “Không thể phân công hoặc chỉnh sửa ca trực đã kết thúc hoặc trong quá khứ”, “Bác sĩ chỉ có thể trực tại phòng khám lâm sàng”, “Kỹ thuật viên chỉ có thể trực tại phòng cận lâm sàng”, “Nhân viên đã được phân công ca trực này trong ngày” or “Phòng này đã có người trực trong ca làm việc này”; nothing is saved. 2.2. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-03 (AF-01): The copy is not possible 3.1. The system shows “Tuần trước không có ca trực nào để sao chép.”, “Không thể sao chép lịch trực cho tuần đã qua trong quá khứ” or “Tất cả các ngày tương ứng trong tuần này đều đã qua hoặc đã kết thúc, không thể sao chép.” 3.2. The use case ends. EF-04 (at step 5): Server error or session ended 4.1. The system shows “Không thể lưu ca trực”, or the “Đăng nhập” screen (UC-01). 4.2. Nothing is saved. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the assignment is saved and shown in the matrix. Failure: nothing is saved. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-05 |  |  |
| **Messages** | None |  |  |

### **15.3 UC-87 Update Shift Assignment**

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |

Vui lòng hoàn tất trước khi thay đổi nhân sự hoặc phòng trực”; nothing is saved. 1.2. The use case returns to step 3\. EF-02 (at step 5): Server error or session ended 2.1. The system shows “Không thể lưu ca trực”, or the “Đăng nhập” screen (UC-01). 2.2. Nothing is saved. |  |  |

| **Business Rules** | BR-05, BR-113 |  |  |
| **Messages** | None |  |  |

| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |

The system shows “Không thể xoá ca trực đã kết thúc hoặc trong quá khứ”, “Không tìm thấy lịch trực cần xoá” or that the room “đang có … bệnh nhân đang chờ hoặc đang khám trong ca trực này. Không thể xoá ca trực”. 1.2. Nothing is changed; the use case ends. EF-02 (at step 5): Server error or session ended 2.1. ## **16.Medicine Catalog**

###  **16.1 UC-81 View Medicine Catalog**

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to view, search and filter the medicine catalog so that I can look up and manage the medicines used for prescriptions. Only Admin can access the catalog.  |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in (UC-01) and is not required to change the password.  |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin selects “Danh mục thuốc” in the menu. The system displays the “Danh mục thuốc” screen with:2.1. The search box “Tìm theo tên, hoạt chất, hàm lượng, mã thuốc, số đăng ký...”.2.2. The filters “Tất cả đường dùng” (fixed list), “Tất cả đơn vị” (units currently in the catalog), “Tất cả nhóm” (Thông thường, Gây nghiện, Hướng thần, Tiền chất), “Tất cả trạng thái” (Đang hoạt động, Ngừng hoạt động), and the “Xóa bộ lọc” button.2.3. The “Thêm thuốc” button.2.4. Table columns “Mã thuốc”, “Tên thuốc”, “Hoạt chất”, “Hàm lượng”, “Đơn vị”, “Đường dùng”, “Nhóm kiểm soát” and “Trạng thái”. Each row is clickable and opens the medicine detail.2.5. Paging with 10 rows per page by default, selectable page sizes 10, 20 and 50, and the total number of medicines. The list is sorted by medicine name. The Admin enters a keyword and/or selects filters. After a short debounce, the system updates the list and returns to page 1\.4.1. The search matches medicine name, active ingredient, strength, medicine code or registration number, and ignores letter case and Vietnamese accents.4.2. Search and filters are combined using AND. The Admin clicks a medicine row. The system displays the medicine detail.6.1. It shows every list field, plus the registration number, the medicine code in the insurance catalog, the creation time and the last update time.6.2. From the detail, the Admin may edit the medicine (UC-83) or activate/deactivate it (UC-84), or return to the catalog. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 2): The catalog has no medicine1.1. The system displays an empty list and MSG92.1.2. The Admin may click “Thêm thuốc” (UC-82). AF-02 (at step 4): No medicine matches2.1. The system displays an empty list and MSG01, keeping the keyword and filters.2.2. The Admin may change the criteria or click “Xóa bộ lọc”. AF-03 (at step 3): Clear search and filters3.1. The Admin clicks “Xóa bộ lọc”.3.2. The system clears the keyword, resets every filter to “Tất cả”, returns to page 1 and reloads the list. AF-04 (at step 2): Change page or page size4.1. The Admin selects another page or page size (10, 20, 50).4.2. The system keeps the current keyword and filters; changing the page size returns to page 1\. AF-05 (at step 2): Add a medicine5.1. The Admin clicks “Thêm thuốc”; the use case continues in UC-82. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 1): The user is not an Admin1.1. The system refuses access and displays MSG13.1.2. A direct request to the medicine API returns HTTP 403 FORBIDDEN; no medicine data is disclosed. EF-02 (at step 6): The medicine does not exist2.1. The system displays MSG39 (“Không tìm thấy thuốc.”) and a button back to the catalog. EF-03 (at steps 2–6): Session expired or system error3.1. If the session has expired, the system displays MSG12 and opens the Login screen.3.2. If the catalog or the detail cannot be loaded, the system displays MSG80; the Admin may retry. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | The medicines matching the criteria, or the selected medicine, are shown. No data is changed.  |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-33; Permission Matrix (Medicine catalog: Admin only).  |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG01, MSG12, MSG13, MSG39, MSG80, MSG92  |  |  |

### 

### **16.2 UC-82 Create Medicine**

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to add a medicine to the catalog so that Doctors can select it when prescribing. The clinic neither sells nor dispenses medicines, so the catalog has no price or stock (BR-33).  |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in (UC-01), is not required to change the password, and is on the medicine catalog (UC-81).  |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin clicks “Thêm thuốc”. The system opens the “Thêm thuốc” form with the fields:2.1. “Mã thuốc”, “Số đăng ký”, “Tên thuốc”, “Hoạt chất”, “Hàm lượng”, “Đơn vị tính”, “Đường dùng”, “Nhóm kiểm soát” (required) and “Mã thuốc theo danh mục BHYT” (optional, marked “Không bắt buộc”).2.2. “Đường dùng” is chosen from the fixed route list; “Nhóm kiểm soát” from Thông thường, Gây nghiện, Hướng thần, Tiền chất.2.3. “Đơn vị tính” is free text with suggestions of the units already in the catalog. The Admin enters the data and clicks “Thêm thuốc”.3.1. “Mã thuốc” is the clinic’s internal code set by the Admin and is converted to upper case as it is typed. The system validates the data (BR-79):4.1. Required fields are present.4.2. “Mã thuốc”: at most 50 characters, only upper-case letters, digits and hyphens.4.3. “Số đăng ký”: at most 20 characters; “Tên thuốc”: 2–255; “Hoạt chất”: 2–500; “Hàm lượng”: at most 255; “Đơn vị tính”: at most 50; “Mã thuốc theo danh mục BHYT”: at most 255\.4.4. “Đường dùng” belongs to the fixed route list.4.5. “Mã thuốc” and “Số đăng ký” do not already exist in the catalog (BR-51).4.6. Leading and trailing spaces are removed and repeated spaces are collapsed; an empty optional field is saved as empty. The system saves the medicine with status “Đang hoạt động” and records the creation in the audit log. The system closes the form, shows MSG04 (“Tạo thành công thuốc {mã thuốc}.”) and reloads the catalog. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 4): A required field is empty1.1. The system shows MSG02 under that field; nothing is saved. AF-02 (at step 4): Wrong format or length2.1. “Mã thuốc” with a character other than upper-case letters, digits and hyphens, or “Tên thuốc”/”Hoạt chất” shorter than 2 characters: MSG05 under the field.2.2. A field longer than its maximum: MSG08 under the field. AF-03 (at step 4): Duplicate code or registration number3.1. The system shows MSG07 under “Mã thuốc” or “Số đăng ký”; the entered data is kept.3.2. This also applies when another Admin saved the same value at the same time. AF-04 (at step 4): Route not in the list4.1. The system shows MSG40 under “Đường dùng”. AF-05 (at step 3): Cancel5.1. If no data was entered, the form closes.5.2. If data was entered, the system shows MSG38 with “Tiếp tục chỉnh sửa” and “Loại bỏ”. “Loại bỏ” closes the form without saving and returns to the catalog. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 1): The user is not an Admin1.1. The system refuses the action and shows MSG13; nothing is saved. EF-02 (at steps 4–5): Session expired or system error2.1. If the session has expired, the system shows MSG12 and opens the Login screen.2.2. If the medicine cannot be saved, the system shows MSG80 and keeps the entered data so the Admin can retry; nothing is saved. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the new medicine is in the catalog with status “Đang hoạt động” and the creation is recorded in the audit log. A “Thông thường” medicine can be selected when prescribing (UC-59); “Gây nghiện”, “Hướng thần” and “Tiền chất” medicines are stored but cannot be prescribed on an ordinary prescription. Failure: no medicine is created.  |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-33, BR-51, BR-79; Permission Matrix (Medicine catalog: Admin only).  |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG02, MSG04, MSG05, MSG07, MSG08, MSG12, MSG13, MSG38, MSG40, MSG80  |  |  |

### 

### **16.3 UC-83 Update Medicine**

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to update the information of a medicine in the catalog so that prescriptions use correct data. Prescriptions already created keep the medicine data stored when they were written.  |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in (UC-01) and is not required to change the password. The medicine exists in the catalog.  |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin opens a medicine from the catalog (UC-81) and clicks “Sửa thông tin”. The system opens the “Sửa thông tin thuốc” form with the current values.2.1. “Mã thuốc” is shown read-only with the note “Mã thuốc không thay đổi được”.2.2. The other fields are the same as in UC-82; both active and inactive medicines can be edited. The Admin changes the fields and clicks “Lưu thay đổi”.3.1. “Lưu thay đổi” is enabled only after a value has changed. The system validates the data as in UC-82 step 4 (BR-79).4.1. “Số đăng ký” must not belong to another medicine (BR-51).4.2. If the data has been changed by another user since the form was opened, the flow continues at AF-04. The system saves the new values and records the update in the audit log, with the old and new value of each changed field. The system closes the form, shows MSG03 (“Thông tin thuốc {mã thuốc} cập nhật thành công.”) and refreshes the detail and the catalog. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 4): Invalid data1.1. Empty required field: MSG02. Wrong format, or “Tên thuốc”/”Hoạt chất” shorter than 2 characters: MSG05. Too long: MSG08. Route not in the list: MSG40.1.2. The message is shown under the field and nothing is saved. AF-02 (at step 4): Duplicate registration number2.1. The system shows MSG07 under “Số đăng ký”, including when another Admin saved the same number at the same time. AF-03 (at step 3): Cancel3.1. If nothing was changed, the form closes.3.2. If something was changed, the system shows MSG38 with “Tiếp tục chỉnh sửa” and “Loại bỏ”. “Loại bỏ” closes the form without saving. AF-04 (at step 4): The medicine was changed by another user4.1. The system shows MSG75 (“Thuốc vừa được người khác cập nhật. Vui lòng tải lại và thử lại.”) and nothing is saved.4.2. The system reloads the medicine detail and keeps the form open so the Admin can edit again. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 1): The user is not an Admin1.1. The system refuses the action and shows MSG13. EF-02 (at step 4): The medicine no longer exists2.1. The system shows MSG39 (“Không tìm thấy thuốc.”) and nothing is saved. EF-03 (at steps 4–5): Session expired or system error3.1. If the session has expired, the system shows MSG12 and opens the Login screen.3.2. If the medicine cannot be saved, the system shows MSG80, keeps the entered data and lets the Admin retry; nothing is saved. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the new values apply to prescriptions written afterwards; existing prescriptions are unchanged; the update is recorded in the audit log. If “Nhóm kiểm soát” changes away from “Thông thường”, the medicine can no longer be prescribed from that moment. **TBD:** how unsent prescriptions that contain the medicine are blocked, and the message used, is decided with UC-59/UC-90. Failure: the medicine keeps its previous values.  |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-33, BR-51, BR-79; Permission Matrix (Medicine catalog: Admin only).  |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG02, MSG03, MSG05, MSG07, MSG08, MSG12, MSG13, MSG38, MSG39, MSG40, MSG75, MSG80  |  |  |

### 

### **16.4 UC-84 Activate/Deactivate Medicine**

| Primary Actors | Admin | Secondary Actors | None |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As an Admin, I want to deactivate a medicine so that Doctors can no longer prescribe it, or reactivate a deactivated one. A medicine is never deleted, because existing prescriptions still refer to it.  |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Admin is signed in (UC-01) and is not required to change the password. The medicine exists in the catalog.  |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Admin opens the detail of an active medicine (UC-81) and clicks “Ngừng sử dụng”. The system shows the dialog “Ngừng sử dụng thuốc” with MSG06 (“Bạn có chắc chắn muốn ngừng sử dụng thuốc “{tên thuốc}” không?”). The Admin confirms with “Ngừng sử dụng”. The system changes the status to “Ngừng hoạt động” and records the change in the audit log (old and new status). The system shows MSG03 (“Trạng thái thuốc {mã thuốc} cập nhật thành công.”) and refreshes the detail and the catalog. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 1): Reactivate a medicine1.1. The Admin opens the detail of an inactive medicine and clicks “Kích hoạt”.1.2. The system shows the dialog “Kích hoạt thuốc” with MSG06 (“Bạn có chắc chắn muốn kích hoạt thuốc “{tên thuốc}” không?”).1.3. The Admin confirms with “Kích hoạt”; the use case continues at step 4 with status “Đang hoạt động”. AF-02 (at step 3): Cancel2.1. The Admin closes the dialog; the status is unchanged. AF-03 (at step 4): The medicine was changed by another user3.1. The system shows MSG75 (“Thuốc vừa được người khác cập nhật. Vui lòng tải lại và thử lại.”) and nothing is saved.3.2. The system reloads the medicine detail. AF-04 (at step 4): The medicine already has the requested status4.1. Nothing is saved and nothing is recorded; the system shows the current status. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 1): The user is not an Admin1.1. The system refuses the action and shows MSG13. EF-02 (at step 4): The medicine no longer exists2.1. The system shows MSG39 (“Không tìm thấy thuốc.”) and nothing is saved. EF-03 (at step 4): Session expired or system error3.1. If the session has expired, the system shows MSG12 and opens the Login screen.3.2. If the status cannot be saved, the system shows MSG80 on the detail screen; the status is unchanged and the Admin may retry. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the medicine has the new status and the change is recorded in the audit log. An inactive medicine stays visible in the catalog (filter “Ngừng hoạt động”) and does not change prescriptions already sent.  |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-33; Permission Matrix (Medicine catalog: Admin only).  |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG03, MSG06, MSG12, MSG13, MSG39, MSG75, MSG80  |  |  |

## **17.e-Prescription**

### **17.1 UC-90 Submit e-Prescription**

### 

| Primary Actors | Doctor  | Secondary Actors | National prescription system (simulated)  |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Doctor, I want to sign the prescription and send it to the national prescription system before confirming the conclusion, so that it is valid under TT 26/2025 and the patient can buy the medicine with its code. Every send is stored, whatever its result.  |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Doctor is signed in (UC-01) and is not required to change the password. The Doctor is the Doctor of the visit and is on duty in its room (BR-19, BR-55), and the medical record is Open. The prescription is “Chưa gửi”, “Bị từ chối” or “Chưa nhận được phản hồi”. The conclusion is saved with exactly one main diagnosis (UC-56, BR-31).  |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | On the “Đơn thuốc” tab, the Doctor clicks “Ký và gửi đơn”. The system shows: a preview of the prescription with the watermark “BẢN NHÁP – KHÔNG CÓ GIÁ TRỊ”; the diagnoses and the follow-up date that will be sent; the reminder “Sau khi gửi thành công, đơn thuốc và chẩn đoán không sửa được nữa.” The Doctor enters the signing PIN and clicks “Xác nhận ký và gửi”.3.1. The button is enabled only after 6 digits are entered, and shows “Đang gửi…” while sending. The system checks the following in one transaction. Any failure continues at AF-04 or EF-01 → EF-03. the Doctor, the visit and that the prescription has not changed since the dialog opened (BR-47, BR-119); the PIN (BR-139, BR-140); the link codes (BR-48, BR-49, BR-65, BR-66); the lines (BR-33, BR-79, BR-107); the child data (BR-141). The system copies the conclusion’s diagnoses and the follow-up date onto the prescription (BR-47). It builds the message (BR-54, BR-82), signs it (BR-139), writes the audit row (BR-42) and records a new attempt (BR-47). The system sends the prescription to the national prescription system (BR-45), and the national system accepts it. The system records the attempt as accepted and locks the prescription and the conclusion’s diagnoses (BR-47). The system shows MSG84 (“Đã gửi đơn thuốc {prescription\_code} thành công.”) with “In đơn thuốc” (UC-60) and “Xác nhận kết luận” (UC-58). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 6): Rejected1.1. The attempt is recorded as rejected with the error list; the prescription becomes “Bị từ chối” and stays editable.1.2. The system shows MSG85, the error list and “Sửa đơn” (UC-92). AF-02 (at step 6): No answer within 10 seconds2.1. The attempt is recorded as “Không phản hồi”; the prescription becomes “Chưa nhận được phản hồi” and can no longer be edited.2.2. The system shows MSG86 and “Gửi lại”. “Gửi lại” restarts at step 2 with a new attempt and a new signature. AF-03 (at step 2–3): Cancel3.1. “Hủy” closes the dialog; nothing is signed or sent. AF-04 (at step 4): Wrong PIN4.1. The system shows MSG107 and clears the PIN field; the Doctor retries at step 3\. The fifth wrong PIN in a row continues at EF-02. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 4): Data not ready to send. Nothing is sent; the message is shown under the item concerned.1.1. Missing link code: MSG87. Conclusion not saved: MSG105.1.2. Invalid line: MSG40 (medicine inactive), MSG103 (not “Thông thường”), MSG106 (over 30 days), MSG89 (same medicine twice), MSG02 / MSG05 / MSG08 (fields). The Doctor corrects the prescription (UC-59 or UC-92).1.3. Child under 72 months without a weight or an accompanying person: MSG104. The Doctor records the weight (UC-47) or asks the Receptionist to add the relative. EF-02 (at step 1 or 4): PIN blocked or not set2.1. Blocked: MSG11. Not set: MSG108. Nothing is sent. EF-03 (at step 1 or 4): Not allowed, or changed meanwhile3.1. Already accepted: the button is hidden; a direct request gets MSG88.3.2. Prescription or visit changed by another request, or a send is already running: MSG75, and the tab reloads.3.3. Not the Doctor of the visit: MSG13. Record closed: MSG68. Off duty: MSG48. Not assigned to a room: MSG99. EF-04: Session expired or system error4.1. Session expired: MSG12 and the Login screen. Server unreachable: MSG96. Other errors: MSG80.4.2. A failure before step 6 records nothing; after step 6 the attempt keeps its recorded result. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: one accepted attempt and one signature are recorded. The prescription and the conclusion’s diagnoses are locked. The visit can be concluded and the prescription printed. Rejected or no answer: one attempt and one signature are recorded. Nothing is locked, and the conclusion stays blocked (BR-32). Failure before sending: nothing changes. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-19, BR-31, BR-32, BR-33, BR-42, BR-45, BR-47, BR-48, BR-49, BR-52, BR-54, BR-55, BR-65, BR-66, BR-79, BR-82, BR-107, BR-119, BR-120, BR-123, BR-139, BR-140, BR-141  |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG02, MSG05, MSG08, MSG11, MSG12, MSG13, MSG40, MSG48, MSG68, MSG75, MSG80, MSG84, MSG85, MSG86, MSG87, MSG88, MSG89, MSG96, MSG99, MSG103, MSG104, MSG105, MSG106, MSG107, MSG108 |  |  |

## 

### **17.2 UC-91 View Prescription Submission Result**

### 

| Primary Actors | Doctor  | Secondary Actors | National prescription system (simulated)  |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Doctor, I want to see whether the prescription was accepted and, if not, the errors returned, together with every past attempt, so that I know whether to print and conclude, correct, or resend. Viewing changes nothing.  |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Doctor is signed in (UC-01) and is not required to change the password. The visit has a prescription.  |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | The Doctor opens the “Đơn thuốc” tab of the visit (also shown at the end of UC-90), or the prescription in the medical record (UC-52, BR-35). The system shows the prescription code, its status and the matching actions (BR-47):2.1. “Chưa gửi”: “Ký và gửi đơn”.2.2. “Chưa nhận được phản hồi”: MSG86 and “Gửi lại”.2.3. “Bị từ chối”: MSG85, the latest error list, “Sửa đơn” and “Gửi lại”.2.4. “Đã được chấp nhận”: the accepted time and “In đơn thuốc”; the prescription is read-only. The Doctor clicks “Kết quả gửi”. The system lists every attempt, newest first: attempt number, sent time, sender, result (“Chấp nhận”, “Bị từ chối”, “Không phản hồi”), response time and, for a rejection, the error list. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 2): Resend or correct1.1. “Gửi lại” starts UC-90; “Sửa đơn” starts UC-92. AF-02 (at step 4): Never sent2.1. The list shows MSG92 (“Chưa có dữ liệu để hiển thị.”). AF-03 (at step 1): Closed record, or not the Doctor of the visit3.1. Everything is read-only; no send, resend or correct action is shown. AF-04 (at step 2): The Doctor tries to confirm the conclusion first4.1. UC-58 refuses with MSG67 and a link to this tab (BR-32). |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 1): No access1.1. Receptionist, Cashier, Technician or Admin: MSG13 (BR-120). EF-02 (at step 1): Prescription not found2.1. MSG39. EF-03: Session expired or system error3.1. Session expired: MSG12 and the Login screen. Server unreachable: MSG96. Other errors: MSG80 and “Tải lại”. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success and failure: nothing changes.  |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-32, BR-35, BR-42, BR-47, BR-120  |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG12, MSG13, MSG39, MSG67, MSG80, MSG85, MSG86, MSG92, MSG96  |  |  |

## 

## 

### **17.3 UC-92 Correct and Resubmit Prescription**

### 

| Primary Actors | Doctor  | Secondary Actors | National prescription system (simulated)  |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| **Description** | As a Doctor, I want to correct a rejected prescription following its error list and send it again, so that it is accepted and I can conclude the visit. The prescription code does not change (BR-52).  |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The Doctor is signed in (UC-01) and is not required to change the password. The Doctor is the Doctor of the visit and is on duty in its room (BR-19, BR-55), and the medical record is Open. The prescription is “Bị từ chối”.  |  |  |
| **Normal Flow** | From UC-91 or the “Đơn thuốc” tab, the Doctor clicks “Sửa đơn”. The system opens the UC-59 form with the current lines, “Lưu ý” and “Lời dặn”. The prescription code is read-only, and the latest error list stays above the form. The Doctor changes the prescription and clicks “Lưu đơn thuốc”.3.1. The button is enabled only after a change, and shows “Đang lưu…” while saving. The system validates as in UC-59 (BR-33, BR-79, BR-107) and checks that the prescription has not been changed meanwhile (BR-119). The system saves with the same code (BR-52), writes the audit row (BR-42) and shows MSG03 (“Đơn thuốc cập nhật thành công.”). The status stays “Bị từ chối” until the next send. The Doctor clicks “Ký và gửi đơn”. UC-90 runs from step 2 as the next attempt and ends as UC-90 steps 7–8. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows** | AF-01 (at step 2): The error concerns the conclusion or a link code1.1. The Doctor corrects the diagnoses in UC-56 (not locked yet, BR-31) or asks the Admin to fix the link code (prescriber link code in UC-08, facility link code in UC-77). The Doctor then continues at step 6 without changing the prescription.  AF-02 (at step 4): Drug allergy match2.1. The system shows MSG26 with the medicine (BR-23). “Đổi thuốc” returns to step 3; “Vẫn kê đơn” continues at step 5, and the confirmation is recorded in the audit log. AF-03 (at step 4): Invalid data3.1. MSG02, MSG05, MSG08, MSG40, MSG89, MSG103 or MSG106 is shown under the field, as in UC-90 EF-01. Nothing is saved. AF-04 (at step 3): Cancel4.1. No change: the form closes. Changes: MSG38 with “Tiếp tục chỉnh sửa” and “Loại bỏ”. AF-05 (at step 6): Rejected again, or no answer5.1. Rejected again: as UC-90 AF-01, then back to step 1\. No answer: as UC-90 AF-02, and only “Gửi lại” is available. |  |  |
| **Exception Flows** | EF-01 (at step 1): Not rejected1.1. Accepted: “Sửa đơn” is hidden; a direct request gets MSG88. No answer yet: only “Gửi lại” is available. EF-02 (at step 1 or 4): Not allowed, or changed meanwhile2.1. MSG13, MSG68, MSG48 or MSG99, as in UC-90 EF-03.2.2. Prescription changed by another request: MSG75. The prescription reloads and the form stays open. EF-03 (at step 6): Sending fails3.1. The exception flows of UC-90 apply; the correction stays saved. EF-04: Session expired or system error4.1. Session expired: MSG12 and the Login screen. Server unreachable: MSG96. Save fails: MSG80, and the entered data is kept for a retry. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | Success: the correction is saved with the same code and recorded in the audit log. The new attempt is accepted, and everything is locked as in UC-90. Rejected again or no answer: the correction stays saved and one more attempt is recorded. Failure: the prescription is unchanged. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-19, BR-23, BR-31, BR-32, BR-33, BR-42, BR-47, BR-52, BR-55, BR-79, BR-107, BR-119, BR-120, BR-139  |  |  |
| **Messages** | MSG02, MSG03, MSG05, MSG08, MSG12, MSG13, MSG26, MSG38, MSG40, MSG48, MSG68, MSG75, MSG80, MSG85, MSG88, MSG89, MSG96, MSG99, MSG103, MSG106  |  |  |
