| Xóa bộ lọc | Button. Clears every filter and searches again. |
| Tìm kiếm | Button. Searches with the entered filters and returns to page 1\. |
| Làm mới | Button. Reloads the current list. |
| Danh sách Bệnh nhân · Tổng số | Read-only. Displays the number of matching patients. |
| Mã bệnh nhân, Họ và tên, Ngày sinh, Giới tính | Table columns, read-only. |
| Số lượt khám, Ngày khám gần nhất, Chẩn đoán gần nhất | Table columns, read-only. The number of visits, the last visit date and the last final diagnosis (ICD-10 code \- name); "—" when none. MSG01 when no patient matches. |
| Lịch sử khám | Button (or click on the row). Opens the visit history of the patient. |
| Hiển thị | Dropdown: 10, 20, 50 rows per page. Default: 20\. |
| Phân trang | Buttons. Previous / next page, with "Trang x / y". |
| Quay lại danh sách bệnh nhân | Button. Returns to the patient list. |
| Bệnh nhân, Mã bệnh nhân, Ngày sinh, Giới tính | Read-only. Header of the selected patient, with "Tổng cộng: … lượt khám". |
| Mã lượt khám, Ngày khám, Phòng khám, Bác sĩ khám | Table columns, read-only. Visits newest first. |
| Đối tượng | Table column, read-only. BHYT or Dịch vụ. |
| Chẩn đoán cuối cùng | Table column, read-only. ICD-10 code \- name of the final diagnosis; "—" when not concluded. |
| Trạng thái | Table column, read-only. Status of the visit; "Đã bỏ qua" for a skipped visit. |
| Xem chi tiết | Button. Opens the medical record of the visit (UC-52). A visit without a medical record shows "Chưa có hồ sơ" instead. |

### **10.2: View Medical Record Detail** {#10.2:-view-medical-record-detail}

![][image48]

This screen allows Doctor to:

* See the patient header with drug allergies and medical history  
* Switch between the visits of the patient  
* Read the administrative data, vital signs, clinical examination, paraclinical results, conclusion, prescription and follow-up appointment of a visit  
* Edit the current unfinished visit, reprint the slips of a closed visit and export the medical record (UC-53)

**Field Description**

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| Quay lại | Button (arrow). Returns to the visit list of the patient (UC-51). |
| Số hồ sơ, Lưu trữ | Read-only. The medical record number ("Chưa cấp số" when not issued) and the storage number once archived. |
| Lượt khám | Read-only. Visit code and registration time. Shows "Hồ sơ đã được mở khóa lại lúc …" when the record was unlocked. |
| Chỉnh sửa ca khám hiện tại | Button. Shown only for the Doctor's own unfinished visit. Opens the Clinical Examination screen of the visit. |
| In kết luận, In đơn thuốc, In giấy hẹn | Buttons. Shown when the record is closed and the Doctor is the Doctor of the visit (UC-57, UC-60, UC-62). "In đơn thuốc" only when the prescription was accepted; "In giấy hẹn" only when the visit has an appointment, disabled when the appointment is no longer "Đã hẹn". |
| Xuất hồ sơ bệnh án | Button. Enabled only for a closed record; otherwise disabled with MSG131. Opens the export dialog (UC-53). |
| Bệnh nhân | Read-only. Full name, patient code, gender, age, citizen ID, phone number and address. |
| Dị ứng | Read-only, red label. The drug allergies; "Chưa ghi nhận dị ứng thuốc" when none. |
| Tiền sử bệnh & yếu tố nguy cơ | Read-only. Shown when recorded. |
| Lịch sử các đợt khám | List. One row per visit, newest first: date, visit code, room, diagnosis, status. Clicking a row opens that visit; the current visit is marked "Đang xem"; a visit without a record shows "Chưa có hồ sơ" and cannot be opened. |
| Thông tin hành chính lượt khám | Read-only. Status ("Bỏ khám – không có kết luận" for an abandoned visit), priority and reason, visit code, room, responsible Doctor, visit type with the insurance card number. |
| Lịch sử chuyển phòng khám | Read-only. Shown when the visit was transferred: from room → to room, reason, time. |
| Chỉ số sinh hiệu | Read-only. Mạch, Nhiệt độ, Huyết áp, Nhịp thở, Cân nặng, Chiều cao, BMI, SpO₂ with the measuring time; "—" when not measured. |
| Khám lâm sàng & Diễn biến bệnh | Read-only. Reason for visit, process of illness, general examination, organ examination, preliminary diagnosis. |
| Chỉ định & Kết quả Cận lâm sàng | Read-only. Each order slip with its services (name, code, room, status). Lab results show Tên chỉ số, Kết quả, Khoảng tham chiếu, Đơn vị, Đánh giá (Bình thường / Bất thường); imaging results show the description, conclusion and recommendation. "Không có chỉ định cận lâm sàng trong đợt khám này." when none. |
| Tệp hình ảnh kết quả | Buttons. Open the result image in a preview window after the access check; MSG39 when the file is not found. |
| Chẩn đoán & Kết luận điều trị | Read-only. Final diagnosis (ICD-10 code and name; "Chưa kết luận" when none), treatment plan and the Doctor's advice. |
| Đơn thuốc | Read-only table: STT, Tên thuốc / Hoạt chất, Số lượng, Cách dùng & Liều lượng, with the prescription code and advice. "Không có đơn thuốc trong đợt khám này." when none. |
| Hẹn tái khám | Read-only. Follow-up date, slip number and advice. "Không có lịch hẹn tái khám." when none. |

### **10.3: Export Medical Record** {#10.3:-export-medical-record}

![][image49]

This screen allows Doctor to:

* Choose the purpose and the recipient of the export  
* Download the outpatient medical record (form 15/BV1) of a closed visit as a PDF file, taken from the archive copy made when the record was closed

**Field Description**

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| Xuất hồ sơ bệnh án (PDF) | Dialog title, with the visit code of the record. |
| Mục đích xuất | Dropdown, required: Trao đổi dữ liệu, Lưu trữ, Cung cấp cho người bệnh, Cơ quan có thẩm quyền. Default: "-- Chọn mục đích \--". Shows MSG02 when empty. |
| Người nhận | Text box, at most 200 characters. Full name / receiving agency and the request document number. Required (MSG02) when the purpose is "Cung cấp cho người bệnh" or "Cơ quan có thẩm quyền"; MSG08 when too long. |
| Hủy, X | Buttons. Close the dialog without exporting. |
| Xuất PDF | Button. Enabled when a purpose is selected. Creates and downloads the PDF file, then shows MSG34. Shows MSG131 when the record is not closed. |

## **11\. Examination Conclusion** {#11.-examination-conclusion-1}

### **11.1: View Patients Pending Conclusion** {#11.1:-view-patients-pending-conclusion}

![][image50]

This screen allows Doctor to:

* See the patients of the room whose paraclinical results are complete and who wait for the conclusion  
* Search and filter the list  
* Call a patient back and open the conclusion step of the visit

**Field Description**

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| Phòng khám hiện tại, Bác sĩ phụ trách, Tổng số bệnh nhân chờ | Read-only. The Doctor's room, the Doctor and the number of waiting patients. The list refreshes automatically every 10 seconds. |
| Danh sách bệnh nhân, Chờ kết luận, Vắng mặt | Tabs, with the number of patients of each. "Chờ kết luận" shows the visits waiting for the conclusion. |
| Tìm bệnh nhân | Text box, optional. Searches by name, patient code or insurance card number; returns to page 1\. |
| Lọc ưu tiên | Dropdown: Tất cả ưu tiên, Ưu tiên, Thường. Default: "Tất cả ưu tiên". |
| Lọc loại khám | Dropdown: Tất cả loại khám, BHYT, Dịch vụ. Default: "Tất cả loại khám". |
| Xóa bộ lọc | Button. Clears the search and the filters. |
| STT, Họ tên, Mã BN | Table columns, read-only. |
| Loại khám | Table column, read-only. BHYT or Dịch vụ. |
| Thời gian đăng ký | Table column, read-only. Time and date of registration. |
| Ghi chú | Table column, read-only. The note, the priority reason or "Chuyển từ phòng …". |
| Trạng thái | Table column, read-only. "Chờ kết luận". |
| Bắt đầu | Button. Confirms the patient is present, shows "Bệnh nhân … đã có mặt, chuyển sang bước kết luận." and opens the Kết luận tab of the visit (UC-56). Outside the shift it stays enabled only for the Doctor's own patients (BR-19, BR-20); otherwise MSG48 is shown. |
| Vắng mặt | Button. Moves the patient to the skipped list and shows MSG54. |
| Phân trang, Số dòng/trang | Buttons and dropdown (10, 20, 50). "Hiển thị x \- y / z". MSG92 when the list is empty, MSG01 when the search or filter matches nothing. |

### **11.2: View Paraclinical Results** {#11.2:-view-paraclinical-results}

![][image51]

This screen allows Doctor to:

* See the paraclinical order slips of the visit with the status and room of each service  
* Open a submitted result in the same form as the printed result slip  
* Cancel a service the patient refused and print the order slip

**Field Description**

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| Danh sách đã chỉ định | Tab of the Clinical Examination screen. Lists the order slips of the visit. MSG92 when there is none. |
| Phiếu chỉ định, Chẩn đoán sơ bộ | Read-only. Order slip number and the preliminary diagnosis. |
| Chỉ định lúc | Read-only. Order time (dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm). |
| In phiếu chỉ định | Button. Prints the order slip (UC-50). Hidden when the slip or all of its services are cancelled. |
| Mã chỉ định, Tên dịch vụ | Table columns, read-only. |
| Phòng thực hiện | Table column, read-only. Room and location; "Phân phòng sau khi thanh toán" for an unpaid service, otherwise "Chưa xếp phòng" when no room yet. |
| Trạng thái | Table column, read-only: Chờ thanh toán, Chờ thực hiện, Đang thực hiện, Hoàn thành, Đã hủy. A cancelled service also shows "Lý do: …". |
| Xem kết quả / Ẩn kết quả | Toggle (or click on the row), only for "Hoàn thành" services. Opens the result slip below the row, with the same template as the printed slip (UC-68), or collapses it. MSG80 when the result cannot be loaded. |
| Hủy | Button. Shown only while the service can still be cancelled. Opens the cancel dialog. |
| Lý do hủy | Text area in the cancel dialog, required, 5–500 characters. |
| Đóng, Xác nhận hủy | Buttons of the cancel dialog. "Xác nhận hủy" cancels the service, recalculates the charges and shows MSG70. |

### **11.3: Conclude Examination** {#11.3:-conclude-examination}

![][image52]

This screen allows Doctor to:

* See the preliminary diagnosis of the clinical examination  
* Record the final diagnosis in words with the main and secondary ICD-10 codes, the treatment plan, the treatment result and the advice  
* Save the conclusion, then confirm it and close the medical record (UC-58)

**Field Description**

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| Kết luận | Tab of the Clinical Examination screen. Enabled while the visit is "Đang khám" or "Chờ kết luận". |
| Chẩn đoán sơ bộ (khám lâm sàng) | Read-only. The preliminary diagnosis and its ICD-10 codes from UC-47. |
| Đã lưu lúc | Read-only. Time and Doctor of the last save. |
| Chẩn đoán kết luận | Text area, required. The diagnosis in the Doctor's words. MSG02 when empty. |
| Bệnh chính (ICD-10) | Search box, required, one code. From 2 characters, searches active ICD-10 codes by code or name. MSG64 when missing or repeated as a secondary disease; MSG65 / MSG66 when not allowed / discouraged as a main disease; MSG40, MSG110, MSG111 when the code cannot be used. Read-only (lock icon) once the prescription was sent. |
| Bệnh kèm theo (ICD-10) | Search box, optional, several codes, at most 12 (MSG112). The main disease cannot be selected. Each code has an X button to remove it. Read-only once the prescription was sent. |
| Hướng điều trị | Text area, required. MSG02 when empty. |
| Kết quả điều trị | Text area, optional. Free text; can be left empty when not assessed yet. |
| Lời dặn | Text area, required. MSG02 when empty. |
| Tóm tắt bệnh án, Ghi chú | Text areas, optional. |
| Lưu kết luận | Button. Validates and saves the conclusion, then shows MSG03. For a discouraged main code, asks MSG66 with "Giữ mã này" / "Chọn mã khác". |
| Xác nhận kết luận | Button. See Close Medical Record (UC-58). Disabled until the conclusion is saved. |

### **11.4: Print Conclusion** {#11.4:-print-conclusion}

This screen allows Doctor to:

* Preview the conclusion slip of a closed visit  
* Print the slip; a reprint is marked "Bản sao"

**Field Description**

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| In kết luận | Button. Shown in the dialog after closing the record (UC-58) and on the medical record detail of a closed visit for the Doctor of the visit (UC-52). Opens the preview. |
| Phiếu kết luận khám bệnh | Read-only preview: facility header, visit code, "BẢN SAO" for a reprint, patient name, gender, patient code, date of birth, address, visit date, room, diagnosis, secondary diseases, treatment plan, treatment result, advice, date and the Doctor's name. |
| Đóng | Button. Closes the preview without printing. |
| In | Button. Enabled when the preview is loaded. Opens the print dialog of the browser. |

### **11.5: Close Medical Record** {#11.5:-close-medical-record}

This screen allows Doctor to:

* Confirm the saved conclusion and close the medical record in one action  
* Choose the archive category of the record  
* Print the conclusion, prescription and follow-up slips right after closing

**Field Description**

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| Xác nhận kết luận và đóng hồ sơ | Section under the conclusion form. Explains that after confirmation the record is locked and archived and the slips can be printed. |
| Xác nhận kết luận | Button. Disabled until the conclusion is saved (MSG129) and while there are unsaved changes. Checks the visit; MSG25 when some services have no result, MSG67 when the prescription was not sent successfully, with "Mở tab Kê đơn". |
| Xác nhận kết luận (dialog) | Confirmation dialog with MSG27. |
| Loại hồ sơ lưu trữ | Dropdown: Thông thường (10 năm), Tai nạn lao động (20 năm), Tai nạn giao thông (20 năm), Tâm thần (20 năm). Default: "Thông thường (10 năm)". |
| Hủy | Button. Closes the dialog; nothing is changed. |
| Xác nhận | Button. Closes the record, completes the visit and shows MSG130. |
| Đã đóng hồ sơ bệnh án | Dialog after closing, with the visit code and the buttons "In kết luận" (UC-57), "In đơn thuốc" (UC-60, when the visit has a prescription) and "In giấy hẹn" (UC-62, when the visit has an appointment). |
| Về danh sách chờ | Button. Returns to the waiting list. |

### **11.6: Prescribe Medication** {#11.6:-prescribe-medication}

![][image53]

This screen allows Doctor to:

* See the saved diagnosis, the drug allergies and the follow-up date  
* Add drugs from the medicine catalog and fill in each drug line  
* Save, delete, sign and send the prescription (UC-90)

**Field Description**

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| Kê đơn | Tab of the Clinical Examination screen. Shows MSG105 until the conclusion with the main disease is saved. |
| Chẩn đoán (theo kết luận) | Read-only. The diagnosis and its ICD-10 codes; the first one is marked "(bệnh chính)". |
| Dị ứng thuốc | Read-only. The recorded drug allergies; "Chưa ghi nhận dị ứng thuốc" when none. |
| Ngày tái khám | Read-only. The follow-up date; "Chưa hẹn tái khám" when none. |
| Trẻ dưới 72 tháng tuổi | Read-only, child only. Age in months, weight and accompanying person; MSG104 when one is missing. |
| Mã đơn thuốc | Read-only. Prescription code, prescribing time and Doctor; "Mã đơn thuốc được tạo khi lưu đơn lần đầu." before the first save. |
| Thêm thuốc | Search box. Searches the catalog by name, active ingredient, strength, drug code or registration number; a drug already in the prescription is marked "(đã có trong đơn)". |
| STT, Tên thuốc, Hoạt chất, ĐVT, Đường dùng | Table columns, read-only. |
| Liều mỗi lần | Text box, required, at most 50 characters. |
| Lần/ngày | Number, required, 1–24. |
| Số ngày | Number, required, 1–30; up to 90 when the diagnosis is in the long-term list (MSG106). |
| SL | Number, required, 1–9,999 (MSG05). Suggested as dose × times per day × days when the dose is a whole number of the unit. |
| Cách dùng | Text box, required, at most 255 characters. |
| Ghi chú | Text box, optional. |
| Lên, Xuống, Xóa | Buttons on each line. Move the line or remove it. |
| Lưu ý, Lời dặn | Text areas, optional, at most 2,000 characters each (MSG08). |
| Lưu đơn thuốc | Button. Validates (at least one drug, no drug twice) and saves the prescription, then shows MSG03. |
| Ký và gửi đơn | Button. Signs and sends the prescription (UC-90). Disabled with MSG117 when the Doctor has no registered signing certificate. |
| Kết quả gửi | Button. Shows the submission results (UC-91). |
| Xóa đơn | Button. Only for a saved prescription not yet sent. Asks for confirmation (MSG06: “Xóa đơn thuốc này? Mã đơn … sẽ không dùng lại.”), then deletes it. |
| Đơn thuốc đã gửi | Read-only notice MSG88 once the prescription was accepted; the prescription can no longer be edited or deleted. |

### **11.7: Print Prescription** {#11.7:-print-prescription}

This screen allows Doctor to:

| In | Button. Enabled when the preview is loaded. Opens the print dialog of the browser. |

## **12\. Paraclinical Service** {#12.-paraclinical-service-1}

### **12.1: View Waiting Paraclinical List** {#12.1:-view-waiting-paraclinical-list}

This screen allows Technician to:

* View the paraclinical services routed to a room, split into three tabs.  
* Confirm patients present, call, accept or skip them, and open the result form.

**Field Description**

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| Phòng | Drop-down of the paraclinical rooms. The Technician can act only in a room where they are on duty now; otherwise the lists are read-only (MSG48). |
| Thẻ số liệu | Read-only figures of the room for today (waiting, priority, skipped). |
| Chờ tiếp nhận / Chưa đến | Tab (default). Released services of the room whose patient has not been confirmed present yet (no queue number), with the action “Xác nhận có mặt” (UC-65). |
| Hàng đợi vào phòng | Tab. Services whose patient was confirmed present and has a queue number: waiting, in progress or waiting for the result. |
| Đã bỏ qua | Tab. Skipped services with the skip time, with their own search and paging, and the action “Tiếp nhận lại” (UC-46). |
| Tìm kiếm | Text box. Patient code, order code, full name, citizen ID or insurance number (and queue number in the queue tab). |
| Bộ lọc | Drop-downs. Filter by ordering room or by status. |
| Danh sách | Columns: STT / Hàng đợi, Ưu tiên, Bệnh nhân, Mã BN, Loại khám, Dịch vụ, Bác sĩ & Phòng, Thời gian, Trạng thái, Thao tác. Priority patients first, then patients already present, then by queue number, then by order time (BR-14, BR-18). Services of the same order slip in the same room are shown together. |
| Thao tác | “Tiếp nhận” and “Bỏ qua” for a waiting service (UC-65); “Đã thực hiện” and “Trả về” for a service in progress (UC-66); “Nhập KQ” for a performed service (UC-67). |
| Thông tin lâm sàng | Clicking a row opens the patient’s clinical information: clinical note, history, drug allergies and the other services of the slip. |
| Tự động làm mới | The lists refresh every 10 seconds while the screen is visible (UI-04). |

![][image56]

### **12.2: View Pending Result List** {#12.2:-view-pending-result-list}

This screen allows Technician to:

* View the performed services of a room whose results are not submitted yet.  
* Open the result form of a service.

**Field Description**

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| Phòng | Drop-down of the paraclinical rooms. Read-only for a room where the Technician is not on duty now (MSG48). |
| Thẻ số liệu | Read-only: total, not started, draft saved, waiting 30 minutes or more. |
| Tìm kiếm | Text box. Patient code, order code, full name, citizen ID, insurance number or service name. |
| Bộ lọc | Drop-downs. Status (Chưa nhập / Nháp) and ordering room. |
| Danh sách | Columns: STT / Mã phiếu, Ưu tiên, Bệnh nhân, Mã BN, Đối tượng, Dịch vụ đã làm, Thời gian (since performed), Trạng thái (with “Lưu nháp (x/y)” when drafts exist), Thao tác. Priority patients first, then by queue number. |
| Nhập kết quả | Button. Opens the result form of the service (UC-67). Only the technician who performed the service can submit it (BR-29). |
| In phiếu | Button. Prints the order slip of the patient. |

![][image57]

### **12.3: Accept Paraclinical Order** {#12.3:-accept-paraclinical-order}

This screen allows Technician to:

* Confirm that a patient has arrived and give the queue number.  
* Accept the patient who comes in, or skip an absent patient.

**Field Description**

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| Xác nhận có mặt | Button in tab “Chờ tiếp nhận / Chưa đến”. Gives the next paraclinical queue number of the room for today to the service and to the other waiting services of the same slip in the room, and moves the patient to tab “Hàng đợi vào phòng”. A service not paid yet cannot be confirmed. |
| Tiếp nhận | Button for a waiting service that has a queue number. Sets the service (and the other checked-in services of the slip in the room) to In Progress and assigns it to the Technician; an action toast offers “Nhập KQ ngay”. |
| Bỏ qua | Button for a waiting service. Marks the service (and the other waiting services of the slip in the room) as skipped with the skip time and moves it to tab “Đã bỏ qua” (BR-21). |
| Thông báo | Errors are shown when the patient is already checked in, the service is no longer waiting, the patient has not been confirmed present, or the Technician is not on duty in the room (MSG48). |

![][image58]

### **12.4: Perform Paraclinical Order** {#12.4:-perform-paraclinical-order}

This screen allows Technician to:

* Confirm that the accepted service has been performed.  
* Return a service that cannot be performed to the waiting list.

**Field Description**

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| Đã thực hiện | Button for a service in progress. Sets the service (and the other services of the same slip in the room that this Technician is performing) to Performed with the performed time; it then appears in the pending result list (UC-64). |
| Trả về | Button for a service in progress. Opens the dialog “Trả về hàng chờ”. |
| Lý do gợi ý | Buttons with common reasons; clicking one fills “Lý do”. |
| Lý do \* | Text area in the dialog. Required, with a maximum length. The reason is recorded in the audit log. |
| Trả về hàng chờ | Button in the dialog. The service goes back to the waiting list at its original queue number. |
| Hủy | Button in the dialog. Closes it without changes. |

![][image59]

### **12.5: Record Paraclinical Result** {#12.5:-record-paraclinical-result}

This screen allows Technician to:

* Enter, save as draft and submit the result of a service they performed.  
* Upload result images for imaging and functional services.

**Field Description**

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| Thông tin phiếu | Read-only: patient, order code, service, ordering doctor and room, preliminary diagnosis. |
| Giờ lấy mẫu | Laboratory test only. Date and time; not in the future. |
| Chỉ số xét nghiệm | Laboratory test only. One value per parameter of the service, with its unit and the reference range that fits the patient’s sex and age; the system suggests the flag Thấp / Cao / Bất thường (BR-133). |
| Máy thực hiện | Drop-down. Optional. Instruments of the room that match the service type. |
| Kỹ thuật | Imaging only (CT / MRI). Text. |
| Mô tả | Imaging and functional tests. Text, or one field per section of the form; every section is required for endoscopy and ECG. |
| Kết luận \* | Required text. |
| Đề nghị | Optional text. |
| Link hình ảnh | Optional link to the images (e.g. PACS for CT / MRI). |
| Ảnh kết quả | Imaging and functional tests only. JPG or PNG, at most 10 images, each at most 10 MB, with an optional caption. An imaging or functional result needs at least one image or an image link. Images can be removed until the result is submitted. |
| Lưu nháp | Button. Saves the entered data without locking it and shows the time of the last draft. |
| Gửi kết quả | Button. Checks the required fields, shows MSG06, then saves and locks the result (BR-29), sets the service to Completed and shows MSG28. When all services of the visit have results, the visit becomes Waiting for Conclusion. |
| Thông báo | MSG02 / MSG05 / MSG08 at a wrong field; MSG13 when the Technician is not the performer; a submitted result is read-only. |

![][image60]

### **12.6: Print Paraclinical Result** {#12.6:-print-paraclinical-result}

This screen allows Technician to:

* Print the submitted result of a service for the patient.

**Field Description**

| Field Name | Description |

## **16\. Background Job Inventory**

### **16.1 Close Unfinished Visits at End of Day (JOB-01)** {#16.1-close-unfinished-visits-at-end-of-day-(job-01)}

***Trigger:*** Scheduled — every day at 00:05 (Asia/Ho\_Chi\_Minh), configurable (VISIT\_END\_OF\_DAY\_CRON); also runs once when the application starts, to catch up on a missed run.

***Purpose:*** Closes the visits of earlier days that did not finish (BR-22), so the queues start empty every day.

***Processing steps:***

* Find the visits of earlier days that are not finished.  
* A visit still waiting for the examination fee is cancelled; its PayOS payment link is closed first and its pending receipts are cancelled. Paid receipts are never cancelled or refunded.  
* Any other unfinished visit is set to Bỏ khám (abandoned); its unperformed paraclinical services are abandoned and an order whose services were not all performed is cancelled.  
* Each change is recorded in the audit log with the job’s reason.  
* Log the number of cancelled, abandoned and deferred visits.

***Failure behavior:***

| Scenario | System behavior |
| :---- | :---- |
| A visit fails (concurrent edit, PayOS unreachable) | That visit is skipped and retried on the next run; the other visits are still closed. A PayOS link that may still be paid defers the visit. |
| The run at startup fails | A warning is logged; the application keeps running and the scheduled run retries. |
| No unfinished visit | The job ends with no change. |

### **16.2 Mark Expired Follow-up Appointments as Missed (JOB-02)** {#16.2-mark-expired-follow-up-appointments-as-missed-(job-02)}

***Trigger:*** Scheduled — same schedule as JOB-01 (00:05 daily, clinic time); also runs once at startup.

***Purpose:*** Marks “Lỡ hẹn” the follow-up appointments whose validity period has ended (BR-124; 10 working days after the appointment date by default, Saturdays and Sundays not counted).

***Processing steps:***

* Find the appointments still “Đã hẹn” whose validity period has ended.  
* Set them to “Lỡ hẹn”. Marking is idempotent, so a repeated run changes nothing.  
* Log the number of appointments marked.

***Failure behavior:***

| Scenario | System behavior |
| :---- | :---- |
| The run at startup fails | A warning is logged; the scheduled run retries. |
| No expired appointment | The job ends with no change. |

### **16.3 Send Follow-up Reminder Emails (JOB-03)**

***Trigger:*** Scheduled — 08:00, 14:00 and 20:00 every day (clinic time), configurable; enabled only when FOLLOW\_UP\_REMINDER\_ENABLED is true.

***Purpose:*** Sends the reminder email of the follow-up appointments due in 1 day (configurable) to patients who have an email (UC-75).

***Processing steps:***

* Find the scheduled appointments whose follow-up date is the configured number of days ahead and that were not reminded yet.  
* Send one reminder email per appointment; an appointment is reminded only once.  
* Log the number of emails sent, failed and skipped.

***Failure behavior:***

| Scenario | System behavior |
| :---- | :---- |
| Sending an email fails | It is counted as failed and retried at the next run of the same day. |
| The whole run fails | A warning is logged; the next scheduled run retries. |

### **16.4 Clean Up Ended Login Sessions (JOB-04)**

***Trigger:*** Scheduled — every day at 03:30, configurable.

***Purpose:*** Deletes the stored refresh tokens of login sessions that have ended.

***Processing steps:***

* Delete the ended login sessions.  
* Log the number of sessions deleted.

***Failure behavior:***

| Scenario | System behavior |
| :---- | :---- |
| No ended session | The job ends with no change. |

## 

## **17\. External API Inventory** {#17.-external-api-inventory}

### **17.1 PayOS Webhook (API-01)** {#17.1-payos-webhook-(api-01)}

| URL | POST: /api/v1/payments/payos-webhook |
| :---- | :---- |
| Purpose | Receives the result of a PayOS bank-transfer QR payment and marks the matching receipt as paid (UC-71). |
| Caller | PayOS payment gateway |
| Auth | No user login. The webhook signature is verified with the PayOS checksum key; an invalid signature returns 400\. |
| Processing | Finds the receipt by the PayOS order code (404 when not found). Ignores a result that is not successful (code ≠ "00"). Rejects an amount different from the patient amount (400). A receipt already Paid is left unchanged; a receipt that is not Pending returns 409\. Otherwise the receipt is completed as Paid. |
| Response | 200 "OK". |

# **IV. Non-Functional Requirements** {#iv.-non-functional-requirements}

## **1\. External Interfaces** {#1.-external-interfaces}

### **1.1 User Interfaces** {#1.1-user-interfaces}

| ID | Requirement |
| :---- | :---- |
| UI-01 | The system is a web application. All screens are in Vietnamese; dates use the format dd/MM/yyyy, time uses 24-hour format (HH:mm), and money is shown in VND with thousand separators (e.g. 150.000 ₫). |
| UI-02 | After signing in, a user whose password must be changed (first sign-in with a system-generated password, or after an Admin reset) is taken to Change Password first. Otherwise each user lands on the dashboard of their role: Admin \=\> Admin Dashboard; Receptionist \=\> Receptionist Dashboard (today's registrations and room queue status); Doctor \=\> Doctor Dashboard (examination and conclusion waiting lists of the doctor's assigned room); Technician \=\> Technician Dashboard (released paraclinical services of the technician's assigned room); Cashier \=\> Cashier Dashboard (pending payments). |
| UI-03 | Every screen shares the same layout: header (hospital name, current user, role, assigned room and its department, sign-out), left menu containing only the functions allowed for the role (see 4.4 Permission Matrix), and main content area. |
| UI-04 | Waiting lists (examination rooms, paraclinical rooms, pending payments) refresh automatically at least every 10 seconds without reloading the page. Priority patients are highlighted and shown first (BR-14), followed by transferred patients, then by queue number (BR-18). |
| UI-05 | Statuses are shown with their Vietnamese labels and a consistent badge style on all screens (badge colours: TBD until approved in DESIGN.md). Visit – WAITING\_FEE\_PAYMENT, WAITING, IN\_EXAMINATION, WAITING\_PARACLINICAL, WAITING\_CONCLUSION, COMPLETED, CANCELLED, ABANDONED (a skipped visit keeps its status and is marked as skipped); payment – PENDING, PAID, FEE\_EXEMPT, CANCELLED; paraclinical service – PENDING\_PAYMENT, WAITING, IN\_PROGRESS, PENDING\_RESULT, COMPLETED, CANCELLED, ABANDONED. |
| UI-06 | Required fields are marked with (\*). Validation errors are shown in red directly under the field (MSG02, MSG08); success messages are shown as toast messages. |
| UI-07 | Irreversible actions require a confirmation dialog (MSG06) before being executed: Confirm Conclusion (closes the medical record), Submit e-Prescription, Submit Paraclinical Result, Cancel Refused Paraclinical Service, Transfer Patient, Confirm Payment, Lock Account, Reset Password and Delete Shift Assignment. |
| UI-08 | Screens are optimized for desktop resolution 1366×768 and above. Main reception and examination screens must be fully usable with the keyboard (Tab / Enter) to support fast data entry at peak hours; dedicated shortcut keys are TBD. |

 

### **1.2 Hardware Interfaces** {#1.2-hardware-interfaces}

| ID | Device | Requirement |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| HW-01 | Ticket printer (thermal, 80 mm) | Used at the reception desk, the cashier desk, examination rooms and paraclinical rooms to print queue tickets. The examination ticket shows the visit code, queue number, room and room location, and the amount to pay when an exam fee is payable (BR-16). For a self-paid visit that has not paid yet, the receptionist prints a payment guide slip without a queue number; the cashier prints the examination ticket after the fee is paid, and the doctor prints a new ticket after a transfer (UC-41). The technician prints a paraclinical queue ticket when confirming that the patient is present (UC-65). |
| HW-02 | Office printer (A4/A5) | Used to print paraclinical order slips, paraclinical results, examination conclusions, prescriptions, follow-up appointment slips, payment receipts and exported medical records (PDF, form 15/BV1). Print layouts follow the forms required by the Ministry of Health where applicable. |
| HW-03 | Barcode / QR scanner (optional) | Could be used at reception to read the QR code on the chip-based Citizen ID card (CCCD) or the health insurance card to fill in identification fields. Manual input must always remain possible. |
| HW-04 | Queue display screen (optional) | A TV/monitor in front of each examination or paraclinical room could display the queue number being called and the next numbers. |
| HW-05 | Workstations | Standard PCs with a modern web browser; no software installation is required on client machines. Digital signing of e-prescriptions uses the remote signing service with a PIN, so no USB token is needed. |

 

### **1.3 Software Interfaces** {#1.3-software-interfaces}

| ID | External system | Direction | Description |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| SW-01 | Health Insurance Portal (Vietnam Social Security – BHXH), simulated | PHETMS \=\> Portal | During examination registration (UC-40), the Receptionist verifies the card (UC-74). The system sends the insurance card number with the patient's identification data and receives the card validity, the coverage rate and whether the card belongs to the patient (BR-13, BR-27). An invalid card turns the visit into a service visit; if the card does not belong to the patient or the portal does not respond, the Receptionist re-enters the card or chooses a service visit. In this project the portal is a simulator returning predefined data; the interface is designed so that it can be replaced by the real portal later. |
| SW-02 | Web browser | — | Latest two versions of Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge and Mozilla Firefox. |
| SW-03 | Export | PHETMS \=\> File | Statistics reports are exported to Excel (.xlsx) and PDF (UC-33). Medical records are exported to PDF on form 15/BV1 (UC-53) and to XML/JSON for data exchange (UC-80). Examination tickets, paraclinical orders and results, conclusions, prescriptions, follow-up appointment slips and payment receipts are printed from the browser. |
| SW-04 | Paraclinical equipment / existing lab software | — | Direct integration with laboratory and imaging equipment is out of scope (LI-08). Technicians enter the result values, description and conclusion on the Record Paraclinical Result screen and upload result images and attachments (UC-67), which are stored through the Cloudinary Upload API (5.2). The current build accepts PNG/JPEG images only. Integration with the current paraclinical software is an open issue (Q-04). |
| SW-05 | PayOS payment gateway | PHETMS \<=\> PayOS | The Cashier can collect a payment by bank transfer: the system creates a PayOS QR payment request, PayOS returns the payment result through a signed webhook, and the system marks the payment as Paid (UC-71). Unpaid PayOS requests are cancelled by the end-of-day job (BR-22). |
| SW-06 | Remote Signing Service, simulated | PHETMS \<=\> Signing Service | Before an e-prescription is sent, the system requests a digital signature with the Doctor's signing certificate; the Doctor approves with a PIN and the system verifies the signature (UC-90, UC-92). |
| SW-07 | National Prescription System, simulated | PHETMS \<=\> National System | The system sends the signed e-prescription with the 14-character prescription code, diagnosis and follow-up date, and receives acceptance or a list of errors (UC-90 → UC-92). An accepted prescription is locked. |
| SW-08 | Email Service | PHETMS \=\> Email Service | **TBD (UC-75, not implemented yet).** Sends follow-up reminder emails before the appointment date to patients who have an email address. |

 

### **1.4 Communication Interfaces** {#1.4-communication-interfaces}

| ID | Requirement |
| :---: | ----- |
| CI-01 | All communication between browser and server uses HTTPS (TLS 1.2 or higher). The web client and the API are served from the same host; the session cookie is sent with the `Secure` and `HttpOnly` flags. |
| CI-02 | Staff use the system from client workstations through a web browser. The server needs outbound Internet access to Cloudinary (result images) and PayOS (payment requests), and must be reachable over HTTPS from the Internet to receive PayOS payment webhooks.  |
| CI-03 | In this version the health insurance portal, remote signing service and national prescription system are simulators running inside the backend, so no network call is made. When they are replaced by real services, calls use HTTPS REST/JSON with a timeout of 10 seconds. If the insurance portal does not respond, the Receptionist is informed (MSG20) and may retry or register the visit as a service visit (UC-74). |
| CI-04 | Waiting lists (examination rooms, paraclinical rooms, pending payments) are refreshed by polling the server at most every 10 seconds; no push channel (WebSocket/SSE) is used in this version. |
| CI-05 | Calls to PayOS use HTTPS through the PayOS SDK. Incoming PayOS webhooks are accepted only when their signature is valid (checksum key); the system then marks the payment as Paid (UC-71). |
| CI-06 | Result images are uploaded to Cloudinary over HTTPS with signed requests; only HTTPS delivery URLs of the clinic's Cloudinary account are stored (UC-67). |

 

## **2\. Quality Attributes** {#2.-quality-attributes}

### **2.1 Usability**  {#2.1-usability}

### 

| ID | Requirement | Measure |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| US-01 | Training time | A new Receptionist, Doctor, Technician or Cashier can perform the main tasks of their role on their own after at most 2 hours of training. An Admin needs at most 4 hours. |
| US-02 | Registering a returning patient | Search the patient \+ register the visit \+ assign the department \+ print the ticket in at most 60 seconds and at most 6 clicks/key confirmations (excluding insurance verification time). Needed for the 7:00–9:00 peak hours. |
| US-03 | Registering a new patient | Create the patient profile and register the visit in at most 3 minutes. |
| US-04 | Calling the next patient | The Doctor/Technician calls the next patient with one click from the waiting list. |
| US-05 | Data re-use | Patient administrative data, drug allergy history and previous diagnoses are shown automatically and never need to be re-entered at later steps of the visit or at later visits. |
| US-06 | Search | Patient search accepts partial name, phone number, citizen ID or health insurance number, is accent-insensitive for Vietnamese (e.g. "nguyen" matches "Nguyễn") and shows results while typing. |
| US-07 | Error prevention | Pick lists are used instead of free text wherever possible (departments, services, ICD-10 diagnoses, drugs, units, common reasons for visit). |
| US-08 | Consistency | The same action has the same name, icon and position on every screen. |

### 

### **2.2 Performance** {#2.2-performance}

### 

| Requirement | Target | Condition |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Page load time | Any page loads within 2 seconds | Up to 100 users active simultaneously |
| Form submission response | System acknowledges within 2 seconds | Up to 100 users active simultaneously |
| Patient search | Results returned within 1 second | Database of up to 500,000 patient profiles |
| Waiting list update | A registration whose exam fee is paid, a transferred patient or a newly paid CLS service appears in the target department's list within 5 seconds | Normal operation |
| CLS result availability | A recorded CLS result is visible to the ordering Doctor within 5 seconds | Normal operation |
| Health insurance verification | Result returned within 5 seconds (excluding portal outage) | Simulated portal |
| Printing | Examination ticket is sent to the printer within 3 seconds after the registration is confirmed | Normal operation |
| Throughput at peak hours | Handles at least 300 visit registrations per hour | 7:00–9:00 peak hours |
| Report generation | Statistics for a period of up to 12 months are shown/exported within 10 seconds | Up to 1 year of visit data |
| Maximum simultaneous users | System remains fully functional for up to 100 users | Single server deployment |

### 

### **2.3 Security** {#2.3-security}

| Requirement | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| Authentication required | Every page and action other than the sign-in page requires the user to be signed in. There is no self-registration; accounts are created only by the Admin. |
| Role-based access | Each user can only see and perform the functions of their role and within the restricted scope defined in the Permission Matrix (4.4). Access rights are checked by the system on every request, not only by hiding menu items. |
| Password protection | Passwords must never be stored in a form that a person or program can read. Passwords must have 8 to 64 characters and at most 72 bytes (UTF-8). |
| Account lockout | After 5 consecutive failed sign-in or current-password attempts, password sign-in is blocked for 15 minutes. The block ends automatically when the period expires, or earlier when the Admin resets the password (UC-11). This temporary block does not change the account status; manual Lock/Unlock (UC-10) is separate and does not clear it.  |
| Session timeout | A session with no activity for 30 minutes is ended automatically and the user must sign in again. |
| Medical data confidentiality | Patient health data is sensitive personal data. Doctors can view and export the medical records of all patients, including the examination history and paraclinical results of all visits (BR-35), but can only edit the current, uncompleted visit served in their assigned room (BR-19, BR-32). Technicians only see the patients and orders routed to their room; the Cashier only sees billing information; the Receptionist only sees administrative information. Result files are never accessible through a guessable or public link, and every access to a medical record is recorded in the audit log (Data rule: Medical data is access-controlled, I.3.3). |
| Audit trail | The system records who did what and when for: sign-in/sign-out, creating/updating patient profiles, registering and cancelling visits, recording examination data, paraclinical results, diagnoses, prescriptions, concluding examinations, creating/confirming/cancelling payments, price and service changes, and all account, role and department changes. Audit entries cannot be edited or deleted by any user. |
| Closed record protection | A concluded examination (diagnosis, results, prescription) cannot be edited by anyone (BR-32). |
| No data deletion | Accounts, departments, services, patient profiles, registrations, examinations and payments are never permanently deleted; they can only be deactivated, cancelled or abandoned (Data rule: Records are never permanently deleted, I.3.3). |
| Secure transmission | All data is transmitted over HTTPS. |

| 98 | MSG98 | Warning message | After a role change to Doctor/Technician that still lacks professional information or a room | Vui lòng bổ sung học hàm/học vị, số giấy phép hành nghề và phân công phòng cho {full\_name}. |
| 99 | MSG99 | Page notice | Doctor / Technician is not assigned to any room | Bạn chưa được phân công vào phòng nào. Vui lòng liên hệ quản trị viên. |
| 100 | MSG100   | In line | Search returns more than 50 patien ts (UC-35)  | Có hơn 50 bệnh nhân phù hợp, hệ thống chỉ hiển thị 50 kết quả đầu. Vui lòng nhập từ khóa cụ thể hơn.  |
| 101 | MSG101  | Confirmation dialog  | A profile with the same full name and date of birth exists | Đã có {number} hồ sơ trùng họ tên và ngày sinh. Vui lòng kiểm tra trước khi tạo hồ sơ mới. \[Chọn hồ sơ này\] \[Quay lại chỉnh sửa\] \[Vẫn tạo hồ sơ mới\]  |
| 102 | MSG102 | Page notice  | No examination room can receive patients  | Không có phòng khám nào đang hoạt động có thể tiếp nhận bệnh nhân. Vui lòng báo quản trị viên. |
| 103 | MSG103 | In red, under the field | Selecting or sending a medicine that is not in the ordinary control group | {medicine\_name} không thuộc nhóm thuốc thông thường nên không kê được trên đơn thuốc. |
| 104 | MSG104 | In line | Sending a prescription for a child under 72 months without weight or accompanying person | Trẻ dưới 72 tháng tuổi cần có {item} trước khi gửi đơn thuốc. |
| 105 | MSG105 | In line | Prescribing or sending before the conclusion diagnosis is saved | Vui lòng lưu chẩn đoán kết luận trước khi kê và gửi đơn thuốc. |
| 106 | MSG106 | In red, under the field | More than 30 days when no diagnosis is in the long-term list (TT 26/2025 Phụ lục VII) | Chỉ được kê tối đa 30 ngày. Được kê đến 90 ngày khi bệnh chính hoặc bệnh kèm thuộc danh mục bệnh được kê đơn trên 30 ngày. |
| 107 | MSG107 | In red, under the field | The signing PIN is wrong | Mã PIN ký không đúng. |
| 108 | MSG108 | In line | Sending a prescription without a signing PIN set | Bạn chưa thiết lập mã PIN ký. Vui lòng thiết lập trong trang tài khoản. |
| 109 | MSG109 | In line | Changing the conclusion diagnosis after the prescription was accepted | Đơn thuốc đã gửi thành công nên không thể sửa chẩn đoán. |
| 110 | MSG110 | In red, under the field | The ICD-10 code has more detailed codes | Mã ICD-10 này có mã chi tiết hơn. Vui lòng chọn mã chi tiết. |
| 111 | MSG111 | In red, under the field | The ICD-10 code does not apply to the patient's sex | Mã ICD-10 này không áp dụng cho giới tính của người bệnh. |
| 112 | MSG112 | In red, under the field | More than 12 secondary diagnoses | Chỉ chọn tối đa 12 bệnh kèm theo. |

## **3\. Other Requirements** {#3.-other-requirements}

### **3.1 Data Retention** {#3.1-data-retention}

| ID | Requirement |
| :---- | :---- |
| OR-01 | Medical records are kept for at least 10 years in accordance with the Law on Medical Examination and Treatment. *(Retention periods for special cases to be confirmed – Q-14.)* |
| OR-02 | Invoices are kept for at least 10 years. |
| OR-03 | Audit log entries are kept for at least 12 months and cannot be edited or deleted by any user. |

 

### **3.2 Printed Forms** {#3.2-printed-forms}

| ID | Form | Main content |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| PF-01 | Examination ticket | Hospital name, registration code, queue number, department and location, doctor, patient code and name, year of birth, visit type, coverage rate, priority mark, patient amount of the exam fee, payment instruction, date/time. |
| PF-02 | Paraclinical order | Patient information, registration code, order code, list of ordered services with performing departments and locations, ordering Doctor, date. |
| PF-03 | Paraclinical result | Patient information, service, result values/images, conclusion, Technician, date. |
| PF-04 | Examination conclusion | Patient information, vital signs, findings, diagnosis (ICD-10), conclusion, Doctor, date. |
| PF-05 | Prescription | Patient information, diagnosis, drugs (name, dosage, quantity, usage), follow-up date (if any), Doctor, date. Format follows the Ministry of Health prescription regulation. |
| PF-06 | Invoice / receipt | Invoice number, patient information, visit type, coverage rate, service lines with unit price, insurance amount and patient amount, totals, payment method, Cashier, paid time. |

 

### **3.3 Out of Scope** {#3.3-out-of-scope}

The following are not part of this version (see Report 2, Out-of-scope): inpatient care, emergency care and surgery; selling or dispensing medication and drug/medical supply inventory; payment gateways, accounting and settlement with Social Security (the system only records the payment method); real-time connection to the national health insurance portal (simulated only); direct integration with laboratory and imaging equipment; SMS/phone reminders for follow-up appointments; staff shift scheduling, attendance and payroll; patient-facing channels (mobile app, online booking, kiosk); multi-facility management.

### **3.4 Open Issues** {#3.4-open-issues}

| ID | Issue | Impact |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Q-04 | Integration with the current paraclinical result software. | SW-04 |
| Q-09 / BR-14 | How the insurance rule "no repeated examination of the same content within one week if the previous result was normal" is checked. | BR-13, BR-27, UC-49 Order Paraclinical Services |
| Q-14 | Official Ministry of Health forms for electronic medical records. | OR-01, PF-\* |
| Q-15 | Whether doctor shift scheduling is added to the scope. | Scope |
| Q-18 | Handling a skipped patient who is still absent after the recall. | BR-21, BR-22 |
